jobs.title: Welder/Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.

Position Summary:

Basic Function:

He will be responsible to manufacture structural steel and platework, heavy machinery, other fabricated metal products. Welding & Fitting components for final assembly.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

· Perform daily Inspections and maintenance of Personal Protective Equipment and Welding Machines including cables, Welding torch etc. as per Schedule.
· Read and interpret blueprints or welding process specifications
· Operate manually welding equipment to fuse metal segments using processes primarily TIG and some experience with: (OAW), (GTAW), (GMAW) (MIG)
· Repair worn parts of metal products by welding on extra layers
· Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing and soldering equipment
· adjusting welding heads and tooling according to work specifications
· Perform Self-Inspection of parts and work to print
· Complete and maintain paperwork.

• Check machine for defects and repair if necessary

• Ensure machine is calibrated and cleaned

• Lift work piece manually, by forklift or by overhead crane, positions and secures against guides and stops.

• Maintains a clean work area, including his equipment, work supplies and materials

• Complies with Federal, State, and local occupational safety, environmental, health and Safety and air pollution control regulations including machine safety with all safety precautions recommended by Machine manufacturers.

• Adhere to Sulzer safety standards of facility and actively participate in the company’s Safe Behavioral Program & Take 5.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

Experience, Education & Skills:

• Required: 2-3 years’ experience in use of metal fabrication or related work comparable experience in other fields

• Desired:

• High School Degree or GED

• Completion of a three-year apprenticeship program

• Ability to set-up and run machinery without supervision

• Understand and follow oral and written instructions

• Forklift or Crane license considered an asset

• Trade certification is required

• Ability to read and interpret production and sales orders.

• Experience in safe use, storage and disposal of Welding rods & cleaning the work area etc.

• Knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local laws, codes and regulations pertaining to occupational safety, health, and air pollution control.

• Experienced in using power and hand tools

• Meticulous and detail oriented

• Able to lift 50 pounds unassisted

• Able to work independently

• Highly self-motivated

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Suportar a elaboração propostas técnicas e comerciais para fornecimento de peças sobressalentes e reparos em equipamentos rotativos de acordo com a necessidade do cliente

jobs.title: Engineer Rotating Equipment (Shop)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as an Engineer Rotating Equipment (Shop). In this role you will be accountable for:

•
• Inspection & repair activities on rotating equipment in our local workshop

•
• Reverse engineering processes of rotating equipment parts

•
• The repairs, operations, and maintenance of rotating equipment in general

•
• The developments on rotating equipment related services and products

•
• The support of field service activities in a back-office role

•
• Advice and support to other departments e.g. sales, tendering as well as external customers

To succeed in this role, you will need:

•
• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering

•
• 5 years’ experience in rotating equipment engineering

•
• Very good English language skills

•
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude

•
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

What we offer you

•
• A more than competitive salary

•
• A generous number of holidays (40)

•
• A solid pension scheme

•
• Training opportunities

•
• Company restaurant at the facility with tasty and healthy options

•
• Bicycle plan, company fitness, and more

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
Analista de Serviços
Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our team within as an Electrical Fitter in our Laverton North Service Centre.

• Repair and maintain LV & HV electrical rotating machinery.

• Assemble and disassemble electrical rotating equipment.

• Conduct static and dynamic tests on electrical equipment to ensure optimal performance.

• Rewind electric motors and generators.

• Perform balancing on motors to keep things running smoothly.

• Keep the goods flowing with timely ordering when required.

• Take direction from your Supervisor to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.

• When required, attend onsite to conduct effective repairs of electrical rotating equipment.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• CERT III in Electrotechnology or above / equivalent.

• Experience in repairing and rewinding DC motors, medium to High Voltage electrical motors, and generators.

• Excellent time management skills to keep things on track.

• Strong teamwork skills.

• Dedication to maintaining a safe work environment at all times.

What we offer you

• Variety of work at service centre location and field work

• Site allowances for field work

• Technical training and development

• On-site car parking

• Employee Assistance Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The Technical Buyer PPR is responsible for purchase goods, materials and services through proper and fair negotiations to ensure that the projects’ needs are met, taking into consideration price, quality and lead times, according to Sulzer policies. Description of the specific tasks

• Adhere to Sulzer policies and procedures regarding the purchase of Products and Services and in accordance with the finance department procedures applicable to Procurement

• Assume responsibility for leading the procurement of assigned project materials, products and services within budget and within project timescales.

• Establish working relationships with vendors to strengthen business and support company strategies.

• Keep contact with all related suppliers to evaluate the characteristics of the products and services being supplied under the required quality and conditions

• Monitor market trends, competitor strategies and market suppliers

• Explore alternate sources for goods and materials

• Provide the project team with the offers received, making the relevant comments and suggestions about the suppliers, opportunities and market status.

• Prepare technical and commercial evaluation sheets ensuring full scope of supply has been quoted accurately and like throughout panel of vendors

• Gather all relevant requirements from the different departments involved in the project (PM, quality, ORE, …) and host bid clarification meetings with the suppliers involving all stakeholders within the business if required to ensure scope is in line with the needs of the project and company business.

• Responsible for the timely conversion of requisitions to purchase order placement

• Obtain written confirmation of delivery by means of securing formal purchase order acknowledgments for all purchase orders

• Ensure delivery of purchased supplies in accordance with project and production requirements in a timely manner and with the required quality

• Expedite supplier activities as well as internal involved departments to provide the required feedback to enable suppliers to progress with engineering / production activity.

• Manage the timely resolution of Non-Conformities with suppliers and coordinate the internal activities required for their closure.

• Effectively communicate and escalate any risks to delivery dates and production schedule within the business.

• Keep updated the relevant data on the ERP of the factory on the assigned tasks and responsibilities.

• Identify lessons learnt, communicate them to all relevant stakeholders and properly document them according to Sulzer Spain procedures

• Balance both tactical executions with strategic initiatives necessary to drive cost reduction projects.

• Delivers briefs, updates and reports as required and attends required meetings

• Commit to the continuous improvement strategy by developing ideas and strategies to improve operational efficiency, add value, aid business performance and work.

• Assume responsibility for any proposed and assigned actions within any internal improvement project.

• Behavioral demonstration of safety policies commitment and mindset

• Be ethical and compliant with all regulations in place

Skills

• Highly skilled at negotiating.

• Contract management.

• Planning.

• Strong oral and written communication in Spanish and English.

• Willing to assume responsibilities.

• Results oriented.

• Ability to coordinate several projects at a time.

• Problem-solving

• Proactivity in incident resolution

jobs.title: Project & Customer Support Engineer PPR
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Project & Customer Support Engineer is responsible for leading the execution of a project, developing its planning, control, and coordination from initiation to completion, with the aim of meeting the established deadlines, ensuring the quality previously agreed with the client, and achieving the defined economic margins. Specific Tasks:

• Serving as the main point of contact with the client throughout the entire manufacturing process and until the closure of warranty periods.

• Execution of spare parts and duplicate pump projects, monitoring production progress across the different Operations areas, such as Engineering, Purchasing, Production, Finance, and Logistics, overseeing, among others, the following phases:

• Production release.

• Purchasing.

• Arrangement of materials from stock.

• Manufacturing of materials sourced from external suppliers and from the company’s own facilities.

• Material receipts.

• Quality inspections.

• Non-conformities management.

• Technical and quality documentation generated in accordance with project requirements.

• Deliveries and logistics.

• Invoicing.

• Potential warranty claims.

• Project planning.

• Identification of risks that may impact project success and proactive anticipation through corrective measures.

• Liaison with suppliers and negotiation of terms and conditions.

• Client interaction and ability to work under pressure.

• Coordination with other Sulzer Group sites worldwide, both to support ongoing projects and to provide the necessary information for forecasting monthly and annual results.

• Accountability for the project’s financial performance.

• Management of project transportation and logistics.

• Proactive participation in and support of company initiatives aimed at promoting a culture of workplace safety, environmental protection, and continuous improvement.

Skills:

• Highly skilled at negotiating.

• Contract management and conflict resolution.

• Planning.

• Strong oral and written communication in Spanish and English.

• Willing to assume responsibilities.

• Team player.

• Results oriented.

• Ability to coordinate several projects at a time.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Technico-Commercial
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Vous serez habilité(e) à développer des stratégies de marché, de nouvelles applications, à diriger des discussions technico-commerciales et à gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la phase d’appel d’offre jusqu'à l'exécution, tout en collaborant avec des experts mondiaux et des équipes locales. Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Commercial(e) Technique motivé(e) pour diriger la croissance de notre activité Mass Transfer Components and Services (MTCS) en Algérie et dans certains pays africains francophones.

Les principales responsabilités sont :

• Effectuer des visites régulières chez les clients existants et potentiels pour comprendre les besoins techniques et commerciaux, présenter les capacités de l’entreprise, renforcer la proximité client et assurer des relations durables.

• Identifier, générer et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales dans le territoire et les marchés définis, assurant un solide pipeline de projets et une croissance durable.

• Évaluer les demandes clients sous les angles technique et commercial, en collaboration avec les « application managers » et les spécialistes techniques back-office afin d’assurer l'alignement avec les exigences clients.

• Préparer et présenter des offres techniquement et commercialement solides et réaliser des présentations techniques ou des formations mettant en avant les choix de conception, les performances et notre valeur ajoutée.

• Développer des conceptions performantes et économiques en utilisant les données de process clients et les outils logiciels internes.

• Préparer des estimations de coûts précises pour les solutions proposées en utilisant les outils internes et/ou avec les équipes CEG (Cost Estimation Group) basées en usine.

• Gérer l’ensemble du processus d'appel d'offres, incluant préparation, soumission, suivi, réunions de clarification et négociation des termes commerciaux afin de sécuriser des contrats équitables et d »fendant les intérêts de Sulzer.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle :

• Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur en génie chimique ou discipline technique apparentée. Un master est un avantage.

• Expérience : Minimum 10 ans d'expérience dans l’un des domaines suivants : Usines / installations industrielles ou support technique opérationnel dans des raffineries locales/régionales, usines pétrochimiques, unités de production/traitement de gaz ou autres installations chimiques/biobasées ou fournisseurs de technologies / EPC – Vente technique, ingénierie d'affaires chez un fournisseur local de technologies, organisation de services industriels ou contractant EPC.

• Un profil mixte – Une combinaison d’expérience en exploitation et chez un fournisseur/EPC est hautement valorisée.

Les compétences demandées :

• Bonne compréhension des technologies de séparation, équipements de transfert de masse, technologies de mélange ou procédés associés.

• Capacité à analyser des données process et proposer des solutions fiables et économiques.

• Familiarité avec les schémas techniques tels que PFD et P&ID.

• Compétences commerciales : Compréhension des mécanismes et procédures commerciaux / Capacité à préparer offres, appels d’offres, estimations de coûts et à participer aux négociations contractuelles

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Évoluer sur des projets dimensionnant et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 3 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 4 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT - Variable avec un Bonus

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Head of TS Sales - EAPA
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The TS Sales Director sets the regional sales objectives for the TS
product line, (including the corresponding targets for order intake, gross margin and sales), develops and implements winning strategies for projects, provides guidance to local sales teams, defines key customer accounts and actively develops customers relationships, leads the forecasting process on a monthly basis and acts as the Product Line interface to subregional sales teams for the region. This role will also be actively involved in Product Line campaigns, working with the global team to develop sales strategies, define target markets
and technical capabilities required (locally or globally) to reach sales targets Main tasks

• To evaluate all current and relevant information on market trends, customers and competitors and set the appropriate sales targets at a regional and sub-regional level in conjunction with the Regional Head.

• To create sales and action plans for TS, identify key projects, define actions for regional and local teams, follow through until project closure

• To develop, expand and maintain sales channels for TS through direct customer contact, via agents and/or within the Sulzer organization

• To advise the Regional Head on market volume, sales budget and the ways of working the market, lead budgeting activities across the region to help develop and set targets and strategies for subsequent years.

• To identify opportunities to sell the entire TS service/product portfolio according to the sales plan

• To lead the regional sales team in providing TS product expertise when required at a sub-regional or country level to meet sales targets

• To work with the TS Product Line on introducing new services/products to the region

• To work with regional colleagues to develop and manage (potential) acquisition activities for the region

• To manage all TS distributors, agents or resellers including due diligence, performance management and agreement renewal, ensuing strict compliance with internal IDD processes

• To draft suitable, profitable contracts by negotiating with customers on delivery, quality, (export) regulations, payment terms, etc., taking into account the rules and/or specific requirements for certain countries and/or customers

• To plan and implement PR activities for (potential) customers, sales channels/agents, user groups, fairs, conferences and the internal organization (including customer training).

• To act as a reporting, mediating and/or problem-solving entity between the customer, agent and internal organization in order to prevent escalation and/or claims.

• To make improvement proposals for (new) products and/or services.  Maintaining all account, contact and opportunity data on Salesforce.com to always ensure maximum levels of accuracy.

• Work with Product Line to represent region in strategy development, contribute to strategy development and lead regional implementation efforts  To act as TS subject matter expert

Responsibilities:

• Achieving the sales plan for the region with regard to order intake, gross margin and sales

• Introducing existing services/products to new market areas and introducing new services/products to existing market areas.

• Lead handover activities from sales to operations to ensure clearly defined deliverables, scope and timeline to help ensure on time and on budget delivery of projects and recognition of sales.

• Lead regional customer management and potential acquisition activities

Minimum Job Requirements

Education requirements (desirable):

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

Job experience:

• 15 years sales experience within the rotating equipment market

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):

• Is capable of commu

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Mansioni TS Sales Director definisce gli obiettivi regionali di vendita per la linea di prodotti TS, (inclusi gli obiettivi corrispondenti per l'assunzione di ordini, il margine lordo e le vendite), sviluppa e implementa strategie vincenti per i progetti, fornisce una guida ai team di vendita locali, definisce i clienti principali e sviluppa attivamente le relazioni dei clienti, conduce il processo di previsione su base mensile e funge da interfaccia Product Line ai team di vendita subregionali per la regione. Questo ruolo sarà anche attivamente coinvolto nelle campagne di Product Line, lavorando con il team globale per sviluppare strategie di vendita, definire i mercati target e le capacità tecniche necessarie (localmente o globalmente) per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita
• Requisiti - Valutare tutte le informazioni attuali e pertinenti sulle tendenze del mercato, i clienti e i concorrenti e fissare gli obiettivi di vendita appropriati a livello regionale e subregionale in collaborazione con il capo regionale. - Per creare piani di vendita e di azione per TS, identificare i progetti chiave, definire azioni per le squadre regionali e locali, seguire fino alla chiusura del progetto - Sviluppare, espandere e mantenere i canali di vendita per TS attraverso il contatto diretto del cliente, tramite agenti e/o all'interno dell'organizzazione Sulzer - Per consigliare il Capo Regionale sul volume del mercato, il bilancio delle vendite e le modalità di lavoro del mercato, condurre attività di bilancio in tutta la regione per aiutare a sviluppare e impostare obiettivi e strategie per gli anni successivi. - Per identificare le opportunità di vendere l'intero portafoglio di servizi/prodotti TS secondo il piano di vendita - guidare il team di vendita regionale nel fornire competenze di prodotto TS quando richiesto a livello subregionale o paese per soddisfare gli obiettivi di vendita - Lavorare con TS Product Line per introdurre nuovi servizi/prodotti nella regione - Lavorare con i colleghi regionali per sviluppare e gestire (potenziali) attività di acquisizione per la regione - gestire tutti i distributori TS, agenti o rivenditori, tra cui la dovuta diligenza, la gestione delle prestazioni e il rinnovo degli accordi, garantendo una stretta conformità ai processi IDD interni - redigere contratti idonei e vantaggiosi negoziando con i clienti in materia di consegna, qualità, (esportazione), termini di pagamento, ecc., tenendo conto delle regole e/o dei requisiti specifici per determinati paesi e/o clienti - Pianificare e implementare attività di PR per clienti (potenziali), canali di vendita/agenti, gruppi di utenti, fiere, conferenze e organizzazione interna (compresa la formazione del cliente) - agire come entità di reporting, mediazione e/o problem solving tra il cliente, l'agente e l'organizzazione interna al fine di prevenire l'escalation e/o reclami - Promuovere proposte di miglioramento (nuovi) prodotti e/o servizi - Mantenere tutti i dati di account, contatto e opportunità su Salesforce.com per garantire sempre i massimi livelli di accuratezza. - Lavorare con Product Line per rappresentare la regione nello sviluppo della strategia, contribuire allo sviluppo della strategia e portare gli sforzi di attuazione regionale - agire come esperto di materia TS Cosa? - L'opportunità di lavorare con un team globale di esperti in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo - La possibilità di sviluppare le tue competenze e contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative - Un pacchetto di stipendio e benefici competitivi - L'opportunità di fare una vera differenza nel mondo Contatto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Mansion Der TS Sales Director setzt die regionalen Verkaufsziele für die TS-Produktlinie (einschließlich der entsprechenden Zielvorgaben für Auftragseingang, Bruttomarge und Umsatz), entwickelt und implementiert Gewinnstrategien für Projekte, bietet Beratung für lokale Vertriebsteams, definiert Schlüsselkundenkonten und entwickelt aktiv Kundenbeziehungen, führt monatlich den Prognoseprozess und fungiert als Product Line-Schnittstelle für subregionale Vertriebsteams für die Region. Diese Rolle wird auch aktiv an Product Line Kampagnen beteiligt sein und mit dem globalen Team zur Entwicklung von Vertriebsstrategien zusammenarbeiten, Zielmärkte definieren und technische Fähigkeiten erforderlich (lokal oder global), um Verkaufsziele zu erreichen Voraussetzungen - Zur Bewertung aller aktuellen und relevanten Informationen über Markttrends, Kunden und Wettbewerber und zur Festlegung der angemessenen Verkaufsziele auf regionaler und subregionaler Ebene in Verbindung mit dem Regionalleiter. - Um Vertriebs- und Aktionspläne für TS zu erstellen, Schlüsselprojekte zu identifizieren, Aktionen für regionale und lokale Teams zu definieren, folgen Sie bis zum Projektabschluss - Um Vertriebskanäle für TS durch direkten Kundenkontakt, über Agenten und/oder innerhalb der Sulzer-Organisation zu entwickeln, zu erweitern und zu pflegen - Um den Regionalen Leiter über Marktvolumen, Verkaufsbudget und die Funktionsweise des Marktes zu beraten, führen Sie die Budgetierung in der gesamten Region, um Ziele und Strategien für die nächsten Jahre zu entwickeln und festzulegen. - Die Möglichkeiten, das gesamte TS-Service/Produktportfolio nach dem Verkaufsplan zu verkaufen - Um das regionale Vertriebsteam bei der Bereitstellung von TS-Produktkompetenz bei Bedarf auf subregionaler oder landwirtschaftlicher Ebene zu leiten, um Vertriebsziele zu erreichen - Mit der TS Produktlinie zu arbeiten, neue Dienstleistungen/Produkte in die Region einzuführen - Mit regionalen Kollegen zusammenarbeiten, um (potenzielle) Akquisitionsaktivitäten für die Region zu entwickeln und zu verwalten - Um alle TS-Distributoren, Agenten oder Wiederverkäufer zu verwalten, einschließlich Due Diligence, Performance Management und Vertragserneuerung, um die Einhaltung interner IDD-Prozesse zu gewährleisten - Erarbeitung geeigneter, profitabler Verträge durch Verhandlungen mit Kunden über Liefer-, Qualitäts-, (Export-)Bestimmungen, Zahlungsbedingungen usw. unter Berücksichtigung der Regeln und/oder spezifischen
• Anforderungen für bestimmte Länder und/oder Kunden - Planung und Umsetzung von PR-Aktivitäten für (potentielle) Kunden, Vertriebskanäle/Agenten, Nutzergruppen, Messen, Konferenzen und die interne Organisation (einschließlich Kundenschulung) - Als Melde-, Vermittlungs- und/oder Problemlöseeinrichtung zwischen dem Kunden, Agenten und der internen Organisation zu fungieren, um eine Eskalation und/oder Ansprüche zu verhindern - Verbesserungsvorschläge für (neue) Produkte und/oder Dienstleistungen - Bewahren Sie alle Konto-, Kontakt- und Gelegenheitsdaten auf Salesforce.com, um immer maximale Genauigkeit zu gewährleisten. - Arbeiten mit der Produktlinie, um Region in der Strategieentwicklung zu vertreten, zur Strategieentwicklung beizutragen und regionale Umsetzungsbemühungen zu leiten - als TS-Fachexperte handeln

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Mansioni Le directeur des ventes de TS fixe les objectifs de vente régionaux pour la gamme de produits de TS (y compris les objectifs correspondants pour l'entrée de commandes, la marge brute et les ventes), élabore et met en œuvre des stratégies gagnantes pour les projets, fournit des conseils aux équipes de vente locales, définit les comptes clients clés et développe activement des relations avec les clients, dirige le processus de prévision sur une base mensuelle et agit comme interface de la gamme de produits aux équipes de vente sous-régionales pour la région. Ce rôle sera également activement associé aux campagnes Product Line, en collaboration avec l'équipe mondiale pour développer des stratégies de vente, définir des marchés cibles et les capacités techniques nécessaires (localement ou à l'échelle mondiale) pour atteindre les objectifs de vente
• Requisiti - Évaluer toutes les informations actuelles et pertinentes sur les tendances du marché, les clients et les concurrents et fixer les objectifs de vente appropriés aux niveaux régional et sous-régional en collaboration avec le chef régional. - Créer des plans de vente et d'action pour les TS, identifier les projets clés, définir les actions pour les équipes régionales et locales, suivre jusqu'à la clôture du projet - Développer, étendre et maintenir les canaux de vente pour TS par le biais de contacts directs avec les clients, par l'intermédiaire d'agents et/ou au sein de l'organisation Sulzer - Conseiller le chef régional sur le volume du marché, le budget des ventes et les modalités de fonctionnement du marché, diriger les activités de budgétisation dans toute la région pour aider à élaborer et à fixer des objectifs et des stratégies pour les années suivantes. - Identifier les possibilités de vendre l'ensemble du portefeuille de services/produits TS selon le plan de vente - Diriger l'équipe régionale de vente en fournissant l'expertise sur les produits TS lorsque nécessaire au niveau sous-régional ou national pour atteindre les objectifs de vente - Travailler avec la gamme de produits TS à l'introduction de nouveaux services/produits dans la région - Travailler avec des collègues régionaux pour développer et gérer des activités d'acquisition (potentielles) pour la région - Gérer tous les distributeurs, agents ou revendeurs de TS, y compris la diligence raisonnable, la gestion du rendement et le renouvellement de l'entente, en veillant au strict respect des processus internes de DCI - Élaborer des contrats appropriés et rentables en négociant avec les clients sur la livraison, la qualité, la réglementation (exportation), les conditions de paiement, etc., en tenant compte des règles et/ou des exigences spécifiques de certains pays et/ou clients - Planifier et mettre en œuvre des activités de relations publiques pour les clients (potentiels), les canaux/agents de vente, les groupes d'utilisateurs, les foires, les conférences et l'organisation interne (y compris la formation des clients) - Agir en tant qu'entité de rapport, de médiation et/ou de résolution de problèmes entre le client, l'agent et l'organisation interne afin d'éviter l'escalade et/ou les réclamations - Faire des propositions d'amélioration pour (nouveaux) produits et/ou services - Tenir à jour toutes les données de compte, contact et opportunité sur Salesforce.com afin d'assurer toujours des niveaux maximums de précision. - Travailler avec la gamme de produits pour représenter la région dans l ' élaboration de stratégies, contribuer à l ' élaboration de stratégies et diriger les efforts de mise en œuvre au niveau régional - Agir en qualité d'expert en matière de TS
• Cosa offriamo - L'opportunité de travailler avec une équipe mondiale d'experts dans un environnement dynamique et innovant - La possibilité de développer votre expertise et de contribuer au développement de solutions innovantes - Un régime concurrentiel de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux - L'occasion de faire une vraie différence dans le monde Contatto

jobs.title: Ingénieur Technico-Commercial Itinérant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Assist in preparing and delivering technical presentations.
Support the development of customized solutions based on client needs.
Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure feasibility of proposals.
Respond to customer inquiries and provide technical support.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
Maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Strong interest in technology and sales.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM tools.
Team player with a proactive mindset.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Centro de Servicios - Antofagasta
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El propósito del cargo de supervisor de Centro de Servicios de Antofagasta es liderar la operación integral del taller, asegurando que cada reparación y servicio de mantenimiento de bombas centrífugas cumpla con los más altos estándares de calidad, seguridad y eficiencia. Esta posición es clave para el crecimiento del negocio en la región, exigiendo un equilibrio entre la excelencia técnica en hidráulica y una visión comercial proactiva para identificar oportunidades junto al equipo de ventas.
Responsabilidades Principales

• Gestión Operativa y Planificación: Dirigir la programación diaria del taller, asignando recursos y personal de manera eficiente para cumplir con los plazos de entrega del cliente.

• Aseguramiento de Calidad y Técnica: Supervisar la ejecución de reportes técnicos detallados y asegurar que todas las reparaciones sigan los protocolos de fábrica.

• Control de Gestión (KPIs): Implementar y monitorear indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) enfocados en productividad y rentabilidad.

• Administración ERP: Garantizar la integridad de la data operativa, incluyendo la carga de horas hombre (HH) y consumos en el sistema ERP.

• Desarrollo Comercial: Colaborar con el área de ventas en visitas técnicas, identificar necesidades no cubiertas en los clientes y evaluar la factibilidad de nuevos negocios.

• Gestión de Seguridad (HSE): Liderar la cultura de seguridad en el taller, garantizando el cumplimiento de las normativas de seguridad ocupacional y el cuidado de las instalaciones.

• Mejora Continua: Identificar e implementar mejoras en los procesos operativos para optimizar costos y elevar el estándar del servicio.

• Gestión de Proveedores: Desarrollar y evaluar la red de proveedores locales para asegurar el suministro de insumos y servicios externos de alta calidad.

Requisitos y Cualificaciones

• Formación Académica: Ingeniero Mecánico, Industrial o carrera técnica superior afín.

• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia liderando talleres mecánicos de alta complejidad, con foco específico en la reparación y mantenimiento de bombas centrífugas (Slurry, Multietapa, Verticales, etc.).

• Conocimientos Técnicos: Experiencia avanzada en hidráulica, interpretación de planos, tolerancias mecánicas y análisis de fallas en equipos rotativos.

• Liderazgo: Capacidad demostrada para manejar equipos de trabajo operativos, promoviendo el desarrollo profesional y el buen clima laboral.

• Herramientas Digitales: Manejo fluido de sistemas ERP (SAP) y herramientas de Office para la generación de reportes e indicadores.

• Residencia: Residencia en Antofagasta.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos:

• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.

• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro de salud y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A highly skilled industrial technician who installs, maintains, repairs, and troubleshoots complex machinery and mechanical equipment in manufacturing plants, refineries, power facilities, and other industrial environments. Millwrights ensure equipment operates safely, efficiently, and with minimal downtime by performing precision alignment, fabrication, calibration, and preventive maintenance. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble compressors, turbines, gearboxes, expanders and other rotating equipment

• Assemble machines as per instructed by Supervisor

• Possess a sufficient quantity of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments

• Continuously upgrade knowledge of projects, materials and procedures to better perform duties including safety cards

• Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager.

• Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Valid driver’s License

• Ability to obtain a Transportation Workers Identification credentials(TWIC)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of the organization

• Strong mechanical aptitude and ability learn technical and design aspects for Rotating Equipment service and repairs

• Physical ability to work in a shop and field environments

• Travel is required

• Experienced in driven equipment repair such as generators, compressors, and pumps

• Experienced in alignments

• Professional presentation, in manner, attitude, appearance, speech, and dependability, to the customer at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingeniero de Ventas - Zona Norte
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El ingeniero de ventas es responsable de desarrollar y promover la venta de productos (piezas de Sulzer y de otros fabricantes) y servicios (servicios de campo y reparaciones) en el mercado de servicios de Sulzer en el Norte de Chile.

Actúa como único punto de contacto, dirigiendo todos los aspectos del desarrollo de oportunidades desde la fase inicial hasta la entrada del pedido.
Responsabilidades

• Trabajar de manera multidisciplinaria con los otros departamentos para preparar planes de ventas y ofertas, garantizando la precisión técnica y financiera.

• Trabajar con el equipo de ventas en general para identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.

• Establecer y mantener relaciones efectivas con los clientes, comprender sus necesidades y promover la comprensión por parte del cliente de nuestra oferta de productos, sistemas y/o servicios.

• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.

• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.

• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.

• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.

• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.

• Proveer información completa y precisa en el desarrollo de los procesos de cotización.

• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.

• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para tu región y cuentas relacionadas.

• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.

• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.

• Visitas constantes a los clientes para desarrollo de nuevos mercados.

• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales.

Requisitos:

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en ventas técnicas y/o industriales.

• Licenciado en ingeniería mecánica, hidráulica, ambiental, química o afines.

• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)

• Conocimiento de mercados de minería y beneficiamiento de metales o conocimiento de mercados de energía y Petroquímica.

• Conocimiento de alguna de las siguientes soluciones: bombas hidráulicas de acuerdo a la norma API, sistemas de bombeo y transporte de agua, estaciones de bombeo.

• Dominio de Microsoft Office (Excel) y Sales Force.

• Lugar: Santiago y/o Antofagasta

• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas.

• Excelentes dotes de comunicación y presentación para comunicarse eficazmente con las partes interesadas.

• Capacidad para trabajar en colaboración en equipos multifuncionales y globales y para relacionarse con los altos directivos.

• Idiomas: inglés nivel intermedio.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos:

• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.

• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro de salud y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Técnico Mecánico
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El Técnico Mecánico es responsable de la revisión, mantenimiento, registro y reparación de los equipos de bombeo
Principales responsabilidades

• Desmontar equipos de bombeo anotando las identificaciones de las piezas, la configuración y el estado.

• Ensamblar unidades de bombeo, incluidas las unidades de ingeniería que requieren un ajuste intrincado, para su envío o prueba.

• Limpiar los componentes de los equipos de bombeo según sea necesario utilizando diversos métodos y pasos.

• Realizar controles dimensionales y/o geométricos de las partes de los equipos de bombeo.

• Solicitar correctamente los repuestos necesarios para la reparación y/o mantenimiento de los equipos de bombeo.

• Manejar equipos especializados de reparación y prueba y otros equipos según sea necesario.

• Completar el papeleo requerido para cada trabajo con precisión y a tiempo.

• Realizar reportes de inspección de los equipos, detallando las piezas de cambio y aquellas que requieren reparación.

• Prestar asistencia en campo para servicio de mantenimiento, puesta en marcha y comisionamiento de bombas.

Requisitos

• Nivel Técnico Profesional. Estudios relacionados a Mecánica.

• 5 años de experiencia en puestos similares.

• 2 años de experiencia en mecánica de bombas y/o montaje.

• Manejo con seguridad una carretilla elevadora y un puente grúa bajo estándares de seguridad. Experiencia comprobable.Se requiere capacidad de resolución de problemas mecánicos y habilidades de solución de problemas.

• Conocimiento y capacidad para utilizar herramientas manuales básicas.

• Capacidad para comprender, realizar y retener la formación relacionada con diversas habilidades y los procedimientos operativos y de seguridad demostrados por el supervisor.

• Debe ser capaz de comunicarse y redactar buenos informes relacionados con el trabajo.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos

• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.

• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro de salud y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingeniero Tendering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El Ingeniero de Tendering es el responsable de centralizar y elaborar las propuestas técnico-económicas para los centros de servicio de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción. Su misión principal es transformar los hallazgos técnicos de los talleres en cotizaciones competitivas, rentables y rápidas. Este rol requiere una coordinación constante con Operaciones y Planificación para asegurar que los costos y plazos ofrecidos sean realistas, actuando como un facilitador crítico para mejorar la satisfacción del cliente interno y externo.
Responsabilidades Principales

• Elaboración de Cotizaciones: Desarrollar presupuestos detallados para la reparación de bombas centrífugas y servicios en terreno, integrando costos de mano de obra, repuestos y servicios de terceros.

• Análisis Técnico-Económico: Realizar evaluaciones profundas de los requerimientos del cliente para asegurar que la solución propuesta sea técnicamente viable y económicamente óptima para Sulzer.

• Gestión de Proveedores: Buscar, evaluar y negociar con proveedores de servicios externos para mejorar los márgenes de los proyectos y reducir costos operativos.

• Coordinación Interna (S&OP): Trabajar estrechamente con los Supervisores de los Centros de Servicios y el Planificador para validar la disponibilidad de recursos y los tiempos de entrega (Lead Times) antes de enviar ofertas.

• Optimización de Planillas y Herramientas: Desarrollar y mantener herramientas de cálculo (Excel avanzado/Software) que permitan estandarizar los precios y acelerar el tiempo de respuesta al cliente.

• Uso de ERP (SAP): Ingresar y gestionar las cotizaciones en el sistema, asegurando la correcta carga de datos para la posterior conversión en órdenes de venta.

• Seguimiento y Mejora Continua: Analizar la tasa de éxito de las ofertas enviadas y proponer ajustes en la estrategia de precios para mejorar la competitividad en el mercado minero e industrial.

Requisitos y Cualificaciones

• Educación: Ingeniero Civil o Ejecución Mecánica (Excluyente)

• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia demostrable en áreas de servicio técnico, mantenimiento o ingeniería de propuestas para equipos rotativos de alta complejidad.

• Disponibilidad: Disponibilidad para viajar (30%) a los centros de Antofagasta, Santiago y Concepción para relevamiento técnico de proyectos complejos.

Conocimientos Técnicos

• Sólidos conocimientos en sistemas de bombeo e hidráulica aplicada.

• Habilidad para interpretar planos de fabricación y hojas de datos técnicos.

• Experiencia en evaluación de daños y reportabilidad técnica.

• Capacidad de negociación con proveedores.

• Excel avanzado (macros y tablas dinámicas) para modelamiento de costos.

• Deseable manejo de SAP u otros ERP industriales.

What we offer you

Ofrecemos

• Salario y beneficios alineados con el mercado.

• Bono anual acorde a los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro de salud y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Referent Monteur Mecanicien
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un/une Technicien Suivi de Fabrication et activités chantiers pour rejoinder nos équipes.

Réaliser des opérations d’assemblage de mécanique de précision au sein de l’atelier (prototypes & petites séries) :

• Pour la partie « service » : assurer le démontage, l’expertise et le remontage de pompes hydrauliques, quelque soit la marque (Sulzer et concurrence).

• Pour la partie « produits neufs » : assurer le montage et l’assemblage des pompes à partir des informations transmises par le management d’atelier et la gestion de production.

Le monteur mécanicien intervient sur tout type de pompe et sur des marchés exigeants (notamment le nucléaire).

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :

• Démonter, expertiser et monter les équipements mécaniques (pompes), à l’aide notamment d’instrument de mesure.

• Réaliser l’inventaire des pièces mises à disposition par le client et contrôler leur état de fonctionnement.

• Remettre à disposition, les pièces de rechange non consommées auprès de l’expédition.

• S’assurer de la bonne gestion des outillages, de leur rangement et de leur maintien en bon état.

• Assurer un niveau de propreté irréprochable sur son espace de travail. Informer immédiatement sa hiérarchie toute situation potentiellement préjudiciable à la qualité, la sécurité, l’hygiène et l’environnement.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin :

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences de base en montage mécanique

• Compétences en lecture de plans

• Compétences en utilisation des instruments de mesure pour expertiser la pompe en atelier (savoir relever les côtes).

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Culture sûreté

• Prendre le réflexe de regarder le dossier de référence de la machine sur matériel IPS

• Habilitations SCN2, HN2 et CS

Vous serez basé en Ile-de-France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay.
Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre!

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Chef d'Equipe
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un/une Chef d'Equipe pour rejoindre notre équipe.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :

• Superviser une équipe de technicien service (1 à 3 personnes) pour l’installation des pompes & la maintenance des pompes & turbines sur site client, dans l’ensemble des marchés servis par l’entreprise, notamment dans le domaine du nucléaire

• Assurer l’installation des pompes & la maintenance des pompes & turbines sur site client, dans l’ensemble des marchés servis par l’entreprise, notamment dans le domaine du nucléaire (mission du technicien service)

• Reporte hiérarchiquement au responsable de l’activité service (Field service manager)

• Reporte fonctionnellement au chef de chantier

• Collabore en équipe avec les fonctions qualité, HSE, Bureau d’Etudes (BE) et toutes les équipes intervenant en support de l’activité service (méthodes etc.)

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin :
Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en mécanique sur machines tournantes (pompes, turbines, compresseurs)

• Compétences en métrologie: utilisation des instruments de mesure et savoir relever les côtes.

• Compétences en lecture de plans

• Connaissances de base Word et Excel

• Compétences rédactionnelles (pour la réalisation des rapports SDIN + rapport Sulzer).

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Connaissance des règles de sureté nucléaire (formation SCN « Savoir Commun du nucléaire » niveau 2 & formation CSQ « Complément Sûreté Qualité »)

• Compétences en radioprotection (formation RP2 « Radioprotection » niveau 2)

• Entrainement à la réalisation des opérations faites sur site clients nucléaires et respect des modes opératoires propres au nucléaire - atelier maquette

Compétences managériales / encadrement d’équipe

• Compétences en management fonctionnel / transversal d’une équipe d’intervention sur site

• Compétences en tutorat / accompagnement des nouveaux embauches /primo-intervenants / techniciens de service dans le développement de leurs compétences

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

jobs.title: Responsable Atelier Service
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un/une Responsable atelier Service pour rejoindre notre équipe.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :

Management de l’atelier du site de Buchelay.

• Ordonnancement de la charge et des priorités de l’atelier au quotidien suivant les informations communiquées par le service planning.

• Affecter les monteurs mécaniciens sur les différentes missions en fonction de leurs compétences et des besoins de production.

• Définir les besoins en matière de compétences et développer la polyvalence de son équipe (formation, suivi du tableau de polyvalence…).

• Organiser la communication et l’information au sein de son équipe (réunions, suivi des indicateurs, remontée d’infos…).

• Rechercher et développer les sources de motivation de son personnel, être à l’écoute et entretenir un bon climat social.

Démonter, expertiser, régler, monter des équipements (tout type de machine tournante)

S’assurer de l’appropriation et du respect par son équipe des règles en matière d’hygiène, sécurité et environnement.

Partager les succès comme les problématiques techniques avec les autres centres de services.

Participation aux réunions de revue de production (pièces de rechange et services) en présence de la qualité, des chefs de projets et du management.

Apporter une expertise technique opérationnelle auprès de l’ensemble des équipes Sulzer en France et de toute la production (support technique à la production et sur site le cas échéant).

Assurer les visites externes (clients, fournisseurs).

Vérifier que la partie documentaire (Dossier de suivi d’intervention, respect des règles du dossier de référence notamment) est conforme aux exigences du marché nucléaire et aux règles internes de l’entreprise. Veiller au strict respect de ces règles par son équipe.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin :

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)

• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)

• Compétences financières opérationnelles (suivi des budgets, respect des temps « gammes », commandes du matériel)

• Connaissances des règles HSE applicables au sein d’un atelier

• Expérience de travail dans SAP : réalisation des fiches de non-conformité, recherche d’informations pour l’ordonnancement de la charge, montage pompe, turbine, compresseur & moteur, validation factures, demandes d’achats)

• Anglais de base

• Connaissances Word, excel (niveau de base)

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Culture sûreté

• Connaissances / dossiers de références machines (nucléaire)

• HN3 et SCN2, CSQ

• Procédures qualités nucléaire
Compétences managériales / encadrement d’équipe

• Management direct d’équipe : maîtrise des principes de management (recrutement, organisation d'activité, suivi de son équipe par objectifs, communiquer des messages clairs et factuels auprès de son équipe (autant sur le versant de la reconnaissance que le recadrage quand c’est nécessaire, pouvant aller jusqu’au disciplinaire)

• Mettre en place le développement des compétences de son équipe

• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de son management

• Maîtrise des outils d'évaluation de performance et de suivi de carrière (site, groupe, légaux)
• Conduite de l’entretien annuel d’évaluation

• Conduite de l’entretien professionnel

Vous serez basé en Ile-de-France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay.
Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre!

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buch

jobs.title: Technicien stand d'essai
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un/une Technicien(ne) Stand d’Essai pour rejoindre notre équipe.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :
1. Procéder au montage des équipements mécaniques conformément aux plans établis et aux procédures applicables au sein de la plateforme d’essai.
2. Installer l’instrumentation nécessaire pour les essais.
3. Raccorder les circuits de puissance électrique simple.
4. S’assurer de la disponibilité du banc d’essai entre chaque essai.
5. Procéder au 1er niveau de maintenance des équipements du stand.
6. Travaux ponctuels à réaliser en espace confiné (Fosses, Ballons)
7. Travaux en hauteur occasionnels
8. Conduite de chariot élévateur et pontier/élingueur (CACES 3,4,5)
9. Travaux par point chaud (frettage/défrettage)
10. Manipulation de produits chimique (N1)

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin :

Le technicien doit pouvoir travailler en autonomie avec des tierces personnes affectées de façon occasionnel au stand d’essais.
Le technicien doit être force de proposition afin de garantir la qualité des essais
Afin de garantir une présence pendant les essais, il est demandé au technicien d’essai une flexibilité sur les horaires de travail dans le respect du cadre législatif hebdomadaire.

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en Machines tournantes (Pompes, Turbines, compresseurs) : pratique opérationnelle sur site (après une expérience en maintenance, mise en service, réparation)

• Compétences métrologie (utilisation des instruments de mesure)

• Compétences financières opérationnelles (suivi des budgets, respect des temps « gammes », commandes du matériel)

• Connaissances des règles HSE applicables au sein d’un atelier

• Expérience de travail dans SAP : réalisation des fiches de non-conformité, recherche d’informations pour l’ordonnancement de la charge, montage pompe, turbine, compresseur & moteur, validation factures, demandes d’achats)

• Anglais de base

• Connaissances Word, excel (niveau de base)

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Culture sûreté

Vous serez basé en Ile de France, dans les Yvelines, à Buchelay.

Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO (rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com) et nous serons heureux de vous répondre!

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation – RTT

• Et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Motor Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Design Engineering Lead is responsible for the design, construction, and maintenance of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, equipment testing, and maintenance procedures. The role may also involve recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. 设置该岗位的目的:

Purpose of the Job:
-

主要任务与职责:
- 负责高速永磁电机和潜水异步电机的本地化开发与优化，包括结构强度设计、参数计算与性能分析。
- 参与本地化电机相关技术方案的指定与评审，确保设计方案的可行性和先进性
- 负责电机样机的试制、测试及问题分析，提出改进措施并优化产品性能
- 协助解决电机生产过程中出现的技术问题，提供技术支持和改进指导
- 跟踪行业技术发展趋势，参与新技术、新工艺的研究与应用
- 编写相关技术文档，包括设计说明书、测试报告及专利申请

Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Responsible for the localization development and optimization of high-speed permanent magnet motors and submersible asynchronous motors, including structural strength design, parameter calculation, and performance analysis.
- Participate in the specification and review of technical solutions related to localized motors, ensuring the feasibility and advancement of design plans.
- Responsible for prototyping, testing, and problem analysis of motors, proposing improvements, and optimizing product performance.
- Assist in resolving technical issues during motor production, providing technical support and guidance for improvement.
- Track industry technology development trends and participate in the research and application of new technologies and processes.
- Prepare related technical documents, including design specifications, test reports, and patent applications.

职位要求：
· 具备扎实电机理论和控制理论基础，熟悉电磁分析软件、机械设计软件和相关标准
· 熟悉电机设计和制造工艺
· 熟悉永磁同步电机、异步电机等常用电机的工作原理
· 具备较好的语言表达、沟通协调、团队协助能力，具备敬业精神及良好的职业道德
· 电子电气相关专业本科及以上学历，3年以上电机设计或制造、控制相关工作经验；
· 展示在满足客户需求方面的响应能力和及时性；
· 有效平衡多项优先事项和相互竞争的需求；
· 保护机密信息；
· 以高度诚信行事；
· 需要具备英语口语和书写能力。

Qualifications:

· Solid foundation in motor theory and control theory, familiar with electromagnetic analysis software, mechanical design software, and relevant standards.
· Familiar with motor design and manufacturing processes.
· Familiar with the working principles of commonly used motors such as permanent magnet synchronous motors and asynchronous motors.
· Good verbal communication, coordination, and teamwork skills, with a professional attitude and strong work ethics.
· Bachelor's degree or higher in electronics or electrical engineering, with more than 3 years of experience in motor design, manufacturing, or control-related work.
· Demonstrate responsiveness and promptness in serving customer needs;
· Balance many priorities and competing demands effectively;
· Protect confidential information;
· Act with a high level of integrity;
· English language ability, oral and writing are required.

What we offer you

• 10~15 days’ annual leave and 5 days’ sick leave

• Long Service Award

• Annual Physical Examination

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance

• Team Building

• Festival Gifts

• Good working atmosphere and personal development opportunity

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer has a long, proud history of engineering excellence and we’re now expanding our reach even further. We’re looking for an experienced Large Machine Specialist to help shape the next chapter of our international growth.

If you're driven by complex technical challenges, thrive in front of customers, and want to influence major industrial projects across global markets, this could be your ideal move.
What You’ll Do

• Drive order intake by supporting our regional sales teams and turning high‑value opportunities into delivered projects.

• Act as the technical authority on large machines (690V and above), advising customers and internal teams alike.

• Visit key accounts across the UK and overseas, strengthening relationships and positioning Sulzer as the supplier of choice.

• Co‑develop account strategies, opportunity pipelines, and tailored solutions alongside Sales and Key Account Managers.

• Provide expert input into RFI/RFP proposals, ensuring we offer the most robust and commercially sound solutions.

• Keep the pipeline flowing through Salesforce, ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and project visibility.

• Build strong networks with engineering, purchasing, and project stakeholders — from first conversation to successful delivery.

This is a role where your know‑how genuinely makes the difference

What You Bring

We’re looking for someone who can combine technical expertise with commercial instinct:

• Proven experience working with large motors or rotating equipment.

• A track record of developing opportunities into successful orders.

• Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder‑management skills.

• Confidence in customer‑facing situations and a talent for building trust.

• Solid understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce experience is a bonus).

• A flexible, self‑driven approach and the willingness to travel internationally.

Why This Role Matters

Large machines are a cornerstone of our service offering — and the demand is expanding beyond UK borders. This role gives you the platform to:

• Directly shape Sulzer’s international growth.

• Strengthen customer relationships in new global markets.

• Bring new ideas, technical solutions, and account strategies to life.

• Play a vital part in the continued development of a high‑value service line.

You'll be stepping into a well‑established capability, with the opportunity to take it further than ever before.

What we offer you

• Highly autonomous, home‑based role with full ownership of your schedule and the freedom to manage your own diary.

• Competitive base salary with an annual performance‑related bonus (including accelerators).

• Choice of a company car or car allowance.

• Aviva Private Medical Insurance (individual cover) plus a comprehensive benefits package.

• Global travel and the opportunity to work on major, high‑profile industrial projects.

• Significant autonomy, technical influence, and real visibility within the organisation.

• Join a supportive, expert team within a globally recognised engineering leader.

• Strong prospects for career progression, with a role that carries long‑term importance and strategic impact.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Performs and safely operates vehicles as required. This includes pick up the customers equipment for repair and safely transporting the equipment to the Service Center and then back to the customer. This includes the knowledge of properly securing the load as required by regulation and safely operating large flatbed vehicles amongst the public. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities:
Performs and safely operates vehicles as required. This includes pick up the customers equipment for repair and safely transporting the equipment to the Service Center and then back to the customer. This includes the knowledge of properly securing the load as required by regulation and safely operating large flatbed vehicles amongst the public. Drivers will be expected to be able to be properly licensed, medically capable and have the knowledge to operate the class of vehicle they will be assigned to drive. The Truck Driver will also support other duties which includes transferring parts from one area to another, cleaning machines and trucks, and other duties as outlined by the Operation Leader to support all and any jobs contracted by Sulzer EMS.

Requirements:
Must be licensed for the type of vehicle to be driven. Must be able to pass a DOT Physical if operating any vehicle over 10,001 pounds GVWR Interstate. Must be able to read and understand the English language. Physical and mental abilities to learn and perform job functions properly and in a timely manner, especially functions affecting the safety of anyone on site.

Basic understanding of warehouse operations.

Physical ability to lift and move items.

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assemble and test products according to specifications.
Inspect finished goods for defects and report issues.
Maintain and clean production equipment.
Follow safety and quality standards.
Document production activities and test results.
Assist in troubleshooting and basic maintenance.
Collaborate with team members to meet production goals.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic mechanical and technical skills.
Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Familiarity with safety and quality procedures.
Willingness to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment.

What we offer you

• Annual leave: 21 Working days

• Public holidays: National Day + Eid Al Fitr + Eid Al Adha

• Sick leave: up to 4 months as per labor law

• Maternity leave: 10 weeks

• Paternity leave: 3 days

• GOSI contributions (Saudi employees)

• End of Service Benefit (EOSB)

• Health insurance (mandatory by law)

• Iqama and work visa sponsorship (for expatriates)

• Overtime rules as per labor law

• Housing or transportation allowances 35%

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing instrumentation, electrical, and general components required for pump manufacturing. The role ensures timely material availability, cost competitiveness, and compliance with technical and quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and select qualified suppliers for instrumentation, electrical, general components and Class C materials, negotiating contracts and pricing.

• Review and assess technical specifications to ensure compliance with project /department’s needs.

• Manage procurement budgets, monitor costs, and implement cost-saving strategies for electrical items and general components.

• Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers and project teams to ensure timely delivery and avoid project delays.

• Ensure all products meet Sulzer quality standards and regulatory requirements.

• Identify procurement risks, maintain documentation, and implement mitigation strategies for supply chain issues.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor: Electrical Engineer, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field. Certifications: CIPS & CPSM preferred.

• Minimum 3 years’ experience in procuring high‑volume materials for large‑scale projects.
procuring high‑volume materials for large‑scale projects.

• Languages: Arabic & English.

• Soft skills: SAP, MS (Outlook, Excel, Word) Power BI.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, negotiation skills and Knowledge of procurement best practices and industry trends.

• Annual vacation of 21 working days.

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.
