jobs.title: Field Service Techniker im Außendienst (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Field Service Techniker (m/w/d) sind Sie ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Außendienst und sorgen für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung. Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Serviceeinsätze, Wartungen und Inbetriebnahmen direkt vor Ort und tragen maßgeblich zur hohen Servicequalität unseres Unternehmens bei. Freuen Sie sich auf eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel technischer Verantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsmitteln. Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen, kostenbewussten und kundenorientierten Serviceablaufs

• Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen an Anlagen zur Aufbereitung von Wasser und Abwasser

• Austausch von Ersatz- und Verschleißteilen sowie Durchführung von Reparaturen, Sanierungen und Wartungsarbeiten direkt beim Kunden vor Ort

• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen

• Durchführung von Werkstatt- und Montagearbeiten

• Auf- und Abbau sowie Inbetriebnahme unserer Versuchsanlagen

• Erstellung von Analyseberichten sowie ausführlichen technischen Basisberichten

• Betreuung unserer Kunden inklusive Durchführung von Kundenschulungen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Instandhaltung, Wassertechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Kenntnisse im E- und WIG-Schweißen von Vorteil

• Führerschein der Klasse B (ehemals Klasse 3)

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft im Rahmen der Außendiensttätigkeit

• Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und kostenbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit sowie Flexibilität

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Argumentationsstärke

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse wünschenswert

• Grundkenntnisse in MS Word und Excel sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Salesforce von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Eine sichere Position in einem modernen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

• Ein angenehmes und kollegiales Betriebsklima

• Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben

• Attraktive Sozialleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Direktversicherungen

• Firmenfahrzeug (Werkstattwagen), Firmenhandy und Firmennotebook

• Einsatzmöglichkeit direkt vom Wohnort aus

• Vielfältige Weiter- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Assistente de Montagem
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Principais Responsabilidades

• Auxiliar na montagem e desmontagem de bombas e outros equipamentos rotativos;

• Apoiar mecânicos e técnicos em rotinas de oficina;

• Realizar a limpeza, inspeção visual e organização das peças durante o processo de reparo;

• Participar de sessões de treinamento e desenvolver habilidades técnicas na área.

Habilidades Necessárias

• Técnico Completo em Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Manutenção Industrial ou afins;

• Conhecimento básico de montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos mecânicos;

• Conhecimento em leitura de desenhos técnicos será considerado diferencial;

• Conhecimento com ferramentas mecânicas e rotinas de oficina.

What we offer you

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
Previdência privada
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

jobs.title: Technical Field Advisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Technical Field Advisor.This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. In this role you will be accountable for:

• Providing mechanical on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI.

• Ensuring accurate installation, trouble shooting, maintenance and diagnostics of gas turbines and other rotating equipment according to Sulzer specifications

• Managing site activities like planning, integration and monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope

• Supervising contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during gas turbine overhauls

• Ensuring all field activities are carried out safely complying with Sulzer’s QESH guidelines and procedures

• Reporting of all required job documentation (protocols, inspection reports, as –built drawings, work instructions, daily progress, defects and non-conformity etc.) properly and timely

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A vocational degree as a Technician

• 10 + years hands-on gas turbine experience and proven track record of executing overhaul projects

• Very good English language skills

• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

What we offer you

• A more than competitive salary

• A generous number of holidays (40)

• A solid pension scheme

• Training opportunities

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Assistant is responsible for supporting project teams by performing administrative and coordination tasks, including updating schedules, tracking resources, and assisting with documentation.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Field Service Coordinator .

In this role you will be accountable for:
• Preparing, coordinating and supporting execution of Field Service activities in collaboration with project team
• Analyzing requests from both internal and external stakeholders/customers
• Updating the manpower plan/project information for the Field Service projects in ERP and tracking costs during the projects
• Generating purchase requisitions for the Field Service projects
• Consulting with subcontractors and suppliers with regard to project preparation, delivery times and consumables procurement
• Managing and maintaining inventory of Field Service tool containers & special tools
• Organizing all travel related topics for the Field Service team
• Carrying out cost calculations and close out costings within the scope of concluded agreements
To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A vocational degree as a Technician
• 5 + years of experience in the field of rotating equipment
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude

jobs.title: Logistiek medewerker (BBL opleiding)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Kom werken bij het Sulzer Turbo Services, onderdeel van Sulzer Services, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde onafhankelijke aanbieders van reparatie, revisie en onderhoud binnen de turbine-industrie. Vanuit Venlo (Lomm) of op locatie, bieden wij onze klanten wereldwijd solide, klantgerichte en flexibele ondersteuning voor hun compressoren, stoom- en gasturbines. Sluit je aan bij onze trotse en hoogopgeleide internationale crew als Logistiek medewerker (BBL opleiding). Vind je het leuk om te werken en leren binnen een internationaal opererend bedrijf waar alle facetten van logistiek aanbod komen, zoals warehousing, import en export werkzaamheden, dan ben je bij ons op de juiste plaats.

Door mee te werken in de operatie leer je als logistiek medewerker alle facetten van het logistieke proces kennen. Door vanuit de verschillende werkzaamheden (opslag, import en export) mee te werken, krijg je een compleet beeld van de gehele logistieke keten. Je werkt 4 dagen per week op onze locatie in Lomm en 1 dag per week ga je naar school.

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Het in ontvangst nemen van goederen, het laden en lossen van toegeleverde goederen, het uitpakken, sorteren en labelen van goederen
• Het verwerken van binnenkomsten, uitgiftes en terugboekingen van goederen in het systeem
• Het opbergen van goederen in stellingen in diversen magazijnen
• Het voorbereiden en gereedmaken voor verzending van goederen
• Het graveren van onderdelen met behulp van een automatische graveermachine
• Het vervoeren van goederen van en naar in- en uitplaatsen met behulp van de aanwezige transportmiddelen op een zo efficiënt mogelijke wijze (intern transport)
• Het uitgeven van goederen aan de hand van werkopdrachten, uitgifte- en materiaalbonnen

Om in deze functie te slagen, moet je:
• Een proactieve houding hebben en leergierig zijn
• Teamplayer zijn die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische wereld en graag het werk van een logistiek medewerker wilt leren
• Flexibel zijn en open houding hebben
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands hebben
• Het leuk vinden om te leren werken binnen een internationaal opererend bedrijf

What we offer you

Lid zijn van een compacte lokale logistiek team binnen een multinationale matrixorganisatie
• Flexibele werktijden
• Opleidingsmogelijkheden
• Bedrijfsrestaurant op de vestiging met lekkere en gezonde opties

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Engineering position is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Recruiting for a Mechanical or Electrical Engineer (both job descriptions available)

Mechanical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to coordinate between the machine shop, quotation department and the customer. This position is mainly an on-site position but might involve up to 10% field service work. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on tasks along with office responsibilities. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of the on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.

Job requirements
- Preferred 3 years’ experience in rotating equipment repairs
- The preferred experience is in rotating equipment repairs, but acceptable experience includes
o Rotating equipment manufacturing
o Rotating equipment package design and assembly
o Vibration analysis
o Field Service-Overhauls
- Proficient with CAD software: AutoDesk or Solidworks
- Preferred Knowhow of the following topics
o Rolling element bearings, sleeve babbitt bearings
o Oil seals and their functionality
o Vibration spectrums and how to interpret them
o Alignment
- Proficient in the usage of micrometers
- Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred if not it is expected this topic is learnt by the engineer as part of on-the-job training.
Role
- The mechanical engineer will need to bridge the communication to the customers on the mechanical portion of the repair.
- The mechanical engineer will need to be involved on the discovery side of the inspections to assist in developing an accurate workscope.
- Should be proficient in CAD software to document design changes and create drawings to be shared with the customers.
- This role will require the individual to be hands-on and involved in the day-to day operations.
- The role will require performing or confirming precise measurements using micrometers and calipers.
Mandatory Attributes
- The individual must be self-motivated and must be prepared for on-the-job training.
- The individual must take responsibility of their assigned task and finish it in a timely manner.
Qualifications
- Undergraduate/Graduate Degree mechanical engineering or related field

Electrical Engineer Position Summary:
The individual with this position will have to split their time in-between the engineering team objectives, field service, field service reports and shop engineering support. This engineering position will entail a dual role with hands-on-responsibilities along with other engineering tasks. It is expected that the individual will need training as part of on-boarding process and Sulzer will accommodate.
Job Requirements
- Preferred 0 – 4 years’ experience in the following field of electrical engineering.
o Electric motor, generators repairs and design.
o Transformer repair and design
o Switch gear design and diagnostics
o Power Semiconductors
- Proficient in basic power theory,
- Knowhow in the following topics
o Operations of induction motors
o Operations of synchronous motors
o Transformer principle
o Operation of semiconductors.
o Winding Insulation Tests
Role
- The electrical engineer will be responsible to perform on-site field service preventive maintenance and troubleshooting on electromechanical equipment.
- They will also be responsible to provide the reports for the job performed to the customer in a timely m

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Summary
Hands-on technician in the disassembly, inspection, assembly, and testing of gas turbine engines, subassemblies, components, and accessories.

Responsibilities

• Work independently and with team members to disassemble, inspect, conduct minor repairs, assemble, and modify gas turbine engines, turbines, accessories, and support systems.

• Read and interpret work instructions and inspection manuals to determine material compliance. Record findings in project logs and submit to next department.

• Use calibrated measuring equipment such as calipers, micrometers, etc.

• Adhere to detailed work instructions and procedures assigned by the supervisor and monitored by a quality inspector.

• Acquire personal tools and hardware to perform the work. Specialized tools provided by Sulzer.

• Operate instrumentation to perform pressure and flow tests.

• Review all phases of tasks, as specified by work instructions, perform self-inspection or peer inspection of critical processes ensuring adherence to quality standards.

• Inspect, operate, and maintain shop equipment, facilities, and support systems.

• Package engines for shipment to the customer.

• Complete any other tasks within the company to support objectives and to develop individual skills.

• Foster a positive working environment and relationships with colleagues.

• Perform all tasks at the highest level of safety awareness.

• Properly utilize provided PPE at all times.

• Properly utilize lifting and rigging fixtures and tooling.

• Occasional travel may be required. 1-2 weeks a year in variable weather conditions.

• Able to work in high noise level conditions utilizing proper PPE.

• Able to lift 60lbs.

• Able to maintain certification to operate powered industrial vehicles (forklifts, etc.).

This is a 1st shift hourly position; 7:30–4:00 with expectation to work significant overtime.

Requirements

• High School Diploma or GED

• Up to 3 months of hands-on jet engine or diesel mechanic experience

Preferred Qualifications

• 1+ year experience in Diesel or Gas Turbine Engine Repair

• Formal training in power plant mechanics and operation

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Outside Sales
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Key Responsibilities:

• Conducts Sales visits to customers in assigned market

• Reviews the customer request for quotation (RFQ’s) to ensure necessary information is available and that the customer’s requirements conform to the company’s capabilities.

• Responsible for representing Sulzer during the commercial portion of the proposal.

• Determines and recommends the pricing to be included in the quotation to the customer, within established guidelines.

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and to participate in project initiation.

• Presents the proposal/quotation to the customer, including equipment description and specification, pricing, and delivery schedule, and reviews and negotiates necessary revisions with the customer.

• Responds and assists to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance .

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in one of the following engineering disciplines: Chemical / Industrial / Process / Physics

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role is responsible for conducting bench‑scale and pilot testing to advance the company’s separation process technologies. You will apply advanced chemical engineering principles to innovate, optimize, and scale separation processes within the Test Center while managing complex projects and collaborating closely with technicians, engineers, sales, and R&D teams.
In this role you will be accountable for:

• Planning and executing customer test activities

• Carrying out internal test projects to support the development and optimization of process technologies

• Supporting modifications, upgrades, and improvements of test units within the test center

• Contributing to the implementation of safety, environmental, and waste‑treatment measures

• Building, maintaining, and expanding the know‑how required for the above responsibilities

• Participating in customer project meetings

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A university degree or equivalent qualification in process or chemical engineering

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in thermal separation technologies (e.g., distillation, evaporation, extraction, crystallization)

• A team‑oriented mindset combined with a hands‑on working style

• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

• A problem‑solving attitude and the capability to develop practical technical solutions

• A customer‑focused approach paired with strong analytical abilities

• Very good proficiency in English and German

What we offer you

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Attractive employment conditions & excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.)

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Cosa offriamo - Une culture innovante, dynamique et agile - Conditions d'emploi attrayantes et prestations sociales excellentes (vacances, fonds de pension, etc.) - Accès à une large gamme de réductions sur le shopping quotidien, le divertissement et le style de vie - Stationnement sur place/indemnité de transport public Contatto Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Field Service & Repair Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Rattaché(e) au head of projects new business, au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, vous serez amené(e) à travailler en atelier et sur sites clients, sur des machines tournantes, dans le secteur industriel.

Sur ce poste, vous serez responsable de:

• Interventions de démontage, expertise et remontage des machines tournantes industrielles standards et spécifiques dans le respect des cahiers des charges

• Réalisation du diagnostic et rédaction des rapports d'expertise

• Réalisation des réparations de pièces et du contrôle des pièces réparées,

• Remontage des machines, réglage/ajustage

• Commissioning / Pre-commissioning / mise en service de machines tournantes

• Réparations sur site

• Respect de la politique de qualité, sécurité et environnement en interne et sur sites clients

• Participation à la mise en place d'actions d'amélioration continue

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous aurez besoin de:

• Formation Bac + 2 en mécanique ou équivalent, vous possédez 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire en envrionnement industriel

• Compétences en lecture de plan et en dessin industriel

• Connaissances en ajustage, montage, pivoterie, étanchéité, contrôle dimensionnel, géométrique et calcul de chaînes de côtes

• Maitrise des outils office 365

• Rigueur, méthodes et polyvalence

Vous avez une question concernant ce poste ?
Contactez Rick IMALET POGO à Rick.Imaletpogo@sulzer.com et nous serons heureux de vous répondre!

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Opportunité de travailler au sein d’une organisation locale de services d’un leader international sur son marché

• Avantage 2 : Des missions variées vous permettant d’avoir un impact réel et de développer vos compétences

• Avantage 3 : Rejoindre un site en pleine croissance et contribuer à son évolution

• Avantage 4 : Un package d’avantages attractifs conformément à notre politique de rémunération locale

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Engineer & Field Auditor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Engineering Lead is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer locations. The role includes diagnosing malfunctions, performing maintenance, and providing on-site training to customer personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
The Service Engineer & Field Auditor is responsible for delivering on-site technical expertise, auditing customer installations, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience throughout the project lifecycle. By combining deep technical knowledge with a proactive and consultative approach, this role supports Sulzer’s commitment to reliability, performance, and customer satisfaction.

Main tasks and responsibilities :
Provide on-site technical support for commissioning, troubleshooting, failure analysis, and training in the operation and maintenance of Sulzer equipment. Audit customer installations and propose tailored solutions that optimize production, reliability, and efficiency. Translate customer needs into concrete recommendations (e.g., equipment upgrades, spare parts strategies, maintenance optimization, or process improvements). Ensure an optimal customer journey, from pre-sales to final delivery, with proactive, transparent, and passionate engagement at every stage. Proactively engage with customers, anticipate needs, and identify opportunities for value creation. Comply with Sulzer’s quality policies, safety standards, and environmental regulations on both company premises and customer sites. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the company’s processes, services, and team environment. Participate in and actively support company initiatives Initially, to adhere to Sulzer policies: Code of Business Conduct, Authority and Approval Procedures, Risk Management, Travel policies, etc…
HSE Responsibilities :
• Ensure compliance with safety instructions, use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
• Proactive intervention in the event of a dangerous situation.
• Propose improvements in terms of safety.

Competencies and behavior required (What strengths needed?)
Management Competencies: Results driven, Proactive, reliable, and capable of working independently as well as in cross-functional teams.
Leadership Competencies: Exceeding customer expectations, Ensuring accountability and integrity, Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication and interpersonal skills Profile: Mechanical engineer or equivalent technical background
Industrial Competencies : Strong technical expertise in rotating equipment, commissioning, maintenance, and failure analysis. Ability to perform audits, analyze findings, and recommend practical, value-added solutions. Adaptability and problem-solving skills in challenging field environments.

Professional experience:
- Proven experience in field service engineering, technical support, or equipment auditing, ideally in fertilizers, or rotating equipment industries.
- Local experience and local markets knowledge
- Experience in customer-facing roles, with demonstrated ability to manage relationships across different stages of the project lifecycle.
- Knowledge of safety and environmental standards applicable to industrial sites
• Strong technical skills
• Problem-solving and conflict management
• Open for changes, demonstrates willingness to change
• International in thinking and acting
• Autonomous
• General computer sk

jobs.title: Business Owner - Spare Parts
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity for a Spare Parts Business Owner to strengthen our aftermarket operations and accelerate growth across France and international markets. In this pivotal commercial and operational role, you will drive the development of the spare parts portfolio, enhance customer satisfaction, and ensure strong economic and operational performance. If you combine business acumen with solid technical understanding - and enjoy working at the intersection of sales, operations, and product strategy - this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact.

Based at our site in Saint-Quentin

Your main tasks and responsibilities

• Manage the complete spare parts portfolio, including range definition, offer structure, pricing policy, and product life‑cycle decisions.

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for spare parts in alignment with group policy, identify high‑potential business segments in collaboration with service teams.

• Define and implement pricing strategies, discount frameworks, and margin optimization measures, Lead initiatives aimed at improving profitability and competitiveness.

• Operational Coordination (≈50%): Collaborate closely with Logistics, Production, and Purchasing to ensure availability and reliability of spare parts.

• Optimize inventory levels, lead times, order processing, and prioritization, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in forecasting, planning, and sourcing.

• Maintain KPIs and reporting including backlog, overdue backlog, lead time, workload, and warranty performance.

• Act as the central point of contact for domestic and international spare parts customers.

• Prepare monthly dashboards and drive progress plans based on performance insights.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• English level B2.

• Understanding of industrial equipment such as pumps, rotating systems, turbines, or similar mechanical assemblies.

• Knowledge of spare parts characteristics, functions, constraints, compatibility, and substitution options.

• Ability to read and use technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, specifications, supplier references).

• Strong B2B business development experience in an industrial environment.

• Familiarity with spare parts sales processes: costing, quotation, negotiation, contracts, and T&Cs.

• Proficiency in pricing strategies, margin management, and bundled or kit‑based product offerings.

• Understanding of aftermarket service models (maintenance, retrofits, upgrades, parts).

What we offer you

• A key role within a global and innovative industrial organization.

• The opportunity to shape and drive the spare parts business in strategic markets.

• A collaborative environment focused on technical excellence, operational reliability, and customer satisfaction.

• Strong professional development prospects in a company that values initiative, expertise, and cross‑functional teamwork.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Lead - South
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Territory Sales Lead, you will oversee and inspire a regional team of Sales Engineers across the South UK, driving growth and strengthening Sulzer’s presence in key markets. You’ll help deliver innovative solutions for the maintenance, repair, and optimisation of rotating equipment across our full service portfolio. Your Main Responsibilities

• Lead and support a regional team of Sales Engineers in promoting Sulzer’s full portfolio of service solutions for rotating equipment - including inspection, overhaul, repair, upgrades, and replacement parts.

• Lead monthly order intake performance for the South UK region, taking full ownership of targets and consistently delivering in line with business forecasts and commitments.

• Drive growth in Sulzer Services key markets , focusing on electric motors, generators, pumps, turbines, compressors, and other critical rotating machinery used across power generation, water, oil & gas, chemicals, and industrial sectors.

• Pursue new business opportunities, championing Sulzer’s products, technologies, and services , supporting the team in presenting solutions that address complex engineering challenges.

• Champion the use of Salesforce , ensuring all opportunities within the South UK team are accurately logged, maintained, and progressed in accordance with Sulzer’s gate process.

• Collaborate closely with peers across the UK & Nordics region, fostering a strong team ethos and maintaining alignment on goals, strategy, and best practice.

• Represent Sulzer at key industry and customer events , strengthening brand presence, building relationships, and enhancing Sulzer’s reputation within the regional market.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

• Proven experience in technical sales leadership , managing a regional or field-based sales team.

• Strong knowledge of rotating machinery service industry, across pumps, gearboxes, compressors, motors, generators etc

• Excellent communication, coaching, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate technical concepts to all stakeholders.

• A proactive, results-oriented mindset with the ability to drive team performance and cultivate new opportunities.

• A strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate insights into action.

• A Full UK Driving Licence and willingness to travel extensively within the territory.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Enjoy 33 days of holiday, including service days.

• A defined bonus scheme based on company and personal performance.

• Prioritise your well-being with confidential support and guidance through our Employee assistance programmes

• Access a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle. Eligible employees can also apply for a Costco membership for additional exclusive offers.

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways focused on your professional development

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Chef de Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Engineer is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes coaching junior professionals and solving complex problems through investigation and analysis.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
Votre mission principale :

• Incarner le lien et piloter les interlocuteurs internes et externes en vue de la livraison du contrat / projet sur les activités pièces de rechange / retrofit / projets neufs.

• Mener le projet à son terme en satisfaisant le client (coût, qualité et délai) et en optimisant le résultat financier pour Sulzer (revenu, marge et cash).

Le chef de projet confirmé intervient sur les projets à forts enjeux et complexes dans l’entreprise

Activités significatives

• Organiser et superviser les réunions de revue de contrat (handover), d'enclenchement et de suivi en interne (KOM), en intégrant et pilotant l’ensemble des compétences transversales nécessaires à l’accomplissement du projet.

• Procéder, dès les phases initiales et en cours de réalisation, aux analyses de risque des projets, à leurs mises à jour nécessaires ; définir et piloter les plans d’actions correctives et préventives correspondants

• Assurer la communication régulière vers les clients (réunion d’enclenchement, réunion de suivi, reporting…), en maintenant le bon niveau de coopération par un relationnel adapté.

• Créer et maintenir des plannings projets (MS Project), outil principal de pilotage des projets.

• Piloter et coordonner les activités & les équipes en interne, en conformité avec le planning des projets, en assurant notamment la collaboration et les interfaces entre le BE, la Gestion production, les Achats, la Production, la Qualité, la force de vente et le Tendering.

• Créer et maintenir les indicateurs clé (fiabilité des engagements, documentation…) au niveau de chaque projet en charge.

• Obtenir les validations documentaires (technique, qualité, approvisionnement) en lien avec les clients et les fournisseurs.

• Etablir les prévisions de facturation, marge et cash-flow au niveau de chaque projet géré.

• Favoriser la négociation de modification de commande (« change order ») avec le client pour améliorer les conditions contractuelles du contrat initial, le revenu et la marge du projet.

• Documenter le projet sur toute sa durée pour prévenir tout cas de litige.

• Déployer et formaliser le retour d’expérience sur l’activité projet.

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en mécanique (culture technique mécanique), acquises via une formation d’ingénieur et une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement mécanique

• Compétences confirmées en gestion de projet (minimum de 7 années dans le management de projets majeurs dans des environnements techniques exigeants, type nucléaire, Oil & Gas, mécanique de précision à l’international)

• Compétences financières / contrôle de gestion d’un projet : connaissances des indicateurs financiers majeurs

• Management des indicateurs / KPI clés : OTD (Livraison à l’heure) et Gross Profit (marge).

• Compétences en relation client & fournisseur (la capacité à gérer le relationnel fournisseur est fondamental sur le poste)

• Connaissances en planification de projet (Type « MS project »)

• Compétences en ERP (suivi de projet sous ERP, type SAP).

• Anglais courant (Lu, écrit, parlé) Niveau C1

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Évoluer sur des projets stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Gr

jobs.title: Supervisor(a) Técnico de Turbomáquinas
Analista de Aplicação
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

O Analista de Aplicação é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de vendas e realizar análise técnica das configurações dos produtos para determinar preços específicos do cliente.
Este perfil de emprego destina-se a profissionais experientes que aplicam conhecimento prático de uma área de trabalho e trabalham de forma independente com supervisão geral. Principais Responsabilidades:
Responsável por preparar e enviar propostas comerciais de serviços (Sulzer Pumps, bombas não-Sulzer e turbomáquinas) recebidas pela Salesforce e outras entidades legais da Sulzer, garantindo a entrega no prazo;
• Responsável por definir o escopo do trabalho conforme o relatório de inspeção e as especificações técnicas;
• Alinhar o escopo do serviço e o orçamento com os fornecedores;
• Criação da base de custo para a proposta;
• Preparar a proposta e inserir pedidos no SAP.

Habilidades Necessárias:
• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica;
• Experiência no departamento comercial (equipamentos rotativos como bombas, compressores, motores, etc.) atendendo indústrias pesadas;
• Conhecimento técnico em bombas e/ou equipamentos rotativos
• Inglês Intermediário

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Vale alimentação, refeição no local e transporte público/fretado
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Previdência privada
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our team as Global Commercial Excellence Manager in our Water & Industry Business Unit and play a key role in driving growth and profitability. In this role, you will work closely with the Global Commercial Excellence team, contributing to global initiatives and strategies while driving pricing and value management, optimizing go-to-market models, and enabling sales teams with tools and insights for consistent execution within the Business Unit.

The role can be based at any of our European Operations

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Collaboration with sales leadership and commercial excellence teams to co-create Go-to-Market strategies in your business unit by driving channel strategy, key account management, business partner enablement, account and territory planning in collaboration with the global commercial excellence team.

• Ensure adoption of the global sales process and methodology within your business unit by promoting best practices, monitoring compliance, and identifying areas for improvement. Take ownership of driving corrective actions and implementing enhancements in collaboration with the global Commercial Excellence teams

• Establish and standardize robust data and analytics frameworks to support consistent pipeline reviews and accurate forecasting across commercial teams. Ensure alignment of tools, metrics, and methodologies to drive visibility, accountability, and strategic decision-making

• Drive Pricing & Value Management by implementing pricing governance, value-based pricing, discount controls, and margin optimization working in tandem with the global commercial excellence team.

• Ensure accurate and structured customer data in CRM systems to enable effective segmentation, precise targeting, and full sales lifecycle management.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Master degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred) and 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, or sales operations.

• Knowledge of Pricing & Value Management, including value-based pricing, discount governance, and margin optimization.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, and account management practices in B2B environments.

• Hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and data-driven forecasting.

• Advanced analytical skills with ability to perform analytics and build actionable insights.

• Excellent stakeholder management and change leadership skills to drive adoption across functions and regions.

What we offer you

• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser abwechslungsreichen Aufgabe unterstützen Sie die Ansprechpartner Ihres Betreuungsbereichs bei der Erreichung unserer strategischen und operativen Ziele durch eine professionelle HR-seitige Unterstützung entlang des kompletten Mitarbeitenden-Lebenszyklus. Im Arbeitsalltag beinhaltet das:

• Sicherstellen einer nachhaltigen Personalbedarfsplanung in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen im Rahmen der Unternehmensstrategie

• Begleitung des zielgerichteten Recruiting von Fach- und Führungskräften inkl. Unterstützung des Onboarding-Prozesses

• enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Führungskräften hinsichtlich verschiedenster personalrelevanter arbeitsrechtlicher sowie tarifvertraglicher Fragen und Themen im Arbeitsalltag

• Beraten und Betreuen der Mitarbeitenden in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen

• Unterstützen der Führungskräfte im Bereich Performance Management

• Professionelles Begleiten von Trennungs- und Offboarding-Prozessen

• Ggf. Durchführen von / Mitwirken bei lokalen / globalen Projekten im Personalbereich

• Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Personalprozessen

• Produktive und professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit sonstigen internen und externen Stakeholdern (insb. Betriebsräte, Gewerkschaften, Bewerber, HR-Community sowie externe Dienstleister)

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:

• Neugier, Offenheit sowie Empathie zum schnellen Aufbau persönlicher Kontakte und professioneller Netzwerke

• Kommunikationsstärke im lokalen sowie globalen Umfeld (fließende Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse werden hierfür benötigt)

• Eigeninitiative und Zielorientierung in der Rolle als eigenständiger Ansprechpartner des Betreuungsbereichs

• Sehr fundiertes HR-relevantes Know-How (Arbeitsrecht, Steuer- / SV-Recht), idealerweise aus dem Industrie- / Service-Umfeld

• Professionelle IT-Kenntnisse (MS-Office, HR-Systeme), sowie IT-Affinität

• Spezialkenntnisse (z.B. weitere Fremdsprachen, Kenntnisse Metalltarifverträge, Workday, SAP) sind ein Plus

• Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen (Umfang noch festzulegen - abhängig vom Betreuungsbereich)

What we offer you

Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und motivierten HR-Teams, welches deutschlandweit mehrere Produktions- und Service-Standorte mit insgesamt ca. 780 Mitarbeitenden betreut. Innerhalb dieser Aufgabe genießen Sie ein hohes Maß an Gestaltungsspielraum und attraktive Rahmenbedingungen.

Haben Sie noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle? Wenden Sie sich per E-Mail an Nina Rufer (nina.rufer@sulzer.com). Wir freuen uns, von Ihnen zu hören!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sostegno a questa variegata attività Siete le persone di contatto della vostra area di supporto per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi strategici e operativi attraverso il supporto professionale HR lungo il ciclo di vita dei dipendenti completo. Nel giorno lavorativo:
• Assicurare la pianificazione della domanda di personale sostenibile in stretto coordinamento con le aree specializzate nel quadro della strategia aziendale
• Accompagnamento del reclutamento mirato di specialisti e dirigenti incl. Supporto del processo di onboarding
• una stretta cooperazione con i dirigenti per quanto riguarda una vasta gamma di leggi sul lavoro e questioni di contrattazione collettiva e argomenti nel lavoro quotidiano
• consulenza e gestione dei dipendenti in tutte le questioni personali
• Sostenere i dirigenti nella gestione delle prestazioni
• Monitoraggio professionale dei processi di separazione e di fuoribordo
• Totale implementazione / partecipazione a progetti di personale locale / globale
• Cooperazione attiva nell'ulteriore sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei processi personali
• Cooperazione produttiva e professionale con altri stakeholder interni ed esterni (compresi i consigli di lavoro, i sindacati, i candidati, la comunità HR e i fornitori di servizi esterni) Per avere successo in questo luogo, si dovrebbe portare:
• Curiosità, apertura ed empatia per costruire rapidamente contatti personali e reti professionali
• La forza di comunicazione nell'ambiente locale e globale (per questo sono necessarie competenze in tedesco e inglese)
• Iniziativa individuale e orientamento obiettivo nel ruolo delle persone di contatto indipendenti nel campo della cura
• Molto ben fondato HR-relevant know-how (legge sul lavoro, imposta / diritto SV), idealmente dall'ambiente industriale / servizio
• Competenze IT professionali (MS office, sistemi HR) e affinità IT
• Conoscenza speciale (ad esempio altre lingue straniere, conoscenza degli accordi metallici, Workday, SAP) sono un plus
• la volontà di viaggiare ai servizi (creazione ancora da definire - a seconda dell'area di cura) Cosa ti offriamo A Sulzer, si diventa parte di un team HR dedicato e motivato, che ha diverse sedi di produzione e servizio in tutta la Germania con un totale di circa 780 dipendenti. • Coopération productive et professionnelle avec d'autres parties prenantes internes et externes (y compris les comités d'entreprise, les syndicats, les demandeurs, la communauté des RH et les prestataires de services externes) Pour réussir à ce stade, vous devez apporter les éléments suivants:
• Curiosité, ouverture et empathie pour l'établissement rapide de contacts personnels et de réseaux professionnels
• Force de communication dans l'environnement local et mondial (les compétences linguistiques en allemand et en anglais sont nécessaires pour cela)
• L'initiative propre et l'orientation cible dans le rôle de personne de contact indépendante dans le domaine des soins
• Savoir-faire très bien fondé en matière de ressources humaines (droit du travail, droit fiscal / droit SV), idéalement de l'environnement industriel / service
• Compétences en TI professionnelles (bureau SM, systèmes RH), ainsi que l'affinité informatique

jobs.title: FP&A Controller - D365
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic FP&A Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international stakeholders, leverage your expertise in finance analytics, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you!

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial goals.

• Periodically refresh and update predictive financial forecasts to reflect the latest business trends and market conditions.

• Conduct thorough profitability and performance reporting, identifying key financial metrics.

• Perform detailed plan analytics and risk assessments, continuously improving financial planning and analysis processes.

• Provide recommendations to the business based on in-depth financial analysis, supporting strategic decision-making.

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making processes.

• Deliver comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions.

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity.

• Handle period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects.

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting.

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and maintain strong internal controls for the processes performed by this role.

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations, maintaining the highest standards of financial compliance.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or similar finance roles; exposure or interest in the industrial sector is a plus.

• Strong skills in financial modelling, forecasting, and data analytics, with a solid understanding of global finance processes and standards; proficiency in Tagetik, Qlik, and/or integrated ERP systems is advantageous. Nice to have experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to deliver key insights to leadership, collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to drive structured solutions, and comfortable working with a level of independence.

• Fluency in English

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives

• Restaurant Tickets

• Permanent contract

• Accident insurance

• Central workplace in Nuevos Ministerios

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Votre mission ? Assurer le développement des parts de marché et, par extension, du chiffre d’affaires en tenant compte des objectifs commerciaux définis et des instructions de travail en vigueur.

Pour ce faire, vous devrez:

• Etablir et déployer un plan d’actions commerciales dans le cadre de la stratégie d’entreprise et des objectifs commerciaux qui lui sont impartis.

• Fidéliser son portefeuille Clients.

• Prospecter de nouveaux marchés ou nouveaux Clients.

• Assurer la promotion des gammes de produits en détectant et en analysant les besoins des Clients et Prospects afin de leur proposer des solutions techniques appropriées.

• Communiquer de manière active avec les clients afin d’établir une relation de confiance et développer l’activité.

• Concevoir les études de faisabilité technique avec l’équipe des commerciaux sédentaires.

• Etablir et suivre les offres commerciales établies.

• Effectuer les relances appropriées.

• Négocier et rédiger les contrats en s’assurant des conditions de réalisation des commandes (prix, délais…).

• Suivre la réalisation des prestations techniques.

• Analyser les résultats des ventes.

What we offer you

Envie de mettre votre expertise au service de projets qui comptent vraiment ?

Nous recherchons un Sales Engineer, pour le business Water.

Au cœur de nos opérations, vous jouerez un rôle clé : analyser, sécuriser, optimiser et garantir un niveau d’excellence à toutes les étapes.
Vous serez force de proposition sur des solutions innovantes, travaillerez au plus près du terrain et collaborerez avec des équipes passionnées, prêtes à relever les défis techniques et réglementaires de demain.

Chez nous, vous trouverez :

• un environnement où votre expertise est valorisée

• une mission porteuse de sens et d’impact concret

• un terrain d’innovation permanent

• de vraies opportunités d’évolution dans un groupe en mouvement

Si vous avez envie de progresser, d’apporter votre vision et de faire bouger les lignes, alors rejoignez-nous !

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Helper Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen
and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

What we offer you

USA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Assistente Entrada de Pedidos
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Order Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the order processing function by handling routine tasks, updating systems, and communicating with internal teams. This role follows standard procedures and makes smaller decisions autonomously.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Process routine customer orders and update systems.
Track delivery schedules and report delays.
Communicate with internal teams to resolve basic issues.
Maintain accurate records of order transactions.
Support reporting and documentation tasks.
Assist in customer service inquiries related to orders.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic understanding of order processing systems.
Good communication and organizational skills.
Attention to detail and ability to follow procedures.
Customer-focused mindset.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

What we offer you

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
Previdência privada
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist/Process Co-ordinator P2P
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee weekly and monthly invoice processing and vendor payments

• Process end-to-end payroll with weekly and monthly cycles. Circa 200 employees

• Oversea Concur application to ensure timely and accurate submission of expense claims

• Drive a culture of accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement in both AP and Payroll

• Ensure compliance with relevant Awards, EBAs, superannuation, taxation and Fair Work obligations

• Ensure strong financial controls and compliance

• Lead system enhancements and process optimisation initiatives

Skills and Experience

• Demonstrated experience 5+ years in both AP and Payroll functions

• High accuracy and attention to detail

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Confident IT capability, especially Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Definitiv Payroll

• Strong analytical, organisational and problem‑solving skills

• Process‑driven mindset with a focus on improvement

What we offer you

• Competitive Salary

• Annual Bonus

• On-site Parking

• High performing team environment

• Work for a global company with over 190 years of excellence

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef de Projet dynamique et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Le/la Chef de Projet sera responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et de la clôture réussie de projets variés, en veillant à l'atteinte des objectifs dans le respect des délais et du budget.

Responsabilités:

• Définir les objectifs du projet, le périmètre, les livrables et les critères de réussite en collaboration avec les parties prenantes.

• Élaborer des plans de projet détaillés, y compris les échéanciers, les budgets et l'allocation des ressources.

• Gérer les équipes de projet, attribuer les tâches et superviser leur progression.

• Identifier et gérer les risques et les problèmes du projet, en élaborant des plans d'atténuation.

• Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes sur l'état d'avancement du projet.

• Assurer le respect des normes de qualité et des procédures internes de Sulzer Maroc S.A.R.L. A.U.

• Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Évaluer les performances du projet et documenter les leçons apprises.

• Préparer et présenter des rapports d'avancement et des revues de projet.

Qualifications

• Diplôme universitaire (Bac+5 minimum) en Ingénierie, Gestion de projet ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience avérée (minimum 5 ans) en gestion de projet, idéalement dans un environnement industriel ou technique.

• Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2 ou certification équivalente un atout).

• Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle, orale et écrite, en français et en anglais.

• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe, à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément et à respecter les délais.

• Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet (ex: MS Project, Asana, Jira).

• Fortes compétences en leadership, résolution de problèmes et prise de décision.

• Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et souci du détail.

• Capacité à s'adapter à un environnement de travail dynamique et à gérer le changement.

Intéressé(e) ? Veuillez nous envoyer votre candidature, comprenant un CV complet et une courte lettre de motivation, via l’outil en ligne.
Vous avez une question concernant le poste ? Contactez Rick IMALET POGO ( rick.imaletpogo@sulzer.com ). Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature !

What we offer you

• Vos avantages : Sulzer offre un bon ensemble d’avantages conformément à la politique de rémunération locale

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients. This role ensures that client needs are met, identifies new business opportunities, and coordinates with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that drive long-term value.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic clients.
Develop and maintain long-term relationships with key accounts.
Understand client needs and align solutions accordingly.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure service delivery.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Monitor account performance and satisfaction.
Prepare and present account reviews and growth plans.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 8-10 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Strong relationship management and negotiation skills.
Experience in B2B account management.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in CRM tools and data analysis.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager MTCS - Nigeria
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS) division delivers advanced solutions that support refineries, petrochemical plants, renewables, bio‑based industries, and oil & gas operators worldwide. We are expanding our footprint in West Africa—and we’re looking for a technically driven, commercially sharp Regional Sales Manager to help us grow.
As the Regional Sales Manager – MTCS, you will be the face of Sulzer Chemtech for customers across Nigeria and West Africa. This role blends technical expertise with strong business acumen. You’ll engage directly with engineering, operations, procurement, and leadership teams to understand process challenges, propose tailored solutions, and drive profitable long‑term partnerships.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a high‑impact region, shape market strategy, and work closely with global experts in mass transfer and separation technology.

Key Responsibilities

Customer & Market Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.

• Conduct regular site visits and technical discussions to understand operational challenges.

• Position Sulzer Chemtech as a trusted technical advisor in the region.

Business Development

• Identify and develop new opportunities across refineries, petrochemical plants, gas processing facilities, and bio‑based industries.

• Grow the sales pipeline and deliver sustainable business results.

Technical & Commercial Activities

• Evaluate inquiries, analyse process data, and develop cost‑effective technical solutions.

• Prepare accurate proposals, cost estimations, and techno‑commercial presentations.

• Manage the full tendering process including clarifications, negotiations, and contract finalisation.

What You’ll Bring

Education

• A degree in Chemical Engineering or related Process Engineering field (beneficial).

Experience

• Operational plants: process engineering, revamp projects, operations support in refineries, petrochemicals, gas processing, or chemical/biobased plants.

• Technology/service providers or EPCs: technical sales, proposal engineering, or project development.

• A blended background across both plant operations and technology providers is highly valued.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of separation technologies, mass transfer equipment, and mixing technologies.

• Ability to interpret PFDs, P&IDs, and process data to deliver optimised solutions.

• Experience preparing tenders, proposals, and engaging in CAPEX project development.

Soft Skills & Competencies

• Strong communication and relationship‑building abilities.

• Commercial awareness and negotiation skills.

• High level of organisation, independence, and initiative.

• Customer‑centric mindset and collaborative spirit.

Other Requirements

• Willingness to travel frequently across Nigeria and West Africa.

• Fluent English (additional regional languages advantageous).

• Valid driver’s licence (or willingness to obtain).

What we offer you

• Work for a globally recognised engineering leader.

• Be part of a dynamic, innovative, and supportive team.

• Gain comprehensive training in Sulzer technologies and tools.

• Shape high‑impact projects across energy, chemicals, and sustainable processing industries.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
