jobs.title: Lead Consolidation/IFRS Analyst
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Consolidation/IFRS Analyst to join our Global Team. You will support our teams worldwide and Group Accounting with consolidation and accounting questions.

The role can be based in our UK or Madrid Offices.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Support the monthly preparation of consolidated financial statements

• Preparation of internal management reports

• Assist with the monthly Group Consolidation process

• Ensure quality and integrity of financial and accounting data via sanity checks and balance sheet reviews

• Support our legal entities and other stakeholders in accounting and consolidation questions

• Support further development of the Group Accounting Manual in accordance with IFRS, including training of colleagues worldwide and implementation of new requirements (IFRS / SIX).

• Support the preparation of the IFRS mid-year and annual consolidated financial statements, incl. responsibility for certain notes and comments

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• University degree in finance with focus on accounting

• Min. 5 years of working experience in a similar function, with significant multi entities experience.

• Extensive experience in practical and theoretical consolidation

• Very good IFRS knowledge, incl. practical experience

• Track record CCH Tagetik or other reporting tool would be an asset

• High analytical and conceptual abilities

• Fluency in English

• Excellent communication skills, able to relate to a variety of stakeholders from Functions and the business

What we offer you

• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Nous recherchons un Sales Engineer Senior pour rejoindre notre équipe Flow Equipment en France.

En tant que Sales Engineer, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre activité en mettant en lien expertise technique et besoins clients. Vous contribuerez à renforcer notre présence sur le marché et à offrir une valeur ajoutée exceptionnelle à nos clients. Vos actions auront un impact direct sur notre succès et sur l’avenir de l’entreprise.

Vous serez chargé de développer, de promouvoir et de représenter les activités Flow de SULZER (pompes pour les secteurs de l'énergie et des infrastructures) afin de répondre au mieux aux besoins de nos clients.

Vos principales missions :

• Être le point de contact principal pour toutes les activités commerciales concernant certains clients.

• Accompagner la direction dans l’élaboration du plan de développement et des budgets.

• Participer aux réunions commerciales.

• Mettre à jour le CRM de SULZER.

• Assurer une croissance rentable sur le territoire.

• Développer et maintenir des relations clients.

• Gérer les appels d’offres et les documents techniques.

• Coordonner les échanges techniques et commerciaux.

• Collaborer avec le réseau mondial d’usines.

• Négocier et conclure les ventes.

• Assurer le suivi des projets.

• Faciliter la communication entre les clients français et les usines.

• Suivre les évolutions marché / clients / concurrents.

Profil recherché :

• Diplôme universitaire en génie mécanique.

• Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une industrie similaire : Oil&Gas ou Energie. Une expérience en équipements rotatifs (Pompes, turbines, compresseurs) est indispensable.

• Compétences en communication, négociation et relation client.

• Autonomie, organisation et motivation.

• Maîtrise de l’anglais (Niveau C1)

• Disponibilité pour des déplacements.

• Flexibilité et créativité.

Nous recherchons quelqu'un basé en France. Ce poste est éligible au 100% télétravail.

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation – RTT - Prime sur objectifs

• Et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e soluzioni di sviluppo innovative che consentono una società di successo e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Sales Engineering Specialist supporta il processo di vendita fornendo competenze tecniche e aiutando i clienti a capire come i prodotti soddisfano le loro esigenze. Questo ruolo colma il divario tra ingegneria e vendita, garantendo precisione tecnica e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti che applicano conoscenze avanzate di un'area di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire progetti / processi indipendentemente con supervisione limitata. In genere allena e recensioni il lavoro di professionisti di livello inferiore. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di vendita senior per unire il nostro team Flow Equipment in Francia. Come Ingegnere di Vendite, si svolgerà un ruolo essenziale nello sviluppo del nostro business collegando competenze tecniche e le esigenze del cliente. Ti aiuterà a rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato e offrire un valore aggiunto eccezionale ai nostri clienti. Le tue azioni avranno un impatto diretto sul nostro successo e sul futuro dell'azienda. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo, della promozione e della rappresentazione delle attività di SULZER Flow (pompi per i settori dell'energia e delle infrastrutture) al fine di soddisfare al meglio le esigenze dei nostri clienti. • Sii il principale punto di contatto per tutte le attività commerciali riguardanti determinati clienti.
• Gestione del supporto nel piano di sviluppo e nei bilanci.
• Partecipa a riunioni di lavoro.
• Aggiornare il CRM SULZER.
• Assicurare una crescita redditizia nel Territorio.
• Sviluppare e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti.
• Gestione delle offerte e dei documenti tecnici.
• Coordinare scambi tecnici e commerciali.
• Collaborare con la rete di fabbrica globale.
• Negoziare e chiudere le vendite.
• Progetti di monitoraggio.
• Facilitare la comunicazione tra clienti francesi e fabbriche.
• Seguire sviluppi di mercato / clienti / concorrenti. Profilo ricercato:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un settore simile: Oil & Gas o Energy. Un'esperienza nell'attrezzatura rotante (pompi, turbine, compressori) è essenziale.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
Sie verantworten in dem Verkaufsgebiet Rheinland und Rheinland-Pfalz den Verkauf von Sulzer-Produkten aus dem Bereich der Abwassertechnik inklusive Serviceleistungen. Dies beinhaltet unter anderem:

• Außendienst im Bereich der kommunalen Wassertechnologie

• Beratung von Ingenieurbüros, Interessenten, Servicepartner und Kunden im Verkaufsgebiet

• Betreuung der Bestandskunden und Akquise von Neukunden

• Aktiver Verkauf von Neuanlagen und Serviceleistungen

• Persönliche technische Beratung und Betreuung großer Bedarfsträger

• Prüfung von Kundenanforderungen auf technische Machbarkeit und die Entwicklung passen-der Lösungskonzepte

• Projektverfolgung, Auftragsverhandlung, Auftragsklärung und Projektbegleitung während der Abwicklungsphase

• Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Durchführung technischer Präsentationen und die Teil-nahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen

• Unterstützung bei der Beobachtung und Analyse der Markt- und Wettbewerbssituation

• Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Umsetzung der kurz- und mittelfristigen Absatzziele

• Teilnahme an Messen, Tagungen und sonstigen dienstlichen Veranstaltungen

• Unterstützung bei Marketing- und Verkaufsfördermaßnahmen

• Ausbau und Stärkung der Marktposition und nicht zuletzt deutliche Steigerung der Umsätze

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
Folgende Voraussetzungen machen Sie zu unserem idealen Kandidaten:

• Sie haben eine abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Techni-ker, Ingenieur der Elektrotechnik oder im Maschinenbau

• Sie sind ein Vertriebsprofi mit langjähriger Außendiensterfahrungen und nachweislichen Ver-triebserfolgen, sind belastbar und verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz

• Sie verfügen möglichst über Vorkenntnisse im Vertrieb von beratungsintensiven Produkten, im besten Fall im Bereich der Pumpentechnik, bei Rührwerken und Zubehör

• Ihre Stärke ist, neben einer überzeugenden Verkaufsrhetorik, Verhandlungsgeschick und ab-
schlussstarken Verhandlungsführung, die ausgeprägte Kunden- und Verkaufsorientierung

• Zusätzlich zu einer verantwortungsvollen, selbstständigen Arbeitsweise verfügen Sie über die Fähigkeit, sich selbst zu organisieren und zu motivieren

• Im sicheren Umgang mit der deutschen Sprache, durch Ihr Auftreten und Ihre ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten schaffen Sie es, Kunden zu begeistern

• Einen Wohnort und nutzbare Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet können Sie vorweisen

• Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, soziale Kompetenz und die Bereitschaft zu flexibler Reisetätigkeit im Verkaufsgebiet (teilweise mit Übernachtungen) runden Ihr Profil ab

• Geübte PC-Anwenderkenntnisse, insbesondere die Beherrschung der MS-Office-Produkte und einen PKW-Führerschein setzen wir als selbstverständlich voraus

What we offer you

Bei Sulzer Flow werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen eine anspruchsvolle, eigenständige Aufgabe in einem fordernden und fördernden Umfeld. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, eine adäquate Vergütung sowie gute Zukunftsaussichten. Firmenfahrzeug (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und moderne Kommunikationsmittel werden zur Verfügung gestellt.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Técnico Mecânico

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role É responsável por instalar, configurar, calibrar e reparar produtos e sistemas técnicos nos locais de campo dos clientes. Esta função executa uma variedade de tarefas de manutenção e suporte técnico e pode fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente. Este perfil de cargo destina-se a pessoal de apoio que segue os procedimentos estabelecidos e trabalha sob supervisão próxima. Decisões menores/mais fáceis são tomadas de forma autônoma. Principais Responsabilidades: Identificar melhorias em equipamentos Sulzer e informa o plano de melhorias aos setores responsáveis Sulzer; Instalação e desinstalação de equipamentos rotativos em campo e plataformas offshore; Montagem e start-up de sistemas de selagem; Alinhamento entre motor e bomba; Montagem e desmontagem de acoplamentos por dilatação térmica, acoplamentos por dilatação hidráulica; Ajuste de gap entre máquina acionadora e máquina acionada, vedação por gaxetas; Montagem/desmontagem de selos mecânicos, mancais radiais de metal patente e rolamentos, axiais e ajuste de folga; Centralização de conjunto rotativo; Ajustes e montagem de pinos cônicos; Montagem e operação básica de máquinas de flushing em unidades de lubrificação, válvulas e atuadores de pequeno porte entre outras atividades pertinentes ao cargo. Habilidades Necessárias: Ténico Mecânico Completo; Conhecimentos práticos e teóricos em montagem de rolamentos, ajustagem mecânica por folga e interferência; Conhecimento em operação básica de máquinas operatrizes, metrologia e utilização de instrumentos de medição tais como paquímetro, micrômetro externo e interno, micrometro tubular, súbito, relógio comparador e relógio apalpador; Conhecimento em controle dimensional com emissão de relatório; Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico mecânico; Conhecimentos básicos em pacote office para emissão de relatórios; Conhecimento de amarrações, elevações e transportes de cargas; Conhecimentos básicos de bombas. 
• What we offer you Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público Programa de bem-estar e Gympass Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) Previdência privada Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is looking for a driven and commercially minded Account Manager to grow and develop our relationships with major Water Utility providers across the Southern Regions. You’ll manage an established customer base, identify new opportunities within those accounts, and take ownership for revenue growth across both Capital and Service & Aftermarket portfolios.

This is a strategic, customer-facing role for someone who thrives on autonomy, consultative selling, and long-term partnership building — with a genuine opportunity to progress into leadership as the account base grows. Key Responsibilities

• Managing and developing existing Water Utility accounts across the Southern Regions.

• Identifying and converting new business opportunities within those accounts across Capital equipment and Aftermarket services.

• Acting as the primary point of contact, building strong technical and commercial relationships at multiple stakeholder levels.

• Owning the number: forecasting, pipeline management, and delivering against growth targets.

• Working closely with internal Engineering, Service, and Commercial teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

• Growing these accounts to a scale where you will have the opportunity to develop and lead your own team in future.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience as an Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or Business Development professional within Water Utilities, Engineering, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, or related industrial sectors.

• A strong understanding of the Water sector’s operational and regulatory environment.

• Proven ability to grow accounts, uncover opportunities, and close technical solutions.

• Confident communicator with the ability to build trust and credibility.

• Commercially sharp, organised, and capable of managing a complex regional territory.

• Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable owning both the customer relationship and commercial outcomes.

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• An annual scheme that rewards company success and individual impact, featuring significant multipliers for exceptional results and role-modeling our core values

• Company car or allowance, including EV options.

• 33 days annual leave and home-working flexibility with full diary autonomy.

• Defined contribution pension scheme and Long Service Awards.

• Continuous professional development through our dedicated Learning Pathways.

• Costco membership, discounted car leasing, and a wide range of retail/lifestyle discounts.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise innovante, reconnue pour son savoir‑faire et ses équipes passionnées ?
Vous aimez être au cœur des projets techniques, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, production et engineering ?

jobs.title: QC Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Quality Control Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.
Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.
Document inspection results and report deviations.
Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.
Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.
Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.
Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.
Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Support Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and operational support to the sales team. This includes processing orders, maintaining customer records, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure smooth sales operations. The role requires strong organizational skills and a customer-focused mindset.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Responsible for providing aftermarket support for Chinese industry.
- Offer quotations and spare parts list to customers or after-sales;

- Maintain close communication with plants to ensure orders delivery on time and enhance customers satisfaction;
- Assist after-sales in utilizing sales tools to track and manage registered quotations;
- Follow up on payments with intermediaries and key account;

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine FA will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating and monitoring of resources such as labor, tools and technical assistants as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. Will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. Will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of Gas Turbines.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Manage, perform, coordinate the management of HD Gas Turbine site activities

• Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair and calibration after installation

• Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment

• Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair and maintenance at customer's sites

• Perform administrative functions such as: writing technical reports, ordering materials, securing quotations, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely, and thorough basis

• Signs off on all changes implemented.

• Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage

• Coach, mentor and train other team members as required, to impart and perpetuate field engineering and/or product knowledge.

• Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages

• Ensure all parts needed for the job are shipped to the site

• Perform walk-downs during installation to ensure that the customer’s contractors are working properly.

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our Sulzer vision and align with our organization’s core values.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Heavy Duty Gas Turbine maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Familiar with safety code and procedure for startup and commissioning

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Relevant experience of minimum 15 years of working on Outage of Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine. Or came from customer power plant experience

• Proficient in English.

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

• Past worked in the OEM is preferable

• Solid understanding of Gas Turbine Operation & Controlling Parameters.

• Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Step into a leadership role where you can drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement at Sulzer’s Leeds Service Centre — a key facility specialising in the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of rotating equipment for customers across power generation, oil & gas, water, and other heavy industries. Known for its technical capability and fast‑turnaround support, the centre plays a vital role in helping customers minimise downtime and maximise performance.

In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening quality standards, shaping improvement initiatives, and supporting a high‑performing, customer‑focused operation.
Your main responsibilities:

• Investigate and resolve quality issues using structured root‑cause analysis, ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions

• Lead and champion continuous improvement initiatives using LEAN methodology, working closely with the local management team

• Oversee the internal audit programme and support successful outcomes in customer and third‑party audits

• Monitor supplier performance and collaborate with procurement to enhance quality, conformance, and reliability

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or significant experience in a relevant service or repair environment

• Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and experience maintaining or managing quality management systems

• Proven success in leading LEAN or continuous improvement projects, with strong structured problem‑solving abilities

• Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills

• An understanding of repair processes, rotating equipment, and supplier quality standards

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds Service Centre — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience.

Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:
Core Benefits

• Competitive salary & annual bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SJR95936 Supervisor(a) Técnico
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

É responsável por instalar, configurar, calibrar e reparar produtos e sistemas técnicos nos locais de campo dos clientes. Esta função executa uma variedade de tarefas de manutenção e suporte técnico e pode fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente.
Este perfil de trabalho destina-se a pessoal experiente em nível de suporte que geralmente trabalha de forma autônoma e só requer supervisão mais próxima em situações não rotineiras.
Principais responsabilidades

Realizar manutenção e suporte técnico em produtos e equipamentos instalados;
Solucionar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas;
Determinar quando os produtos devem ser atualizados ou substituídos;
Fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente;
Coordenar com as equipes de engenharia para questões complexas.

Habilidades e qualificações

Requer formação profissional e experiência de trabalho;
Fortes habilidades técnicas e diagnósticas;
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em ambientes de campo;
Familiaridade com os procedimentos de instalação e calibração.

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Previdência privada
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are global specialists in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over 20 years of expertise, we deliver tailored solutions that ensure reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround for critical rotating equipment. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we are the trusted partner for clients worldwide.

We are seeking an Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer to join our team at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven – a key hub for turbine operations and customer support. Job Responsibilities

• Prepare accurate and timely quotations for gas turbine repair and overhaul projects.

• Analyse inspection reports and project specifications to calculate costs.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, and other internal teams.

• Ensure smooth commercial and technical handover to Project Engineers.

• Monitor and report on key metrics such as order value, margin reviews, and win rates.

• Maintain and update pricing models and standard scopes of work.

• Build strong relationships with customers and suppliers to reduce risk and maximise opportunities.

Job Qualifications

• Strong financial acumen and ability to forecast costs and margins.

• Excellent organisational and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Experience in estimating within the rotating equipment MRO industry.

• Knowledge of industrial gas turbines and associated equipment (desirable).

• A recognised qualification in engineering (preferred).

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Annual performance-based bonus aligned with both individual and company results

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to a wide range of retail and entertainment discounts — including the option to join Costco for exclusive member savings

• Discounted personal car leasing available for employees, family members, and friends

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme, offering guidance on personal and professional matters

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways and structured on-the-job training, helping you grow your career with us

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sales Administrator provides critical commercial, analytical, and operational support to the Sales function. This role ensures high-quality sales performance reporting, forecasting accuracy, end-to-end bid preparation, and continuous process improvement. The position acts as a central coordination point between Sales, Finance, Service Centres, and other operational teams to enable effective decision-making and strong business performance. Key Responsibilities

• Produce regular commercial performance reports, dashboards, and analysis to support Sales and Finance functions.

• Coordinate and consolidate sales forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business targets.

• Design, analyse, and manage sales target templates; facilitate target-setting

• Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis and communicate insights to stakeholders.

• Prepare and coordinate offers, tenders, and company bids in line with internal processes and governance requirements (e.g., Salesforce Sales process).

• Ensure alignment of bids with sales targets, pricing frameworks, and company commercial policies.

• Validate and document all financial assumptions, whole-life cost estimates, revenue projections, margins, risks, contingencies, and delivery schedules.

• Conduct risk assessments for each bid in accordance with company risk management procedures.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date bid information in relevant databases and systems.

• Support continuous improvement of bidding tools, templates, and processes.

• Ensure complete and accurate handover of bid documentation to the Service Centre Manager, Works Manager, Project Manager, or other relevant operational leaders upon contract award.

• Identify gaps and inefficiencies across sales administration, forecasting, and bidding workflows.

• Develop and implement solutions to streamline processes and strengthen business operations.

• Drive transformation initiatives that support service growth and improved operational cohesion across the go-to-market functions.

Key Skills

• Strong experience in sales administration, commercial support, or business operations.

• Proven analytical and reporting capabilities, including experience with forecasting.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and partner with stakeholders.

• High attention to detail with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Experience preparing bids, proposals, or tenders within a structured process environment.

• Proficiency in CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, Excel, Power BI)

What we offer you

• Global organisation with over 190 years of excellence

• Annual salary reviews

• Annual bonus scheme

• Growth and development opportunities

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L'amministratore di vendita fornisce un supporto commerciale, analitico e operativo critico alla funzione Vendite. Questo ruolo garantisce un reporting delle prestazioni di vendita di alta qualità, una precisione di previsione, una preparazione dell'offerta end-to-end e un miglioramento continuo del processo. La posizione funge da punto di coordinamento centrale tra Sales, Finance, Service Centres e altri team operativi per consentire un efficace processo decisionale e una forte performance aziendale. Principali responsabilità
• Produrre rapporti regolari di performance commerciali, dashboard e analisi per supportare le funzioni Vendite e Finanza.
• Coordinare e consolidare le previsioni di vendita, garantendo precisione e allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Progettare, analizzare e gestire i modelli target di vendita; facilitare l'impostazione target
• Identificare tendenze, rischi e opportunità attraverso l'analisi dei dati e comunicare informazioni agli stakeholder.
• Preparare e coordinare offerte, offerte e offerte aziendali in linea con i processi interni e i requisiti di governance (ad esempio, processo di Salesforce Sales).
• Assicurare l'allineamento delle offerte con obiettivi di vendita, framework di prezzi e politiche commerciali aziendali.
• Convalidare e documentare tutte le ipotesi finanziarie, le stime dei costi della vita intera, le proiezioni dei ricavi, i margini, i rischi, le contingenze e i tempi di consegna.
• Condurre valutazioni dei rischi per ogni offerta secondo le procedure di gestione dei rischi aziendali.
• Mantenere informazioni di offerta accurate e aggiornate in database e sistemi pertinenti.
• Supporta il miglioramento continuo degli strumenti di offerta, modelli e processi.
• Assicurare la consegna completa e accurata della documentazione di offerta al Service Centre Manager, Works Manager, Project Manager o altri leader operativi rilevanti al momento del contratto.
• Identificare lacune e inefficienze attraverso l'amministrazione delle vendite, la previsione e i flussi di lavoro di offerta.
• Sviluppare e implementare soluzioni per ottimizzare i processi e rafforzare le operazioni aziendali.
• Promuovere iniziative di trasformazione che supportino la crescita dei servizi e migliorano la coesione operativa attraverso le funzioni go-to-market. Abilità chiave
• Una forte esperienza nell'amministrazione delle vendite, nel supporto commerciale o nelle operazioni aziendali.
• Prove capacità di analisi e reporting, compresa l'esperienza con la previsione.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare con gli stakeholder.
• Alta attenzione ai dettagli con capacità dimostrata di gestire più priorità.
• Provare a preparare offerte, proposte o offerte all'interno di un ambiente di processo strutturato.
• Proficienza in CRM e strumenti di reporting (ad esempio, Salesforce, Excel, Power BI) Cosa ti offriamo
• Organizzazione globale con oltre 190 anni di eccellenza
• Recensioni annuali di stipendio

Sur le rôle L'administrateur des ventes fournit un soutien commercial, analytique et opérationnel essentiel à la fonction des ventes. Ce rôle assure la qualité des rapports sur le rendement des ventes, la précision des prévisions, la préparation des soumissions de bout en bout et l'amélioration continue des processus. Principales responsabilités
• Produire régulièrement des rapports de performance commerciale, des tableaux de bord et des analyses pour appuyer les fonctions Ventes et Finances.
• Coordonner et consolider les prévisions de ventes, en assurant l'exactitude et l'alignement avec les objectifs commerciaux.
• Concevoir, analyser et gérer des modèles de cibles de vente; faciliter la définition d'objectifs
• Identifier les tendances, les risques et les possibilités grâce à l'analyse des données et communiquer des informations aux parties prenantes.
• Préparer et coordonner les offres, les appels d'offres et les offres de l'entreprise conformément aux processus internes et aux exigences de gouvernance (par exemple, le processus Salesforce Sales).
• Assurer l'alignement des offres sur les objectifs de vente, les cadres de tarification et les politiques commerciales des entreprises.
• Valider et documenter toutes les hypothèses financières, les estimations de coûts sur toute la durée de vie, les projections de recettes, les marges, les risques, les éventualités et les calendriers de livraison.
• Effectuer des évaluations des risques pour chaque offre conformément aux procédures de gestion des risques de l'entreprise.
• Tenir à jour des informations précises sur les soumissions dans les bases de données et les systèmes pertinents.
• Soutenir l'amélioration continue des outils, modèles et processus d'appel d'offres.
• Assurer la transmission complète et exacte de la documentation de soumission au gestionnaire de centre de services, au gestionnaire de travaux, au gestionnaire de projet ou à d'autres chefs opérationnels pertinents lors de l'attribution du contrat.
• Identifier les lacunes et les inefficacités dans l'administration des ventes, les prévisions et les processus d'appel d'offres.
• Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour rationaliser les processus et renforcer les opérations.
• Lancer des initiatives de transformation qui soutiennent la croissance des services et améliorent la cohésion opérationnelle dans l'ensemble des fonctions d'accès au marché. Compétences clés
• Forte expérience dans l'administration des ventes, le soutien commercial ou les opérations commerciales.
• Capacités d'analyse et de rapport éprouvées, y compris l'expérience en matière de prévision.
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer avec les parties prenantes.
• Une grande attention aux détails avec une capacité démontrée de gérer plusieurs priorités.
• Expérience de la préparation des offres, des propositions ou des offres dans un environnement de processus structuré.
• Compétence en CRM et outils de rapport (par exemple Salesforce, Excel, Power BI) Ce que nous vous offrons
• Organisation mondiale avec plus de 190 ans d'excellence
• Examens annuels des salaires
• Régime annuel de primes
• Possibilités de croissance et de développement Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Location: Colton, California

The I&C Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc. Location: Colton, California

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).

• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).

• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.

• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).

• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.

• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules.

Scope of Supply (Typical)

• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)

• MCC lineups and associated controls

• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)

• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)

• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)

• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)

• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded)
Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution

Core Responsibilities
1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership)

• Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:

• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)

• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)

• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation

• Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:

• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)

• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects

• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details

• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable)

• Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints.

• Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release.
2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)

• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.

• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.

• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.

• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.

• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and

jobs.title: CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Set up and operate machinery according to instructions.
Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments.
Inspect products for quality and report defects.
Maintain a clean and safe work area.
Record production data and report issues.
Follow safety and operational procedures.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic mechanical skills and attention to detail.
Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines.
Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina.
Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.
Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s GT Aero business is entering an exciting new phase. As a key strategic area for Sulzer globally, we’re investing heavily in people, capability and long‑term development. Our Netherley, Stonehaven site specialises in aeroderivative gas turbine services, delivering repair, overhaul, field services, component manufacture and control‑system support. With one of the world’s largest inventories of turbine parts behind us, we’re positioned for significant growth.

Now we’re looking for a Quality Manager who can help take us to the next level
The Opportunity

This is a chance to join at a pivotal moment. Our QA/QC systems are developing fast, and we want someone who can truly shape the future of quality at the site.

As our Quality Manager, you will:

• Define and implement a site‑wide quality strategy for a growing aeroderivative services business.

• Strengthen and enhance QA/QC processes, ensuring they’re robust, efficient and fit for a high‑integrity engineering environment.

• Drive continuous improvement across operations, working closely with engineering, manufacturing, service teams and leadership.

• Act as the site’s quality expert, advising on standards, compliance, audits and certifications.

• Lay the foundations for a future quality function, helping harmonise processes and build capability as the team expands.

About You

You’ll thrive here if you’re someone who enjoys building, improving and owning quality systems. We’re looking for:

• Strong experience in QA/QC within rotating equipment, engineering, energy, or related environments.

• A hands‑on, solutions‑focused approach to quality management.

• Confidence in leading audits, managing compliance and driving standards.

• The ability to influence, collaborate and bring people with you through change.

• A mindset that sees challenge as opportunity and is motivated by making things better.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

• Purpose of the Job: Responsible for the inspection activities required in the SASOS workshop Main Duties involved but not limited to:
•  Bulk Strip and Detail Strip Inspection of Gas Turbines.
•  Provision of engine bulk strip and detailed defect reports.
•  Carry out stage inspections during engine build.
•  Controlling the workshop Control Order Files and support documentation.
•  Assisting the Company Quality Assurance representative in the absence of the supervisor.
•  Ensuring all measuring equipment in the workshop is approved calibrated and certified accordingly IAW the QMS manuals.
•  Development and revision of workshop procedures as and when required.
•  Sourcing suitable and effective alternatives to the OEM for required materials/repairs/overhauls.
•  Shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors.
•  Assist with in a timely manner the shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors. Progress and expedite all sub-con activity effectively.
•  Obtaining the most cost effective and minimum turn time for engine material requiring repair/overhaul/replacement.
•  Issuing of certificates of conformity for all materials being issued to and purchased by customers.
•  Assisting with shop floor fitting duties as designated by the Charge Hand or Operations Manager.
•  All other duties as relevant to the post and deemed reasonable by the Company.

Education requirements (desirable):
•  Minimum NC Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent), preferably HNC Mech. Eng. Where formal qualifications are not held, suitable proven experience is
• essential.

Job experience:
 Previous experience in a similar role

• Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):
•  Working knowledge of industrial gas turbines and/or power turbines and associated equipment
•  Ability to understand and communicate illustrated parts catalogues.
•  Ability to understand engineering drawings.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

• Responsible for the repair and overhaul of industrial gas turbines, power turbines and associated accessories and equipment. Main Tasks:
• The duties involved include but are not limited to:
•  Maintaining standards of engineering, appearance, timekeeping, discipline and housekeeping.
•  The receipt, bulk strip, detail strip, sub assembly and final build of industrial gas turbines and power turbines.
•  Training of internal employees.
•  Adherence to and completion of all procedures and documentation controlling the overhaul process.
•  Accurate recording of all critical fits/clearances.
•  Highlighting and reporting of critical out-of-tolerance measurements and other non-conforming issues such as damaged or inadequately overhauled components.
 Safe and correct use of all equipment and specialised tooling, including engine tooling is stored and maintained correctly and that any defective or missing equipment is reported immediately to supervising staff.

Education requirements (desirable):
 ITI, SVQ Graduate (or equivalent)., At least 6 years’ experience of overhauling and repairing gas turbines.

Job experience:
•  Previous experience in a similar role would be advantageous.
• Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):
•  Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment would be advantageous
•  Experience working as a senior workshop member in a fabrication, repair or construction environment.

Competencies:
• Good written and verbal communication (English).
•  Good organisational skills.
•  Adaptable approach, able to work independently, and function effectively as part of a team.
•  Strong team player capable of working across various departments and with external stakeholders.
•  Attention to detail

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Responsible for the repair and overhaul of industrial gas turbines, power turbines and associated accessories and equipment. Main Tasks: The duties involved include but are not limited to:  Maintaining standards of engineering, appearance, timekeeping, discipline and housekeeping.  The receipt, bulk strip, detail strip, sub assembly and final build of industrial gas turbines and power turbines.  Training of internal employees.  Adherence to and completion of all procedures and documentation controlling the overhaul process.  Accurate recording of all critical fits/clearances.  Highlighting and reporting of critical out-of-tolerance measurements and other non-conforming issues such as damaged or inadequately overhauled components.  Safe and correct use of all equipment and specialised tooling, including engine tooling is stored and maintained correctly and that any defective or missing equipment is reported immediately to supervising staff. Job experience:  Previous experience in a similar role would be advantageous. Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):  Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment would be advantageous  Experience working as a senior workshop member in a fabrication, repair or construction environment. Competencies: Good written and verbal communication (English).  Good organisational skills.  Adaptable approach, able to work independently, and function effectively as part of a team.  Strong team player capable of working across various departments and with external stakeholders.  Attention to detail

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Cleanline Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Main Tasks and 
• Responsibilities
The duties involved include but are not limited to:
 Cleaning of rotating equipment components not limited to aeroderivative gas turbines, pumps, compressors and steam turbines.
 Processing of components in various chemical tanks.
 Grit and vapour blasting of components.
 Hand cleaning of various components.
 Operation of ball burnishing machine.
 Actively highlighting and assisting in improving quality standards within the department.
 Ensure your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your acts or omissions
 All other duties as relevant to the post and deemed reasonable by the Company.

 Comply with and adhere to the Company’s quality, health & safety and environmental policies and procedures.
 Ensure your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your acts or omissions.
 Proactively engage and support initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, quality, environmental protection and continual improvement.
 Co-operate with the requirements of the Company’s QHSE Management System.

No formal qualifications required with full training provided. However preference will be given to candidates with previous experience in a clean line/workshop environment.

Ability to understand and interpret technical instructions
 Flexible approach, team player and ability to work independently

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
The Opportunity:

Sulzer is looking for an experienced Machinist to undertake machining of components and parts on driven machinery in accordance with Sulzer standards and specification.

ENVIRONMENTAL, SAFETY AND HEALTH

• Direct responsibility for the Health, Safety and Environment of all employees who either directly work in your area of control, or who visit the operational areas you are responsible for, either internal or external visitors. Including full legal & company compliance in areas under your responsibility.

• Develop a positive safety culture through the Sulzer Behavioral Safety Program.

• Follow safety rules and regulations, attend safety meetings, and contribute towards having a safe work environment.

Your Responsibilities : (NOT LIMITED TO)

• Ensure quality standards and engineering standards are conformed to in accordance with engineering drawings.

• Ensure product is compliant with Sulzer and Customer specific quality and engineering standards

• Be able to work independently and make decisions in conjunction with the supervisor regarding tooling, jigs and fixtures.

• Pre and final machining of components in accordance with specifications.

• Follow departmental standards, both written and verbal.

• Fully inspect work done according to specific requirements.

• Read, analyze, understand, and follow engineering drawings

• Read, understand, and follow instructions given on the production order.

• Use specific engineering measuring equipment such as micrometers, Vernier’s etc.

• Operate different machines, follow the safety standards, and use guards where applicable.

• Any other reasonable work instructions to be followed.
What We’re Looking For:

• Detailed knowledge of the various machining practices including turning, milling, shaft grinding, drilling and marking off, experience required.

• Sound knowledge of CNC and manual machining practices required experience in Mazatrol and Haas control. Knowledge on Fanuc and Siemens an advantage.

• Qualified Trade Tested Fitter or Fitter/Turner

• Communication skills

• Drive & motivation

• Ability to act independently.

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change.

• Attention to detail.

• Team driven.

• Quality and customer service orientated.

• Show initiative.

What we offer you

Medical Aid
Pension Fund

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Expediting and Document Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Expeditor is responsible for overseeing the timely production of our industrial equipment manufactured by subcontractors, ensuring on-time delivery and meeting quality standards.

Purpose of the Job:

The Expeditor is responsible for overseeing the timely production of our industrial equipment manufactured by subcontractors, ensuring on-time delivery and meeting quality standards.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
• As an Expediter, you will oversee the following tasks:
• 1. Establish the project Doc management system and procedure
• 2. Manage & maintain the project Doc sheet & schedule with other stakeholders
• 3. Monitoring and expediting the project Doc and production of raw materials & goods to ensure timely delivery.
• 4. Communicating regularly with the suppliers to get updates on order status & progression.
• 5. Solving problems and managing recovery plans in case of damaged goods or manufacturing delays with the suppliers and the project team.
• 6. Ensuring that the suppliers’ schedules are aligned with our internal requirements.
• 7. Coordinate the goods delivery with the logistics groups.
• 8. Developing and implementing new processes to improve internal work efficiency.
• 9. Maintaining an efficient document management system to ensure accessibility of documents.
• 10. Coordinating document validation, approval, and modification processes.
• 11. Providing support to internal and external teams regarding documentation.
• 12. Collaborating with other departments to ensure smooth communication and effective exchange of documents.

What we offer you

NA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Drive customer engagement across Australia & Oceania, fostering strong relationships through direct and digital interactions.

• Execute strategic sales and marketing activities aligned with sustainability, digital innovation, and energy transition initiatives.

jobs.title: Administration Assistant - Wheel Motors
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

If you love administration and thrive on being part of a growing, energetic business, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

Our Sulzer Brisbane Service Centre is fast‑paced, collaborative and on an exciting growth journey, and we’re looking for an experienced admin professional to grow with us and make a real impact. Your main tasks and responsibilities

• General office admin including but not limited to reception activities, personnel queries e.g. travel and expenses and team coordination.

• Job package creation and admin including PO’s and Invoicing. This includes ensuring that all materials are accurately booked from stock to each job.

• System admin for materials and stock management. You will take control of the stock and be responsible for adequate supply. It is imperative that you effectively liaise with warehouse staff, drivers, suppliers and internal management by email and phone tenaciously.

• Accounts payable and receivable tasks - processing suppliers' invoices and customers for payment of invoices.

• General filing (manual and digital), data entry including payroll and reviewing wage reports to ensure 100% accuracy in a timely manner.

• Weekly on hand stock checks from list to ensure workshop consumables are consistently topped up, liaise with Management on levels to be ordered.

• Provide administration assistance to the Leadership Team as required.

• Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with legislative requirements, Company policies and procedures.

What you bring to Sulzer

• 5+ Years' experience in Office Administration with purchasing and stores know how.

• You combine meticulous clerical skills with the practical mindset of a logistics professional.

• Reliability, friendly attitude and ability to liaise with blue collar to senior management personnel.

• Attention to detail.

• Strong computer skills with Microsoft suite, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent SAP/ERP systems.

• Strong communication skills.

• Sound ability to adapt in shared duties.

• High level skills in time management.

What we offer you

• Be part of a fun, energetic and collaborative team.

• Annual salary reviews

• Employee Assistance Program

• On-site parking

• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer's Brendale Service Centre and bring your expertise in electric motor repairs to our dynamic team. We offer competitive workshop pay, excellent workplace culture, career progression, and long-term job security. Experience in Low and High Voltage electric motor repair and overhauls is essential. As an Electrical Fitter, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and repairing electrical rotating equipment.

Your daily responsibilities will include

• Repairing Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) rotating machinery, with a focus on electric motors and generators.

• Performing full overhauls, rewinds, and conducting static and dynamic testing.

• Disassembling and assembling various electrical rotating equipment.

• Attending client sites for critical repairs and servicing.

• Ensuring work is completed safely and to the highest standard.

What We're Looking For

• A Certificate III in Electrical Fitting (or equivalent).

• Extensive experience in repairing, rewinding, and overhauling electric motors, including DC motors, medium to high-voltage motors, and generators.

• Strong focus on safety and excellent time management skills.

• A customer-first mindset with flexibility and problem-solving capabilities.

What we offer you

• Professional Growth: Access development and cutting-edge technology to elevate your career.

• Competitive Compensation: Attractive hourly rates with clear career progression pathways.

• Job Security: Strong pipeline of projects in mining and power generation.

• Recognition & Rewards: Celebrate success with gift cards, monthly BBQs, and other recognition programs.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in preparing and delivering technical presentations.

• Support the development of customized solutions based on client needs.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure feasibility of proposals.

• Respond to customer inquiries and provide technical support.

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Strong interest in technology and sales.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM tools.

• Team player with a proactive mindset.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

jobs.title: VTL Machine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Summary: Works under limited supervision, sets up and operates machine tools without assistance, following department policy and procedures. Manufactures and reconditions components parts to customer, OEM, and industry standards using conventions, machine tools, including VTL, lathes, milling machines, grinders, etc. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches, and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Constantly measures components, parts and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges and tools.

Essential Functions:

• Sets up and operates conventional machine tools, under limited supervision.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up, including methods of mounting, leveling aligning, holding and fastening work.

• Interprets blueprints, charts, tables, handbook formulas, sketches, and written and verbal orders. Lays out work according to requirements. Selects and grinds own cutting tools.

• Works within close tolerances to meet customer/contract specifications and applies knowledge of qualities of metals and alloys being machined.

• Performs any bench work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications.

• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001.

· Safety obligations:
o All employees understand and are able to explain the structure and objectives of the SBP.
o All employees follow the safety rules.
o All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation.

• Maintains machine tools as required to keep machines in good operating condition.

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.

• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in–process work during or prior to a shift change as required.

• Assis other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experience coworkers.

• Works overtime as required.

• Participates in 5S and housekeeping assignments.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Supervisory Responsibilities:
· None
Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a machine shop operating all types of conventional machine tools including lathes, milling machine, boring machines, and drills.

• Ability to read and interpret standard and metric drawings and blueprints, applying knowledge of tool geometry, feeds, speed and basic math skills.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1

jobs.title: Sales Engineer ‐ Service & Aftermarket
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we keep the world’s water flowing. As a global engineering powerhouse, we design, maintain, and service mission‑critical pumping equipment that supports drinking water supply, wastewater networks, flood control, industrial utilities, and energy infrastructure across the planet.

Across Ireland, demand for world‑class Water & Wastewater solutions has never been stronger. Internally, Ireland is recognised as one of the fastest‑growing strategic markets for Sulzer—so we’re investing. This brand‑new role is key to our growth plans, and we’re looking for a commercially driven Sales Engineer to help us strengthen our Service & Aftermarket success nationwide.
