jobs.title: (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in Nederland en België en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten.

Kom werken bij Sulzer als (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider en help mee in onze verdere groei en om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

• Voorbereiden van onderhouds- en modificatiewerkzaamheden aan de installaties/machines of onderdelen hiervan

• Opstellen van werkpakketten inclusief tekeningen, materialen, veiligheidsinstructies en planningen

• Coördineren van werkzaamheden met klanten, eigen Field Service Engineers, Workshop Engineers en externe partijen

• Aanvragen en beoordelen van offertes van leveranciers en aannemers

• Bewaken van voortgang, kosten en kwaliteit tijdens de voorbereiding en uitvoering

• Ondersteunen bij storingsanalyses en het implementeren van structurele verbeteringen

• Zorgen voor naleving van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsnormen (bijv. VCA, ISO, ATEX)

• Beheren van technische documentatie en onderhoudsplannen in het onderhoudsbeheersysteem of administratie.

Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig :

• MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar

• Aantoonbare ervaring in een industriële omgeving (bijv. industriële/communale waterzuiveringen, procesindustrie; chemie, food, pharma, metaal, energie)

• Kennis van industriële installaties, onderhoudsprocessen en technische regelgeving

• Ervaring met onderhoudsbeheersystemen en MS Office

• Bekend met LEAN, TPM of andere verbetermethodieken is een pré

• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatorisch sterk

What we offer you

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden:
Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Een prestatiebonusregeling
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)

Locatie:
Je werkt je samen met je collega’s vanuit onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport en af en toe ook bij onze klanten in de Benelux. We werken in onze moderne locatie met eigen werkplaats in een informele sfeer op een professionele manier met elkaar samen.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Het proactief opbouwen van nieuwe en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande klantrelaties in de Benelux

• Het omzetten van de klantvraag in een gedegen advies en overlegt daarbij indien nodig met binnendienst, projectmanagement en productmanagement

• Het zorgen voor een offerte op maat en presenteert de mogelijkheden op een aantrekkelijke wijze

• Het onderhandelen over de voorwaarden en je bent in staat de offerte om te zetten in een order

• Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in sales, bij voorkeur binnen de industrie

• Kennis van en ervaring met rotating equipment en relevante applicaties in een vergelijkbare functie is een belangrijke pré

• Attractieve bonusregeling

• Flexibele werktijden

• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)

• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)

• Lease auto, telefoon en laptop van de zaak

• Trainingsmogelijkheden

Je werkt veel samen met je collega’s, welke aanwezig zijn in onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport.
Daarnaast ben je tevens bij klanten in ons werkgebied de Benelux.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van o.m. pompen, roerwerken, vermalers en beluchting in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten.

Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Flow Equipment Midden-Zuid NL en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:

• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden

• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten

• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten

• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem

Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:

• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde

• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre

• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre

• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must

• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst

• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden

• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie

• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling

• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre

What we offer you

Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld

• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus

• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)

• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)

• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop

Locatie:
Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn.
Je vertrekt naar onze klantlocaties veelal vanuit thuis. Je bent woonachtig in de regio Midden NL (Nijmegen, Breda, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven) of Zuid NL.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: TS Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for pre-commissioning, commissioning, troubleshooting, start-up, and testing of rotating equipment and related mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems; supervising DIRA activities; monitoring field operations and reporting findings; acting as company representative in customer communications; ensuring compliance with ISO, HSE, and company regulations; promoting workplace safety through inspections and Stop Work Authority; and coordinating with Project, Sales, Engineering, and Workshop teams to ensure successful project execution.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.

• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.

• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.

• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system

• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.

• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.

• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request

• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative

• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.

• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.

• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.

• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.

• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Team player

• Well organized and structured

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Pro-active and self-motivated minset

• Multi-tasking

• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment

• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage

• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary:
This role supports the engineering, configuration, and validation of High Stator Turbo (HST) Compressors within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department. Responsibilities include developing sales‑order‑specific mechanical and automation designs, reviewing electromechanical schematics, and creating the bill of materials (BOM) within the ERP system.

The position collaborates with cross‑functional teams (Project Managers, Tendering, Sales, and Manufacturing, to prepare technical submittals) ensure accurate order configuration, and release finalized engineering packages to Production. The role also provides hands‑on mechanical support, including product testing and troubleshooting

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and hold hand-off meetings as needed to ensure team alignment

• Prepare and manage submittal packages to ensure timely, accurate customer approvals

• Learn the HST products, serve as the SME, and bring that expertise to the local team

• Assist in designing and building HST infrastructure in the USA

• Support Tendering Activities

• Support ORE Activities as needed

• Train HST team as necessary.

• Support Procurement and MRB, Quality Assurance Team

• Act as liaison between other teams in Finland and China

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the SAP ERP system

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and BOMs prepared by other ORE team members to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Design motor control electrical schematics by interpreting specifications, quotes, purchase orders, and company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and electrical production assembly

• Support the Project Engineer with motor control design documentation for sales order submittals.

• Review sales-order-specific electrical schematics (drawings and BOMs) created by other ORE team members

• Provide electrical review and support to other departments assigned by the ORE Manager

• Support field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as necessary

Education & Experience:

Required: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field (or equivalent practical experience with rotating equipment, industrial controls, or electromechanical systems)

• 3 – 7 years of experience in mechanical, electromechanical, or automation engineering.

• Experience with rotating machinery, compressors, turbomachinery, motors, VFDs, or similar high‑speed equipment preferred.

• Hands‑on experience reading or generating mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and BOMs.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred).

• Experience supporting manufacturing, production, or test environments.

• Understanding of industrial automation, motor control, or electromechanical system integration is a plus.

• Ability to collaborate across cross‑functional and international teams.

Skills:
Required: CAD,
SolidWorks,
Siemens TIA,
HMI In-touch
Experience in 3D modelling and drafting
SAP System Experience
Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook,

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role
We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry.
You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories

• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy

• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams

• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins

• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices

• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel

• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion

Requirements:

• Strong technical and commercial acumen within the water industry

• B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

• 10+ years’ experience in the water industry , including 7+ years living and working in Greece

• Proven experience in technical sales, proposals, or tendering functions

• Strong ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

• Sulzer product knowledge is a strong advantage

• CRM experience (Salesforce preferred)

What we offer you

• Chance to make a meaningful impact by driving growth across the Sales organisation within our Water & Industrial business, with sustainability at the heart of our strategy.

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry in a global environment

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Early Careers Coordinator (Maternity Cover – 14 Months)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about developing early talent and supporting people at the start of their careers? We’re looking for a highly organised, people‑focused Early Careers Coordinator to join our team on a maternity cover basis, based in Leeds.
• Start date: June (to allow for handover)

• Contract: Fixed-term, 14 months

• Reporting to: Learning & Development Manager

This role plays a key part in delivering a positive experience for our graduates and apprentices across Sulzer’s UK operations. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys responsibility, autonomy and being the central point of coordination for early careers programmes.

What you’ll be doing

• Coordinating and supporting Sulzer’s early careers programmes, including graduates and apprentices

• Acting as a key point of contact for early careers participants, providing guidance and support throughout their journey

• Managing programme activities such as inductions, rotations, development milestones and key events

• Maintaining accurate early careers records and tracking progression and outcomes

• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business to ensure a smooth and consistent early careers experience

• Working closely with the Learning & Development Manager and the Leeds‑based L&D team to ensure programmes run effectively

About you

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail

• Confident managing your own workload, diary and priorities

• A clear, professional communicator who enjoys working with people

• Comfortable using HR or learning systems (experience with learning platforms is a plus)

Location, travel & flexibility

• Leeds will be your primary working location, with hybrid working available (office and home)

• Some UK travel required, primarily to Birmingham, with occasional travel to Aberdeen and other UK locations

• Planned travel only, with occasional overnight stays – no last‑minute “drop‑everything” requests

• Full UK driving licence required

What we offer you

• Competitive base salary.

• Flexitime policy supporting a balanced and flexible approach to working hours.

• 33 days annual leave .

• Defined pension contribution.

• Medicash healthcare plan, helping cover everyday costs such as dental, optical and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing benefits.

• Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential support when you need it.

• Wide range of discounts on shopping, entertainment and lifestyle, with access to apply for Costco membership.

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Modern working environment – Our Leeds site is undergoing a significant renovation, creating a refreshed, high‑quality and modern workspace.

• Onsite facilities – Enjoy a 24/7 gym, subsidised canteen, vending machines, and an active Sports & Social Club.

• Support for veterans, reservists and cadet adult volunteers – Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme and actively welcomes ex‑military personnel.

Why join us?

• A meaningful role shaping the experience of future talent

• High levels of autonomy and trust in how you manage your time

• Supportive, collaborative L&D team with a structured handover

• Opportunity to gain broad exposure across learning and development activities

About Sulzer

Sulzer is a global engineering company specialising in fluid engineering and chemical processing solutions for industries that are essential to everyday life, including energy, water and manufacturing.

Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ around 13,500 people worldwide across 160 locations, generating CHF 3.5 billion in annual turnover. Our technologies help customers improve energy efficiency, reduce emissions and support the transition to

jobs.title: Projektmanager (w/m/d) für Dampfturbinen und Kompressoren
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Projektmanager (m/w/d), der die technische und kaufmännische Abwicklung von Revisionsprojekten im Bereich Dampfturbinen und Turboverdichter verantwortet. In dieser Rolle begleiten Sie Projekte von der Angebotsphase bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss, stehen im engen Austausch mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Fachabteilungen und tragen maßgeblich zur wirtschaftlichen und technischen Umsetzung unserer Projekte bei. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Technische und kaufmännische Planung sowie Abwicklung von Revisionsprojekten an Dampfturbinen und Turboverdichtern

• Erstellung von Angeboten sowie projektspezifischer Dokumentationen

• Betreuung und Beratung unserer Kunden über den Projektverlauf hinweg

• Führung technischer und kaufmännischer Verhandlungen

• Enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern

• Anfrage, Beauftragung und Koordination der Leistungen unserer Lieferanten

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Turbomaschinen und/oder Kraftwerkstechnik

• Interesse und Bereitschaft, sich in unterschiedliche technische und kaufmännische Fragestellungen einzuarbeiten

• Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, gemeinsam mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Fachabteilungen praktikable Lösungen zu erarbeiten

• Reisebereitschaft von ca. 20 %

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Grundkenntnisse in SAP

• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Word, Excel und Project

What we offer you

• Schlüsselposition mit Verantwortung und direktem Beitrag zum Wachstum

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Ausstattung

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen (u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Familienservice‑Hotline)

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
SUMMARY:
Performs sandblast and paint application tasks in accordance with SPSI standard procedure processes as well as specific customer requirements.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME

 Operates sandblast equipment to provide required surface preparation 35%

 Performs mixing of various types of paint materials. 5%
 Operates conventional spray equipment, including brush to provide a high quality industrial finish to parts and components 35%
 Moves parts and components as needed with forklift or overhead pendant crane 5%
 Dispose of paint waste materials as required by company, state and federal regulations 5%

 Adheres to Safety and Take 5 culture 5%
 Supports and cooperates with Four Principles 5%
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Other duties as assigned 5%

TOTAL PERCENT OF TIME: 100%
QUALIFICATIONS:
 High School graduate or equivalent
 Minimum of 1 year experience operating sandblast equipment
 Minimum of 2 years of experience operating conventional spray equipment
 Forklift and pendant crane experience is helpful
 Minimum 1 year of experience mixing and applying epoxies, polyurethane, inorganic zinc and alkyd enamel paints.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Channel Partners

titleByLocale.it: Business Development Manager - Partner di Canale
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire du développement des entreprises - Partenaires Channel

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Driving sales of Sulzer Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders to new and existing business partners.

• Planning, supporting and following-up of sales activities in-line with the sales strategy and defined processes.

• Developing and maintaining a product training for existing and new Flow Business partners.

• Monitor the performance for key business partners and take remedial action where necessary to ensure that targets are met.

• Liaise and work closely together with the Sales Manager - Pacific and the Service teams with customers.

• Establishing new, and maintaining existing, long-term relationships with customers.

• Supporting marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

• Ensure orders and projects are launched in a timely and professional manner.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers in order to reduce commercial risk and to maximize future business opportunities.

• Maintain and monitor up to date knowledge of competitor products and activities.

• Identify new markets and business opportunities, maximizing the potential of Sulzer's complete product offering in the targeted sub-segments.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 5+ years experience in Pump product sales

• A detailed knowledge and experience in the selection and selling of Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders.

• Relevant tertiary/trade and/or pump sales experience highly regarded.

• Strong communication skills.

• High level negotiation skills.

What we offer you

• Annual Salary Reviews

• Annual Bonus

• Car Allowance + Fuel Card and Toll Pass

• On-site parking

• Work for a global organisation that truly values personal growth and development

• Sulzer - Over 190 years of excellence

Descrizione - I compiti e le responsabilità principali: - Guidare le vendite di Sulzer Sommergibili Pompe, Miscele & Grinders a nuovi e esistenti partner commerciali. - Pianificazione, supporto e follow-up delle attività di vendita in linea con la strategia di vendita e processi definiti. - Sviluppare e mantenere una formazione di prodotto per i partner esistenti e nuovi Flow Business. - Monitorare le prestazioni per i principali partner commerciali e prendere azioni correttive, se necessario, per garantire che gli obiettivi siano soddisfatti. - Liaise e lavorare a stretto contatto con il Sales Manager - Pacific e i Service team con i clienti. - Stabilire nuovi e mantenere relazioni esistenti e a lungo termine con i clienti. - Sostenere le attività di marketing partecipando a fiere, conferenze e altri eventi di marketing. - Assicurare ordini e progetti vengono lanciati in modo tempestivo e professionale. - Sviluppare e mantenere forti relazioni con clienti e fornitori al fine di ridurre il rischio commerciale e massimizzare le opportunità di business future. - Mantenere e monitorare la conoscenza aggiornata dei prodotti e delle attività concorrenti. - Identificare nuovi mercati e opportunità di business, massimizzando il potenziale dell'offerta completa di prodotti di Sulzer nei sottosegmenti mirati.
• Requisiti - 5+ anni di esperienza nelle vendite di prodotti Pump - Una conoscenza dettagliata e l'esperienza nella selezione e nella vendita di Pompe sommergibile, Miscelatori e Grinders. - Esperienza di vendita terziaria/commerciale e/o pompa molto apprezzata. - Forte capacità di comunicazione. - Capacità di negoziazione di alto livello. descriptionByLocale.en:

• Driving sales of Sulzer Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders to new and existing business partners.
• Planning, supporting and following-up of sales activities in-line with the sales strategy and defined processes.
• Developing and maintaining a product training for existing and new Flow Business partners.
• Monitor the performance for key business partners and take remedial action where necessary to ensure that targets are met.

• Supporting marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.
• Ensure orders and projects are launched in a timely and professional manner.

• 5+ years experience in Pump product sales
• A detailed knowledge and experience in the selection and selling of Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders.
• Relevant tertiary/trade and/or pump sales experience highly regarded.
• Strong communication skills.
• High level negotiation skills. What we offer you
• Annual Salary Reviews
• Annual Bonus
• Car Allowance + Fuel Card and Toll Pass
• On-site parking

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Técnico
Senior Project Manager (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of complex, long‑term customer contracts (e.g., LTSA / framework agreements) and high‑risk projects. You’ll be the key link between our customers and internal teams—bringing people together, keeping delivery on track, and building strong, long‑term partnerships. In this role, you’ll lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix environment, communicate confidently with senior customer stakeholders, and spot opportunities to grow the business. Main accountabilities and tasks

• Ensure contractual execution within cost, time, quality and Sulzer PM standards

• Manage financial performance of customer contracts, including cost control, forecasting and invoicing aligned with as‑sold budgets and milestones

• Act as primary customer interface: contract updates, issue resolution, claims, variations and addenda negotiations

• Present contract progress to senior management on a regular basis

• Create and maintain customer, contract and project data, proposals, TOA calculations, purchase orders and scope releases in the Business Management System

• Coordinate project handovers and communication between customers, execution centers and operations

• Lead and manage project teams within a matrix organization

• Ensure full contractual compliance, handle NCRs and customer complaints

• Develop business insights, business cases and support continuous improvement initiatives

• Support customer visits, ensure safety inductions, PPE compliance and ESH requirements

• Promote quality improvements, safety awareness and identify risks and improvement opportunities, escalating with recommended solutions

What we're looking for:

• 9+ years of experience in project and contract management, preferably in complex and international environments

• Experience with industrial rotating equipment

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred; project management background is a plus

• Recognized project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMI, PM²) or equivalent degree

• Strong experience in contract and commercial management, including legal aspects

• Confident communication and negotiation skills at senior customer management level

• Proven ability to lead cross‑functional teams in a matrix organization

• Strong communication skills; proactive, well‑organized and solution‑driven people manager

• Fluent English required

• Willingness to travel 25–50% worldwide

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Supervisor Técnico
Project Manager/Business Admin Apprentice
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Start your career at Sulzer’s Falkirk Service Centre, the specialist hub for high‑voltage testing, repair and refurbishment of large industrial equipment. This is where complex, heavy‑duty engineering comes to life - and as an apprentice, you’ll work alongside expert engineers and project managers, learning hands‑on skills and knowledge that help power major industries across the UK and beyond.

Our Project Manager Apprenticeship gives you real life experience, exposure to a variety of business projects and the chance to build solid technical skills in a professional engineering environment. Key Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day administrative support to teams or managers

• Assist with creating and updating project plans, schedules, and timelines

• Communicate project updates to stakeholders and team members

• Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems

• Input and update information using internal systems and spreadsheets

• Act as a first point of contact for internal and external enquiries

• Communicate professionally via email, phone, and face-to-face

• Support customer or stakeholder queries and escalate where required

• Assist with improving administrative processes and ways of working

• Support business operations such as procurement, invoicing, or project management

• Help monitor KPIs and produce basic performance reports

What We’re Looking For
We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about engineering and ready to learn. You’ll be a great fit if you have:

• 3 National 5’s (passes) , including Maths and English

• Motivation to learn and develop new skills

• Good time ‑ management and organisational ability

• A positive, flexible attitude and strong attention to detail

• Prior business administration or project management experience isn’t required - just curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to get involved.

What we offer you

• Competitive apprentice pay that increases as you progress

• Mentoring and support from experienced professionals

• Opportunities to work with modern technology and innovative applications

• Sponsored education with pathways to higher qualifications

• Potential short placements at other UK sites

• Opportunities to work with teams or customers internationally

• Strong potential for a permanent role on successful completion

• Long ‑ term development and progression routes within Sulzer

• A UK-wide apprentice community of more than 80 peers

• 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays)

• Company pension scheme

What Will Your Time as an Apprentice Look Like?

Year 1 – Full‑Time College
You’ll spend your first year at college working towards a Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification. This gives you the foundation knowledge and core skills you’ll need before joining the team on-site.

Years 2, 3 & 4 – On‑Site Development
From your second year onwards, you’ll be based within our engineering teams. You’ll gain hands‑on experience, apply what you’ve learned, and continue your studies towards a Level 3 qualification and your final Apprenticeship Standard. Throughout this time you’ll receive regular mentoring, internal training, and opportunities to broaden your experience across different engineering tasks.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: HR Advisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Recruitment-focused HR role managing hiring, onboarding, data and leader support while building strong relationships across the business. Looking to take ownership of recruitment while still building your broader HR skillset? This is your opportunity to step into a hands-on, high-impact role supporting a global business in a growing and essential industry.

We’re on the lookout for a driven HR Advisor to lead end-to-end recruitment whilst also supporting key HR processes that keep our business running smoothly.

What you’ll be doing

This is a recruitment-heavy role with real ownership and variety. You’ll partner closely with leaders across the business to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

Key focus areas include:

• Leading end-to-end recruitment across a range of roles (with a strong focus on skilled trades)

• Managing onboarding and candidate experience from offer to day one throughout probation

• Supporting immigration and visa processes for temporary and permanent employees

• Maintaining accurate employee data and workflows in Workday

• Supporting leaders with performance processes (probation, annual reviews)

• Providing generalist HR support across employee lifecycle activities

• Contributing to HR reporting and projects as needed

You’ll also stay connected with our Service Centres across Australia, building strong relationships and ensuring HR is visible, practical and value-adding.

What we’re looking for

You’re someone who enjoys being in the detail but also thrives on building relationships and influencing outcomes.

• 2–3 years’ experience in HR and/or recruitment

• Strong experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes

• Confident communicator with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels

• Highly organised with strong time management skills

• Comfortable working across systems (experience with Workday highly regarded)

• A proactive, solutions-focused mindset

What we offer you

• Performance-based bonus that genuinely rewards impact

• Company phone & laptop

• Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing

• Global organisation with strong career development opportunities

• 12 month contract role with an intension to move to perm

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technicien d'usinage
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machine Tool Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser.

Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen.
In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort

• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort

• Störungsanalysen

• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)

• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)

• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil

• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel

• Führerschein Klasse B

• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen)

What we offer you

Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.

• Zukunftssichere Position in einem modernen und wachsenden Unternehmen

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Leistungsgerechte Vergütung, inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• Intensive Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Einsatzmöglichkeit vom Wohnort

• Top ausgestattete Service-Vans mit modernem Werkzeug

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Mechanical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems, including perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to analyze the structural integrity of the designed components.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision Purpose of the job

Execute engineering Task and act as Subject Expert Matter on mechanical engineering analysis and stress analysis with FEA software.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Analyze and calculate mechanical task issues such as stress analysis, etc.
Understand all advance mechanical engineering structural analysis, including stress concentration factors, ratio of stress to yield, etc.
Conduct advance analysis using Finite element Software, mainly with ANSYS Mechanical and its derivatives
Understand fundamental geometry modification
Understand advance meshing
Have full understanding of bounndary condition (constraints and force) application
Have understanding about fluid dynamic and CFD
Lead and conduct as required meetings with shop personnel, customers and others.
Perform communication / contact with customers on the technical issues or work progress.
Able to explain highly complex structural analysis in easily understandable terms

• Provide solutions for problems while performing the project with regards to quality, time, and cost.

• Prepare engineering report, including progress report.

Field Assignment

Lead engineer if needed for field service activity
Communicate with third party and / or with customer for technical assistance required.
Make and issue progress reports.

Vendor Qualification & Monitoring

Perform monitoring of vendors.
Communicate with vendors for feedback.

Quality Issues

Identify and develop new procedures as required
Support ISO Coordinator to monitor implementation of existing procedures in shop and conduct required training for co-workers.
Monitor and issue engineering quality objective report.

Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory :
Preferable Master degree in Mechanical/Aerospace/lightweigt structure Engineering, Bachelor with relevant experience will be strongly considered.
Having minimum 3 year experience in handling stress analysis and FE analysis, preferably within ANSYS Workbench framework
Experience in CAD Software, preferably Inventor or ANSYS Workbench derivatives
Experience in MS Windows environments, especially for presenting and reporting activities.
Have passion to get deep in FEA knowledge

Value-add :
Having minimum 3 year experiences in turbo-machinery or rotating equipment repair
Having minimum 3 year in API 687 exposure
Having experience/exposure in Fluid Dynamic Analysis, preferably within ANSYS Fluent/CFX framework
Having exposure to project-based workflow, project planning (such as with MS Project), timeline management, etc.

What we offer you

• Career Opportunities

• Medical Insurance

• Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Location: Pasadena, TX (1910 Jasmine Drive)
On‑site role with up to 40% field service

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer supports the inspection, repair, and documentation of rotating equipment by combining hands‑on shop and field work with engineering documentation and customer communication. This role works closely with the machine shop, quotation team, and customers to help define accurate repair scopes and ensure quality execution.

This position is intended for engineers with practical mechanical experience who can work independently with general guidance. Training will be provided as part of onboarding. This role is primarily based on‑site in Pasadena, TX, with occasional field service assignments (up to 40%). The engineer will split time between hands‑on mechanical work, inspections, measurements, and engineering documentation. The role requires close coordination with the repair shop, internal teams, and customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Support rotating equipment inspections and repair evaluations to help define accurate work scopes

• Act as a mechanical point of contact for customers during inspections and repairs

• Coordinate with the machine shop and quotation team on mechanical findings and requirements

• Create and update CAD drawings to document design or repair changes for customer review

• Perform or verify precision measurements using micrometers and calipers

• Participate in day‑to‑day shop and field operations, including repair support

• Assist with field service overhauls as required

• Document findings clearly and complete assigned tasks on schedule

Preferred (3+ years total across one or more of the following):

• Rotating equipment repair or overhaul

• Rotating equipment manufacturing

• Rotating equipment package design and assembly

• Field service for mechanical equipment

• Vibration analysis or diagnostics

Technical Skills & Knowledge

• Proficient with CAD software (SolidWorks or AutoDesk)

• Working knowledge of:

• Rolling element bearings

• Sleeve/babbitt bearings

• Mechanical seals and oil seals

• Shaft alignment

• Vibration spectrums and interpretation

• Comfortable using micrometers and calipers

• Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred

• If not already experienced, this skill will be taught on the job

Required Attributes

• Self‑motivated and willing to learn through on‑the‑job training

• Comfortable working in a hands‑on, industrial environment

• Able to take ownership of assigned work and complete tasks in a timely manner

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

What we offer you

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with 6% company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Gym membership and wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles.
Summary : Responsible for conducting activities in our service warranty & spares department.

Essential Functions:

• Assist our customer base including our reps, distributors and authorized service centers with their service and technical needs

• Leads initial field trouble shooting and expedites technical and engineering support as needed

• Ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty by consulting with, assisting and resolving requests, inquiries and complaints, both verbally and in writing

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Provide 2nd‑level IT support, both on‑site and remotely, for all users of Sulzer Ltd, primarily within the assigned region and, if required, across other regions

• Monitor and maintain the entire local IT infrastructure, including desktop and mobile Windows devices, MFPs, company‑specific hardware and software, user and access management, servers, network components, etc.

• Install and configure end‑user devices, including mobile phones

• Handle hardware procurement and inventory management

• Receive, analyze, and resolve incidents and service requests within 2nd‑level support using standard IT tools

• Escalate incidents and service requests to 3rd‑level support, external local service providers, or management when required

• Perform tasks in accordance with ITIL standards, primarily using the company’s internal ticketing system ServiceNow (SNOW), while adhering to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Technically coordinate and set up video conferences (Microsoft Teams / Yealink)

• Manage and maintain internal meeting room infrastructure

• Collaborate on and support local and global IT projects

• Train and coach new employees and trainees

Special Key Responsibilities

• Provide specialized IT support and daily assistance to VIP users, including support during external executive meetings and town halls

• Member of a cross‑functional team (DevOps: Local IT – Datacenter)

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Successfully completed IT education or training

• Several years of professional experience in 2nd‑ and/or 3rd‑level IT support

• Experience in VIP support is an advantage (preferably in a comparable corporate environment)

• Broad knowledge in network (Cisco), DDC (Hyper-V), AD, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, Intune etc.

• ITIL and/or Microsoft certifications (Server / Client / Network) are an advantage

• Very good English skills and good German skills would be a strong advantage.

• Strong customer‑ and service‑oriented mindset

• Analytical, structured, and solution‑oriented approach

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team‑oriented environment

• Flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, and willingness to undertake occasional business travel

• Availability to work in shift hours (7am - 4pm / 9am - 6pm)

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Winder Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving.

A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference.

We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities

• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes

• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures

• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding

• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers

• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time

Job Qualifications

• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)

• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors

• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings

• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Annual companywide bonus

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingénieur QESH
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur QESH (Qualité, Environnement, Santé, Sécurité) pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des systèmes de gestion intégrés QESH afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire et l'amélioration continue des performances.

Responsabilités du poste

* Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique et les objectifs QESH en accord avec la stratégie du groupe.
* Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations nationales et internationales en matière de qualité, d'environnement, de santé et de sécurité.
* Développer, maintenir et améliorer le système de management intégré QESH (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
* Réaliser des audits internes et externes QESH et suivre les plans d'actions correctives et préventives.
* Analyser les incidents, accidents et non-conformités, et proposer des solutions pour éviter leur récurrence.
* Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance QESH.
* Animer et sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques QESH par des formations et des communications régulières.
* Gérer la documentation QESH (procédures, instructions, enregistrements).
* Assurer la veille réglementaire QESH et anticiper les évolutions.
* Participer à l'analyse des risques professionnels et environnementaux.

Qualifications du poste

* Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé en QESH, QHSE, ou domaine équivalent.
* Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
* Solide connaissance des normes ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001.
* Maîtrise de la réglementation française en matière de QESH.
* Capacité à analyser, synthétiser et résoudre des problèmes complexes.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, pédagogie et leadership.
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
* Maîtrise du Pack Office.
* Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable.

What we offer you

X

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: MRP Controller and Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for end‑to‑end production and material planning through effective MRP execution, inventory control, and cross‑functional coordination to ensure smooth order flow from planning to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Achieve ≥92% On‑Time Delivery and 100% Sales Order Compliance.

• Execute MRP planning, ensuring accurate and timely release of BOMs and requisitions.

• Plan, schedule, and close planned and production orders aligned with forecasts and customer dates.

• Manage routings and production order closures to meet operational targets.

• Monitor end‑to‑end order timelines (PR, PO, production, and delivery) and resolve delays.

• Coordinate with Purchasing, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, and Logistics for seamless execution.

• Optimize inventory and material flow to support production, backlog clearance, and OTD performance.

• Drive digital planning improvements and COGS reduction initiatives through process optimization.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor Mechanical Engineering

• 5-8 Years of Experience in MRP and Planning (End to end execution)

• SAP PP and MM, MS Excel, RFC and compliance

• Production Planning & Control

• Inventory Management & Optimization

• Strong Communication Skills

• Attention to Detail

• Time & Priority Management

• Collaboration & Teamwork

What we offer you

• A great working environment.

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: MRO Gas Turbine Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced MRO Gas Turbine Engineer to provide technical expertise and support for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of gas turbine components and systems. This role is crucial in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of critical equipment for our clients. Job Responsibilities

• Setting technical specifications for the overhaul, inspection, and repair of aero-derivative gas turbines

• Overseeing disassembly, inspection and reassembly activities, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, tolerances and standards

• Leading troubleshooting and diagnostic investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives, applying Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, OEMs, supply chain, and operations to deliver seamless project execution

Job Qualifications

• Strong technical expertise in gas turbines and rotating equipment, with practical experience of MRO environments

• Proven track record in repair schemes, diagnostics, and troubleshooting

• Knowledge of RB211 and/or Avon products (desirable but not essential)

• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions

• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)

• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Annual Bonus scheme based on personal and company performance

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Private Medical Insurance (Self)

• Access free on-site parking and employee discounts across shopping, lifestyle, and entertainment

• Use our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support services and wellbeing resources

• Develop your skills through continuous learning and Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Be part of a supportive, innovative team with genuine opportunities for career progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
