jobs.title: Warranty Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests.

Key Responsibilities

Warranty Claims & Process Management

• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.

• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.

• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).

• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle.

Customer & Stakeholder Interface

• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.

• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.

• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.

• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries.

Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline

• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.

• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.

• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.

• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure.

Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution

• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.

• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.

• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations.

Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management

• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.

• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.

• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.

• Translate customer feedback into improvement actions in coordination with Engineering, Quality, and Service teams.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

• Ensure warranty activities align with departmental KPIs, including Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline.

• Monitor performance indicators such as claim cycle time, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and recurrence trends.

• Identify systemic issues and contribute to process, design, or quality improvements to reduce future warranty exposure.

• Capture and communicate lessons learned to relevant stakeholders and governance forums.

Leadership & Capability Development

• Provide technical and process guidance to junior professionals involved in warranty claim execution.

• Review work outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standar

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the job

The role is responsible for driving sustainable Order Intake growth for Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components (MTC) business through:

• Active hunting of brownfield revamp opportunities from existing operating assets

• Early involvement and development of greenfield / grassroot CAPEX projects, from feasibility to FID

• Providing front‑end technical sales leadership, translating customer process challenges into differentiated, value‑based MTC solutions

Main tasks and responsibilities
Revamp & Brownfield

• Proactively identify revamp, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, separation efficiency improvement, and reliability upgrade opportunities in existing operating plants

• Ability to conduct asset‑level analysis (age of internals, operating issues, performance gaps, fouling, corrosion, capacity creep, energy efficiency requirements)

• Drive revamp‑led sales strategies, including Tray replacement, Packing retrofits (random ↔ structured), Mist eliminator and separator upgrades, Hydraulic rating changes and column internals optimization

• Position Sulzer as a lifecycle partner, not just an equipment supplier

Greenfield/Grassroot Project Development

• Actvely pursue new CAPEX grassroot projects

• Engage customers, licensors, consultants & EPCs early (feasibility,pre-FEED,FEED)

• Coordinate with application & technology, global applications teams in accordance to Sulzer project governance to lock in Sulzer MTC solutions early.

Technical & Application Leadership

• Translate customer challenges into value-based technical proposals that differentiate MTC from competitors with Application & Technology team.

• Order Intake & Sales Achievement
Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• Strategic Planning & Execution
Implement long‑term and short‑term business strategies and ensure alignment with regional and global MTCS initiatives.

• Proposal Follow-up & CRM Management
Proactively follow up on outstanding proposals and maintain accurate, up-to-date information in the Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely with Head Office, Regional Offices, and local intermediaries to support project acquisition, proposal development, and market initiatives.

• Market Intelligence & Reporting
Provide regular updates on market trends, competitive landscape, project pipeline, and sales forecasts to support strategic decision-making.

• Lead country-level market mapping , demand analysis, competitive intelligence, and customer segmentation

• Compliance & Governance
Ensure all commercial activities comply with local legal requirements, industry regulations, and company policies and procedures.

• Other Duties
Perform any additional business related tasks assigned by the superior to support business objectives.

Educational background

• Degree in Chemical Engineering or closely related disciplines such as Process Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with proven process equipment and mass transfer experience.

Professional experience & knowledge

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Upstream, Refinery, Chemical & Petrochemical industry

• Knowledge

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Engenharia
Sales Engineering Metals
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Expert is responsible for providing technical expertise during the sales process, supporting the development of tailored solutions for clients, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and product capabilities.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Role Overview
In this role, you will actively shape and develop the Metals market in Mexico by working closely with end customers, EPCs, and distributors to create tailored technical and commercial solutions. Leveraging our portfolio of pumps, mixers, and water treatment solutions, you will help customers improve process efficiency, reliability, and sustainability , in line with the strategic objectives of the Flow Division within the Water & Industry business unit.
Through regular customer engagement, strong technical understanding, and personal networking, you will build long‑term partnerships and position Sulzer as a trusted solution provider across the Mexican metals industry

Key Responsibilities
Market Development & Sales Strategy

• Implement and execute the sales strategy for the Metals segment in Mexico.

• Actively develop the market by identifying new opportunities, key accounts, and strategic projects.

• Build a sustainable pipeline that supports long‑term growth and profitability.

Customer, EPC & Distributor Engagement

• Establish and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with customers, EPCs, and selected distributors.

• Ensure early involvement in project development phases to influence technical solutions and specifications.

• Act as the main technical and commercial interface between Sulzer and assigned customers.

Solution Development

• Analyze customer processes and operational challenges.

• Leverage deep knowledge of the Sulzer portfolio to develop customized, competitive, and value‑adding solutions.

• Demonstrate clear customer value through improved performance, reliability, lifecycle cost reduction, and sustainability.

Proposals & Contract Management

• Prepare and manage formal technical and commercial proposals, ensuring clarity in scope, pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.

• Coordinate internally with engineering, product management, service, and operations teams to deliver accurate and competitive offers.

• Support negotiations and order intake in line with margin and risk guidelines.

Market & Trend Monitoring

• Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, and competitor activity.

• Translate market intelligence into targeted sales and marketing actions.

• Contribute to segment strategy, forecasting, and opportunity planning.

Success in This Role Looks Like

• Strong presence and credibility in the Mexican metals industry

• Early positioning in EPC‑driven projects

• Consistent opportunity creation and conversion

• Long‑term customer partnerships and repeat business

• Profitable growth aligned with Flow Division strategy

What we offer you

NA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Téchnicien Service/Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Technicien de Service (Field Service Technician) chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients. Vous assurerez un service de haute qualité, garantissant la satisfaction client et le bon fonctionnement de nos produits.

Responsabilités**

* Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre.
* Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs.
* Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits.
* Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.).
* Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome.
* Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique).
* Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur.
* Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes.
* Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel.
* Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques).
* Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure.
* Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe.
* Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client.
* Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national).
* Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable.
* Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Consultor(a) de RH
Inside Technical Sales
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for reviewing plans, technical specifications and drawings to determine JWC product mix recommendation and pricing to be included in proposals. Principle Duties and 
• Responsibilities:
· Effectively respond to the requests and requirements of outside sales team and Consulting Engineers to ensure that current and prospective customers are being communicated consistently on all the Company’s product lines.
· Communicates and follows-up with manufacturer’s representative network to provide specifications and technical sales information to influence Consulting Engineers, contractors and end-user customers.
· Reviews technical specifications and customers’ requirements to determine JWC product mix.
· Completes Formal Quotes and Direct Bids as required.
· Works closely with sales managers, Consulting Engineers to quote and provide correct product mix at a profitable price.
· Follows-up with reps and prospective customers on quotation/proposal status.
· Reviews purchase orders and provide feedback to Contract Administration if terms are unclear or if PO is not valid.
· Resolves customer concerns in a timely manner, understands customer’s needs, applications and specifications.
· Works closely with outside sales staff, R&D and Operations in order to prepare timely and accurate proposals.
· Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.
· Perform other duties and special projects as assigned
Education, Experience & Skills:
Required: Associates Degree in a Technical area or 2 years of related experience
Desirable: CSI specification certification
· 1-2+ years with technical sales, Applications Engineering or Sales Engineering in the North American public works industry. Preferably wastewater treatment industry.
· Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as outstanding overall presentation skills.
· Demonstrated ability to perform equipment take-offs from bid packages.
· Demonstrated ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications including basic knowledge of motor control electrical schematics
· Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)
· Highly self-motivated.
· Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.
· Outstanding business etiquette skills.
· Knowledge of products and technologies including current and potential applications.

Salary: $75K -90K

What we offer you

What we offer you:
401K plan with up to a 6% company match.
12 Paid Holidays.
Paid Time Off
Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability.
Health savings account with employer matching
4 weeks of paid parental leave
Motivating wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: HR Administration & Payroll Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

Sulzer is an equal opportunity em

• Assicurare la registrazione tempestiva e la segnalazione alle istituzioni di sicurezza sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), fondi pensione (BVG/LPP), assicurazione contro gli infortuni (UVG), KTG e assegni familiari.
• Supporta cicli di rendimento e compensazione annuali da un punto di vista amministrativo.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche interne, del GDPR e delle normative sulla protezione dei dati svizzere. Sistemi HR e ottimizzazione dei processi
• Mantenere e ottimizzare i sistemi HRIS e time-tracking (ad esempio, SAP, Workday, Abacus o simili).
• Assicurare l'accuratezza e l'affidabilità dei dati per la segnalazione e l'analisi.
• Miglioramento del processo di guida e standardizzazione attraverso l'amministrazione HR e payroll.
• Supporta l'implementazione di nuovi strumenti e soluzioni HR digitali.
• Compliance, Politiche e Governance.
• Assicurare il pieno rispetto del diritto del lavoro svizzero, degli accordi collettivi di lavoro (se applicabili) e delle politiche aziendali.
• Mantenere i quadri di governance delle risorse umane e sostenere gli audit delle risorse umane.
• Tenere aggiornato con i cambiamenti normativi e tradurli in processi operativi. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno
• Laurea in Risorse Umane, Business Administration, o in un campo relativo.
• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione delle risorse umane e nel libro paga svizzero (obbligatorio).
• Forte comprensione del diritto del lavoro svizzero, del sistema di sicurezza sociale, delle imposte e della conformità all'occupazione.
• L'esperienza in ambienti multinazionali è un bene.
• Forte competenza MS Office e HRIS; competenze del sistema payroll richiesto.
• Fluente in tedesco e inglese.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie est chargé de diriger et de superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH et les opérations de paye de bout en bout pour la Suisse. Ce rôle assure le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des règlements de sécurité sociale, des obligations fiscales et des politiques internes. Le poste est le principal point de contact pour les opérations des RH, l'administration du cycle de vie des employés, l'exactitude de la paye et l'intégrité du système des RH. Le rôle doit être exécuté de façon pratique, en assurant des processus de RH efficaces et une prestation de services de haute qualité aux employés et aux gestionnaires. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités Gestion de la paie (Swiss Payroll)
• Surveiller et exécuter la paie mensuelle de tous les employés suisses, y compris la rémunération variable, les indemnités, les déductions et les absences.
• Gérer les contrôles des états de paie, les rapprochements, les audits et les activités d'établissement de rapports.
• Assurer un calcul correct des impôts, des cotisations de sécurité sociale, des retenues sur fonds de pension et des primes d'assurance.
• Agir en tant que contact clé pour les employés sur les questions de paie, de prestations et de gestion du temps.
• Collaborer avec le ministère des Finances à la comptabilité des états de paie, à la fourniture des salaires et à la vérification des comptes.
• Gérer les activités de fin d'année (certificats de salaire, clôture de l'année fiscale de retenue, déclaration de sécurité sociale) Administration des RH et gestion du cycle de vie des employés
• Agir en tant que conseiller en ressources humaines de confiance auprès des cadres et des dirigeants basés en Suisse
• Gérer et superviser tous les processus administratifs de RH pour l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés (embauche à la retraite).
• Préparer des contrats de travail, des amendements, des lettres de référence et d'autres documents juridiques conformément au droit suisse.
• Assurer la maintenance exacte des dossiers des employés et des fichiers numériques du personnel.
• Gérer les processus d'embarquement et de hors-bord, y compris les permis de travail (L, B, C) et la liaison avec les autorités.
• Veiller à ce que les institutions de sécurité sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), les fonds de pension (BVG/LPP), l'assurance contre les accidents (UVG), le KTG et les bureaux d'allocations familiales soient enregistrés et informés en temps voulu.
• Soutenir les cycles annuels de performance et de rémunération du point de vue administratif.
• Assurer le respect des politiques internes, du RGPD et des réglementations suisses en matière de protection des données. Systèmes RH et optimisation des processus
• Maintenir et optimiser les systèmes HRIS et de suivi du temps (par exemple SAP, Workday, Abacus ou similaire).
• Assurer l'exactitude et la fiabilité des données pour les rapports et les analyses.
• Favoriser l'amélioration des processus et la normalisation de l'administration des RH et des états de paie.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de nouveaux outils et de solutions numériques RH.
• Conformité, politiques et gouvernance.
• Assurer le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des conventions collectives (le cas échéant) et des politiques de l'entreprise.
• Maintenir les cadres de gouvernance des RH et appuyer les audits des RH.
• Se tenir au courant des changements réglementaires et les traduire en processus opérationnels. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin
• Diplôme en ressources humaines, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe.
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans l'administration des RH et la paie suisse (obligatoire).
• Une bonne compréhension du droit du travail, du système de sécurité sociale, des impôts et de l'emploi.
• L'expérience dans les environnements multinationaux est un atout.
• Compétences solides du MS Office et du HRIS; compétences requises du système de paye.
• En allemand et en anglais.
• Temps de travail: 80 - 100 %. Aucun visa ou permis de travail ne peut être fourni pour ce rôle. Avez-vous une question sur le rôle? Contactez Alexi Donadoni à l'adresse alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 25 jours de congé (excluant les jours fériés) + jours de service
• Régime de pension à cotisations déterminées
• Programme d'aide aux employés/soins de santé
• Parking sur place/indemnité de transport public
• Accès à une large gamme de réductions Sulzer est une égalité des chances

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This role sets day-to-day operational objectives, ensures adherence to procedures, and supports the delivery of high-quality technical services to customers.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung

• Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen oder kritischen Serviceeinsätzen

• Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der Servicequalität sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards (u. a. DGUV, ATEX)

• Durchführung und Begleitung von Safety Walks, Schulungen und technischen Unterweisungen

• Monitoring zentraler Service‑KPIs wie Auslastung, Reaktionszeiten und Qualitätskennzahlen

• Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen, Fehleranalysen und Kundeneskalationen

• Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Service in allen personal‑ und organisationsrelevanten Themen

• Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen im Field Service

• Perspektivische Weiterentwicklung in die Rolle des elektrischen Betriebsleiters (Zeithorizont 1–3 Jahre)

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker, Elektromeister zwingend erforderlich

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Serviceumfeld; erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik

• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke

• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit

• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)

• Wohnort im Raum Bonn oder angrenzend

What we offer you

• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld

• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten

• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team

• Marktgerechte Vergütung

• Zugang zu einem Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen

• JobRad‑Leasing

• Kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee & Wasser), Obstkorb und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This role sets day-to-day operational objectives, ensures adherence to procedures, and supports the delivery of high-quality technical services to customers. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben
• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung
• Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen oder kritischen Serviceeinsätzen
• Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der Servicequalität sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards (u. a. DGUV, ATEX)
• Durchführung und Begleitung von Safety Walks, Schulungen und technischen Unterweisungen
• Monitoring zentraler Service‑KPIs wie Auslastung, Reaktionszeiten und Qualitätskennzahlen
• Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen, Fehleranalysen und Kundeneskalationen
• Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Service in allen personal‑ und organisationsrelevanten Themen
• Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen im Field Service
• Perspektivische Weiterentwicklung in die Rolle des elektrischen Betriebsleiters (Zeithorizont 1–3 Jahre) Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker, Elektromeister zwingend erforderlich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Serviceumfeld; erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von Vorteil
• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik
• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke
• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit
• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)
• Wohnort im Raum Bonn oder angrenzend What we offer you
• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld
• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten
• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team
• Marktgerechte Vergütung
• Zugang zu einem Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen
• JobRad‑Leasing
• Kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee & Wasser), Obstkorb und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die die kaufmännische und organisatorische Abwicklung von Standard‑ und Projektaufträgen übernimmt. In dieser Position koordinieren Sie Termine, begleiten Projekte im Tagesgeschäft und stehen in engem Austausch mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern. Wenn Sie kaufmännisches Know‑how mit technischem Verständnis verbinden und gerne strukturiert sowie eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Ganzheitliche Abwicklung technisch und kaufmännisch vorbereiteter Standard‑ und Projektaufträge

• Terminplanung, ‑koordination und ‑überwachung im Projektverlauf

• Beantragung projektbezogener Bürgschaften sowie Erstellung von Anzahlungs‑, Teil‑ und Schlussrechnungen

• Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von Vertragsprotokollen

• Laufende Abstimmung und Korrespondenz mit internen Fachbereichen, Außendienst, Kunden, Lieferanten, Speditionen und Bauleitern (Deutsch & Englisch)

• Lieferantenkommunikation und ‑verhandlungen

• Materialdisposition sowie Organisation und Überwachung von Lieferterminen und Transporten

• Prüfung, Freigabe und Buchung projektbezogener Lieferantenrechnungen

• Überwachung von Zahlungseingängen und Bearbeitung des Mahnwesens

• Erstellung prüfbarer Aufmaße nach Vorgabe

• Bearbeitung von Reklamationen, Retouren und Rechnungskorrekturen

• Übernahme fachspezifischer Sonderaufgaben im Projekt‑ und Tagesgeschäft

Ihr Profil:

• Mehrjährige kaufmännische Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in einem technisch geprägten Umfeld, mit gutem technischem Verständnis

• Sicherer Umgang mit Standardsoftware (z. B. MS Office)

• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Erfahrung mit dem ERP-System iScala sowie Grundkenntnisse in SAP von Vorteil

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse

• Kundenorientiertes Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

• Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

What we offer you

• Selbstbestimmtes und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten

• Kostenloser Obstkorb, Kaffee und Wasser

• Ein starkes, hilfsbereites Team mit gutem Zusammenhalt

• Moderne Arbeitsmittel

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit definierten Kernarbeitszeiten

• 30 Tage Urlaub

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) Entrada de Pedidos
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment.
Principais Atividades

• Realizar a entrada de pedidos no sistema conforme informações recebidas da equipe comercial ou clientes

• Conferir dados de pedidos, como preços, prazos, condições comerciais e cadastros

• Apoiar na correção de inconsistências e acompanhamento de pendências

• Auxiliar na comunicação com áreas internas (Vendas, Logística, Financeiro)

• Manter registros e controles atualizados

• Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios simples e rotinas administrativas

Requisitos Básicos

• Cursando Administração, Gestão Comercial, Logística, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins

• Pacote Office básico

What we offer you

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
Vale refeição e transporte público
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technico-commercial sédentaire / Inside Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Technico-commercial sédentaire chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez un élément clé de notre équipe commerciale, chargé de développer et de maintenir d'excellentes relations avec nos clients, tout en assurant la promotion et la vente de nos solutions techniques.

Responsabilités**

* Gérer un portefeuille de clients existants et le cas échéant, prospecter de nouveaux clients par téléphone et par e-mail.
* Analyser les besoins techniques des clients et leur proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits (pompes, agitateurs, etc.).
* Élaborer des offres commerciales détaillées et techniques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de production.
* Négocier les conditions commerciales et conclure les ventes.
* Assurer le suivi des commandes, de la réception à la livraison, en coordination avec les services internes.
* Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients et les conseiller sur l'utilisation de nos produits.
* Participer à l'élaboration de la stratégie commerciale et au reporting des activités.
* Maintenir une veille technologique et concurrentielle sur le marché.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme technique (Bac+2 à Bac+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en vente de produits techniques industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou équipements rotatifs.
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).
* Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe.
* Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et proactivité.
* La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est un plus.

What we offer you

;

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Machining Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Field Machining Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Key Responsibilities

• Supervise production or service staff and assign daily tasks.

• Monitor workflow and ensure production targets are met.

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.

• Maintain equipment and report maintenance needs.

• Train new employees and support skill development.

• Identify process improvements and implement changes.

• Communicate production status to management.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically requires a technical degree and several years of relevant work experience to be able to manage and coordinate one or more professional-level teams.

• Experience in manufacturing or production supervision.

• Strong leadership and organizational skills.

• Knowledge of safety and quality standards.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues.

• Effective communication and team coordination skills.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The jobholder will work closely with Regional Head of Sales, Segment heads, and their own team to drive Strategic and Tactical initiatives (GDP), manage the marketing team, ensure integration and utilization of business optimization tools, and generally support the sales management team. The position will ensure GDP initiatives are organized and executed monthly and facilitate the data collection of the required TTI’s. Regional marketing will prioritize activities that are in alignment with these initiatives.

Business excellence processes and tools (Salesforce, CPQ, etc.) will be supported by driving adoption and execution of the tools monitoring utilization and escalating any roadblocks or lack of adoption issues as well as overseeing new product order entry management. A background in LEAN/VBSS or similar is considered beneficial to identify opportunities to simplify business processes especially from an internal efficiency and/or customer perspective. Targeted location: Within traveling distance of Easley, SC

Main accountabilities and tasks

• Organize and support the GDP initiatives

• Partner with the segment heads to develop, track, and report on the various action plans

• Work with business analyst personnel to automate the collection of TTI data

• Collect and communicate performance data, market insights, and opportunities to assist sales teams and services (collect KPI’s, structure data, visual management, etc.)

• Coordinate Regional marketing managers’ activities

• Combine marketing promotion, analytics, and GDP/initiatives together to coordinate and focus resources

• Oversee management of marketing communication and Marketing Initiatives

• Support channel partners development programs

• Support sales leadership to create and manage the communication flow on the main social internal and external

• Focus on execution and waste removal in business processes, primarily in Sales and Service activities Drive Sales Support department providing data intelligence to sales leaders to facilitate businesses.

• Organize and oversee data mining, accessibility to data in various systems (ERPs)

• Management level dashboard creation and maintenance

• Support Business Intelligence data collection and Analysis.

• Coordinate with other functions that SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf and other main systems are developed according to business requirements.

• Liaise with Finance and with Strategy (Budgeting Process, by Segment, by Region, by Product)

• Regular Pipeline Review and CRM maintenance

• Trainer for SalesForce

• Rolling Forecast management, both for OI (Order Intake) and Sales

• Partner with sales leaders and corporate business development personnel to track timely execution of key tasks

• Assist with preparation for corporate presentations and reports

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: National Sales Manager PPI
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads and develops Direct and Regional Sales Managers, implements sales strategies, and supports the Pulp and Paper market. This position has direct accountability for all PPI sales activities, both direct and indirect, in the USA. This role will necessitate effective collaboration and coordination with operations, procurement, quality, and other relevant departments. Essential Functions:

• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans.

• Lead the RSM’s, monitor individual performance against goals, and provide coaching, mentoring, and training.

• Responsible for ownership and personal management of the direct corporate accounts. Develops trust and solid partnerships with Corporate and OEM accounts. Negotiates and manages agreements with both.

• Engages collaboratively with technical associations and partners with leading technical universities.

• Analyze and identify market trends, and the competition to jointly develop strategic plans for expanding sales of new and existing products.

• Travel, as necessary within the assigned territory.

Other Duties:

• Must possess superior presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Experience with multiple direct reports and a proven history of leading teams.

• Superior analytical, strategic thinking, leadership skills.

• Demonstrated success through focus, good judgment, and decision-making.

• Keen sense of teamwork and business goal alignment.

• Well-developed sense of urgency to deliver results.

• Excellent relationship and people skills.

Supervisory Duties:

• Network of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists covering the PPI market.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred. MBA is a plus.

• At least 10-15 years’ regional sales experience.

• At least 5 years people management experience.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: IT Apprentice (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The IT Jr. Support is responsible for performing basic IT support tasks such as setting up equipment, assisting users, and following standard procedures. This role works under supervision and supports routine IT operations. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with hardware and software setup and configuration.

• Provide basic technical support to users.

• Follow standard procedures for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Maintain IT equipment and workspace organization.

• Escalate issues to senior support staff as needed.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Qualifications

• Basic understanding of IT hardware and software.

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office is a plus.

A requirement is that you will take part in the BBL program "ICT Support Technician" or "ICT system engineer" in Nijmegen (ROC), Arnhem (Rijn IJssel), or Breda (Curio). You attend school one day a week and work four days at our company.

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

• Desenvolver, implementar e controlar programas e sistemas de gestão, garantia e controle da qualidade;

• Conduzir análises, pesquisas e melhorias contínuas em métodos, processos, formulações e padrões de qualidade;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a modificação de metodologias relacionadas à confiabilidade, ensaios e processos produtivos;

• Realizar acompanhamento técnico e suporte especializado às áreas envolvidas em auditorias, inspeções e projetos internos.

Habilidades Necessárias

• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica/Produção e áreas afins;

• Conhecimento das normas de execução e critérios de aceitação de Ensaios Não Destrutivos (END);

• Conhecimento em Metrologia e interpretação de desenho mecânico;

• Conhecimento em Gestão da Qualidade;

• Inglês intermediário.

What we offer you

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida.
Vale alimentação e refeição no local.
Vale transporte e/ou fretado.
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass.
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
Previdência privada.
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Order Entry & Tendering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Bajo la posición de Orden entry & tendering, el Especialista en Entrada de Órdenes es responsable de ingresar, gestionar y dar seguimiento a todas las órdenes de materiales y servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos, así como de las directivas, procedimientos de trabajo y políticas vigentes de la compañía.
Adicionalmente, colabora en la generación de cotizaciones, brinda apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas y, previa solicitud, realiza otras tareas relacionadas acordes a su función. Responsabilidades:

• Gestionar los pedidos de clientes desde la recepción de la orden hasta su correcta facturación.

• Asegurar la conciliación de los pedidos recibidos con las cotizaciones previamente emitidas o con las listas de precios vigentes.

• Ejecutar y controlar todas las funciones asociadas a la entrada de pedidos y facturación, incluyendo aquellos relacionados con la fabricación de productos para clientes.

• Realizar la entrada de pedidos en SAP, manteniendo comunicación permanente y coordinando la planificación con el equipo de ventas, hasta su facturación.

• Elaborar cotizaciones comerciales, asegurando el correcto uso de precios, condiciones comerciales y políticas internas.

• Brindar apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas, incluyendo gestión documental, actualización de información en sistemas, apoyo en informes y coordinación interna.

• Elaborar y presentar informes de ventas periódicos.

• Demostrar habilidad para seguir métodos y procedimientos establecidos, trabajo en equipo, criterio profesional, atención al detalle y capacidad de comunicación clara y concisa, tanto oral como escrita.

• Asegurar la correcta calidad de la información comercial y contractual en SAP, cumpliendo con políticas internas y estándares de compliance.

• Apoyar análisis básicos de ventas, backlog y desempeño comercial, contribuyendo a la mejora continua de los procesos.

• Coordinar con fábrica y logística para validar fechas de entrega, disponibilidad y condiciones de despacho

• Colaborar en iniciativas de mejora continua en procesos de order entry, cotizaciones y tendering.

Requisitos:

• Técnico de Nivel Superior o Universitario

• 5 años mínimos de experiencia previa contrastable en posición similar

• Tener habilidades sociales y capacidad para resolver problemas en un grupo de trabajo

• Manejo de idiomas español e inglés, competencias completas.

• Dedicación (aprender, adaptar, gestionar), Disposición y Compromiso.

• Buen conocimiento del entorno informático, incluido SAP y la suite Office.

What we offer you

Beneficios:

• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.

• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro médico y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role involves providing engineering troubleshooting & solutions. Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts. Manage internal and external subcontracted work. Develop repair specifications, drawings, forms, and processes. Including support project management
Technical Representative

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:
Responsible for all technical information and specifications for each project including:
• Repair specifications, Inspection forms, drawings / prints, material specifications
• Respond to internal requests for inspection and budgetary repair work scopes
• Issue inspection work scopes and estimates
• Review inspection results and evaluate repair solutions
• Write repair work scopes and submit estimates
• Maintain/update repair and inspection service profile templates
• Provide engineering troubleshooting & solutions
• Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Engineering degree or at least 4 years’ experience in turbo machinery.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Jerome Blalack at Jerome.Blalack@sulzer.com or Hiring Manager – Billy Bottera.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A machinist needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Position Summary:

A Machinist is a professional that uses different techniques to create and make very precise metal parts. A machinist should be able to operate and maintain industrial machines, produce precision tools, interpret technical drawings and instructions, and ensure safety and quality standards. A machinist also needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Responsibilities:

Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Machine personnel, Supervisor, and Lead Man
Capable of setting up & operating all machines in the shop (including large mills, lathes, tool post grinders, and other equipment)
Operate manual and automatic feeds to 0.0002” as required for final cuts
Complete assigned jobs start to finish with little or no supervision. This includes the ability to perform the following:
Read blueprints, drawings and sketches that may require intermediate math and problems solving skills to calculate dimensions not specified on print.
Have and maintain ability to use and operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts
Maintain LEAN objectives within the department

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

Experience as a Manual machinist
Experience with both CNC with manual experience
Field machinist Manual Machinist

Shift:
Work hours are subject to change & will be determined by workload and shift coverage needs. Typically, Day Shift will start at 5:00AM or 7am and end at 3:30PM; Typically, Night Shift will start at 3:30PM and will end at 12am or 2am.

jobs.title: Rotor Balance Tech
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts. Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for gas turbines. Rotor Balance Tech

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts.

• Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for Gas turbines.

• Read/interpret indicators accurately within .0001”. Read and understand the required technical information for the job. Properly complete all associated documentation required for their assignments.

• Continuously develop knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties. Complete company-required training programs .

• Communicate with co-workers, leads & supervisor on projects. Work well with other employees. Follow company Safety, Quality Policies, and ISO procedures.

• Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the schedule time . Keep work area clear and well organized during all phases of the project

• Comply with the requirements of risk assessments and safety procedures. Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Mechanical aptitude, reliability, integrity, teamwork & strong work ethic.

• Rotating equipment experience is preferred but not required.

• Balance experience is preferred but not required.

• Willing to work overtime.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
