• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung umfassender Leistungsmanagement-Frameworks für funktions- und geographisch unterschiedliche Teams
• Verwalten von Großkapitalprogrammen und Überwachung der Kosten-, Preis- und Rentabilitätsmodellierung.

jobs.title: Service Center Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Perform routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, and mail handling.
Support scheduling and meeting coordination.
Maintain office supplies and assist with logistics.
Follow instructions and escalate non-routine issues.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic administrative and organizational skills.
Ability to follow instructions and procedures.
Familiarity with office tools and systems.
Willingness to learn and support team needs.

What we offer you

Country Benefits:

Follow instructions and complete assigned duties.

Support team members as needed.

DEPARTMENT: Product Engineering
SUPERVISOR: Supervisor Pump Design
SALARY GRADE: N/A
FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt

The Product Development (PD) group is involved in the design, validation and documentation of new product design and upgrades to existing product ranges. The successful candidate will work on project support as assigned by Engineers in the PD group.

Position is full-time during the summer.

% OF TIME

Training will be given to accomplish the following:

· Hands-on support of component testing and data collection.
· Drafting support using NX 3D/2D system
· Engineering support work for projects as assigned
· Release of drawings / documents through SAP & Teamcenter ERP systems

· Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
· Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide ESG & EHS Management systems, which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
· Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of freshman year of BSc Mechanical Engineering degree.
· Excellent interpersonal, communication and analytical skills.
· Sound computer skills in Word and Excel.
· Experience with 2D and 3D CAD systems
· An Interest in rotating machinery and manufacturing is beneficial.

jobs.title: Early Careers Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

​Company Overview:

Sulzer Services is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the Rotating Equipment industry. Sulzer Services specializes in the repairs and overhaul of gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors, pumps and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Power Generation industries.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Early Career Programs Specialist to develop and execute our internship and new-hire rotational programs. This role will also provide support to the Training Program Manager with strategic initiatives. Additional responsibilities include internal communications such as newsletters, program updates, department calendars, e-learning content creation, and designing promotional content for training programs. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating developmental programs that provide emerging talent with meaningful learning experiences. This role requires a blend of project management, instructional design, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure program success and alignment with organizational goals. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Develop and execute comprehensive new hire rotational programs that align with organizational objectives and provide participants with structured learning experiences.

• Internship program: establish program and enhance for growth throughout the region and product lines.

• Work closely with department managers and HR to define program goals, identify skill gaps, and ensure alignment with business needs.

• Lead the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and facilitating onboarding to integrate interns and new hire rotational employees effectively.

• Manage all logistical aspects of the programs, including scheduling, venue arrangements, coordinating with volunteers, and resource allocation.

• Monitor and assess program effectiveness through feedback, performance metrics, and evaluations to ensure continuous improvement.

• Assist the Training Program Manager in developing and implementing training strategies that align with organizational goals including but not limited to developing e-learning content, maintaining training calendars, and developing procedures.

• Maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring accurate entry and upkeep of training records, course schedules, and participant data.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a Program Coordinator or similar role, with a track record of coordinating comprehensive internship and rotational programs in a corporate environment.

• 3–5 years of experience in training and development, program coordinator, or a similar role.

• Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage timelines, logistics, and multiple stakeholders.

• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, managers, and external partners.

• Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning platforms.

• Ability to analyze data and assess the effectiveness of training programs.

• Familiarity with instructional design theory and adult learning principles.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Mot

jobs.title: Technical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Designs and delivers hands on mechanical training courses (1–2 weeks) that build foundational and advanced turbomachinery skills, guiding new hires through core concepts, job book exercises, and real-world inspection and assembly practices while evaluating their proficiency. Develops and continuously improves training curricula, materials, and programs to address skill gaps, enhance safety and productivity, and ensure effective onboarding and ongoing workforce upskilling. Responsibilities

• Leading novice mechanical training courses
• Helping to develop the next generation of mechanical talent within our organization
• Guiding groups through the critical job book exercises

• Teaching refined mechanical skills throughout the disassembly, inspection and reassembly stages of an overall

• Verifying an employee’s ability to apply measurement methods to real world inspection scenarios

• Guide new hires through basic terminology and turbomachinery overview

• Identify current and future training needs and create a curriculum to facilitate that training

• Refining and developing mechanical training materials
• Advancing the modules that have already been created

• Building out adjacent training modules for other equipment types

• Developing training aides for specialized tasks.

• Leading periodic advance mechanical upskilling training efforts

• Supporting aspects of new hire shop orientation

• Supporting occasional outage Production Supervision responsibilities/oversight

• Search for gaps in training content and materials that need updating to generate higher productivity and safety among staff

• Researching new training supplies and materials that can enhance Sulzer’s training procedures while providing value to employees

• Communicating with management, trainers, and team members to ensure that all training needs are met

• Conducting technical orientation programs and arranging on-the-job training for new hires as needed

• Resolving any specific problems and tailoring training programs as necessary

• Provide documentation of employees performance during training to supervision and upper management including aptitude, attitude, and academic performance.

• Maintain records from all training classes.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Education, or similar related disciplines and/or a combination of training, experience, and education.

• 5 or more years of technical training experience in an industrial and/or manufacturing setting

• Significant experience creating technical training curriculums and programs

• Ability to plan, manage time, and multitask effectively

• Advanced database and computer skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Advanced record-keeping skills

• Good decision-making, problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork skills

• Leadership and motivational skills are a plus

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Ireland’s essential water and industrial infrastructure rely on the expertise and responsiveness of Sulzer’s service teams. As our Irish business continues to grow, we’re strengthening our commercial and technical capability with a newly created Tendering Engineer role—sitting at the centre of proposal development, technical evaluation, and securing future work across our service and aftermarket operations. This is your opportunity to become a key link between engineering, customers, and suppliers, helping shape technically sound and commercially competitive solutions.

Working in a blended model (office, home, and site/customer visits) and based in either Dublin or Wexford, you will take ownership of the full tendering lifecycle. This will include reviewing customer requirements, carrying out technical assessments (including pump selection and sizing), building accurate costings, and coordinating with internal teams and external suppliers to develop high-quality proposals. As demand continues to grow and with evolving customer needs, this role is critical in supporting business expansion, securing new opportunities, and ensuring we maintain a strong technical and commercial offering across Ireland. Key Duties

• Take ownership of the end-to-end tendering process for service and equipment opportunities

• Review client specifications and translate requirements into practical, engineered solutions

• Carry out pump selection, sizing, and technical evaluations to ensure optimal performance and compliance

• Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals, ensuring accuracy and competitiveness

• Liaise with internal engineering, service teams, and external suppliers to build robust submissions

• Engage with customers to clarify requirements and support pre‑tender discussions where needed

• Analyse cost structures, risks, and margins to support sustainable business growth

• Maintain and improve tendering processes, tools, and technical documentation

• Support knowledge sharing across engineering, service, and commercial teams

What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking someone with a strong technical grounding in rotating equipment and a commercial mindset. You’ll be comfortable interpreting technical requirements, engaging with stakeholders, and translating engineering detail into winning proposals.
You should bring:

• Experience with pumps and rotating equipment (selection, sizing, or application knowledge highly desirable)

• Background in tendering, proposals, applications engineering, or a related technical-commercial role

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop costings and evaluate technical solutions

• Experience working within industrial, water, or process environments

• Ability to interpret specifications, drawings, and performance data

• Strong communication skills, with confidence engaging customers and internal teams

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple tenders simultaneously

What we offer you

As part of a global engineering group with over 160 locations worldwide and a multi‑billion‑franc annual turnover, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, innovate, and shape your career within a truly international organisation.

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working with defined core hours

• Generous annual leave allowance

• Strong pension scheme

• Free on‑site parking and EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Enhanced family‑friendly leave policies

• Access to structured learning and development pathways

• Genuine opportunities for global mobility and long‑term progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L’acqua essenziale dell’Irlanda e l’infrastruttura industriale si affidano all’esperienza e alla reattività dei team di assistenza di Sulzer. Mentre il nostro business irlandese continua a crescere, stiamo rafforzando la nostra capacità commerciale e tecnica con un nuovo ruolo di Ingegnere di Tendering, che si trova al centro dello sviluppo di proposte, della valutazione tecnica, e di garantire il lavoro futuro attraverso il nostro servizio e le operazioni di aftermarket. Questa è la tua occasione per diventare un collegamento chiave tra ingegneria, clienti e fornitori, aiutando a modellare soluzioni tecnicamente solide e commercialmente competitive. Lavorando in un modello misto (ufficio, casa e visite di sito/cliente) e con sede a Dublino o Wexford, si prenderanno la proprietà del ciclo di vita completo di tendering. Ciò includerà la revisione dei requisiti del cliente, l'esecuzione di valutazioni tecniche (compresa la selezione delle pompe e il dimensionamento), la costruzione di costi accurati, e il coordinamento con team interni e fornitori esterni per sviluppare proposte di alta qualità. Poiché la domanda continua a crescere e con l'evoluzione delle esigenze dei clienti, questo ruolo è fondamentale nel sostenere l'espansione aziendale, nel garantire nuove opportunità, e assicurandoci di mantenere una forte offerta tecnica e commerciale in tutta l'Irlanda. Doveri chiave
• Assumere la proprietà del processo di appalto end-to-end per opportunità di assistenza e attrezzature
• Verificare le specifiche del cliente e tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni pratiche e ingegnerizzate
• Eseguire la selezione della pompa, il dimensionamento e le valutazioni tecniche per garantire prestazioni e conformità ottimali
• Preparare proposte tecniche e commerciali dettagliate, garantendo precisione e competitività
• Liaise con l'ingegneria interna, i team di assistenza e i fornitori esterni per costruire presentazioni robuste
• Impegnarsi con i clienti per chiarire i requisiti e sostenere le discussioni pre-tender laddove necessario
• Analizzare le strutture dei costi, i rischi e i margini per sostenere la crescita sostenibile delle imprese
• Mantenere e migliorare i processi di appalto, gli strumenti e la documentazione tecnica
• Supporta la condivisione delle conoscenze tra team di ingegneria, servizio e commerciali Cosa stiamo cercando Stiamo cercando qualcuno con una forte messa a terra tecnica in attrezzature rotanti e una mentalità commerciale. Sarete a vostro agio a interpretare i requisiti tecnici, coinvolgendo con le parti interessate, e traducendo dettagli ingegneristici in proposte vincenti. Dovresti portare:
• Esperienza con pompe e attrezzature rotanti (selezione, dimensionamento o conoscenza delle applicazioni altamente auspicabile)
• Sfondo dell'offerta, delle proposte, dell'ingegneria delle applicazioni o di un ruolo tecnico-commerciale
• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di sviluppare costi e valutare soluzioni tecniche
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti industriali, acquatici o di processo
• Capacità di interpretare specifiche, disegni e dati delle prestazioni
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con fiducia coinvolgendo clienti e team interni
• Un approccio proattivo e dettagliato, con la capacità di gestire più gare contemporaneamente Cosa ti offriamo Nell’ambito di un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 160 sedi in tutto il mondo e un fatturato annuo multi-milioni-franco, avrai l’opportunità di crescere, innovare e plasmare la tua carriera all’interno di un’organizzazione veramente internazionale.

• Mensola sottosidrata in loco
• politiche di congedo per famiglie migliorate
• Accesso a percorsi di apprendimento e sviluppo strutturati
• Geniali opportunità per la mobilità globale e la progressione a lungo termine Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Noi

Da unser irisches Unternehmen weiter wächst, stärken wir unsere kommerzielle und technische Fähigkeit mit einer neu geschaffenen Tendering Engineer-Rolle – im Zentrum der Vorschlagsentwicklung, der technischen Bewertung und der Sicherung künftiger Arbeiten über unseren Service- und Aftermarket-Betrieb. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle L'Irlande compte sur l'expertise et la réactivité des équipes de service de Sulzer. Au fur et à mesure que notre activité en Irlande continue de croître, nous renforçons notre capacité commerciale et technique avec un nouveau rôle d'ingénieur d'appel d'offres – en étant au centre de l'élaboration de propositions, de l'évaluation technique et en assurant des travaux futurs dans nos activités de service et de post-marché. C'est l'occasion de devenir un lien clé entre l'ingénierie, les clients et les fournisseurs, aidant à façonner des solutions techniquement saines et commercialement compétitives. Travaillant dans un modèle mixte (bureau, domicile, visites de site/client) et basé à Dublin ou Wexford, vous serez propriétaire du cycle de vie complet de l'appel d'offres. Il s'agira notamment d'examiner les besoins des clients, d'effectuer des évaluations techniques (y compris la sélection et le calibrage des pompes), d'établir des coûts précis et de coordonner l'élaboration de propositions de haute qualité avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs externes. Au fur et à mesure que la demande continue de croître et que les besoins des clients évoluent, ce rôle est essentiel pour soutenir l'expansion des entreprises, obtenir de nouvelles possibilités et nous assurer de maintenir une offre technique et commerciale solide dans toute l'Irlande. Principales fonctions
• Prendre en charge le processus d'appel d'offres de bout en bout pour les possibilités de service et d'équipement
• Examiner les spécifications du client et traduire les exigences en solutions pratiques et conçues
• Effectuer la sélection des pompes, le calibrage et les évaluations techniques pour assurer une performance et une conformité optimales
• Préparer des propositions techniques et commerciales détaillées, garantissant l'exactitude et la compétitivité
• Assurer la liaison avec l'ingénierie interne, les équipes de services et les fournisseurs externes pour construire des soumissions robustes
• S'engager auprès des clients pour clarifier les exigences et soutenir les discussions pré-tendance au besoin
• Analyser les structures de coûts, les risques et les marges pour soutenir la croissance durable des entreprises
• Maintenir et améliorer les processus d'appel d'offres, les outils et la documentation technique
• Soutenir le partage des connaissances entre les équipes d'ingénierie, de service et de commerce Ce que nous cherchons Nous recherchons quelqu'un avec une forte base technique dans l'équipement rotatif et un état d'esprit commercial. Vous serez à l'aise d'interpréter les exigences techniques, d'engager les parties prenantes et de traduire les détails d'ingénierie en propositions gagnantes. Vous devriez apporter:
• Expérience avec les pompes et l'équipement rotatif (sélection, calibrage ou connaissance d'application hautement souhaitable)
• Contexte des appels d'offres, des propositions, de l'ingénierie des applications ou d'un rôle technique et commercial connexe
• Des compétences analytiques solides avec la capacité de développer des coûts et d'évaluer des solutions techniques
• Expérience de travail dans des environnements industriels, d'eau ou de procédés
• Capacité d'interpréter les spécifications, les dessins et les données de performance
• Fortes compétences en communication, avec confiance mobilisant les clients et les équipes internes
• Une approche proactive et axée sur les détails, capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs appels d'offres Ce que nous vous offrons Dans le cadre d'un groupe mondial d'ingénierie comptant plus de 160 sites dans le monde et un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plusieurs milliards de francs, vous aurez la possibilité de croître, d'innover et de façonner votre carrière au sein d'une organisation véritablement internationale.

• Indemnité de congé annuel généreuse
• Régime de retraite solide
• Parking gratuit sur place et recharge EV
• Une cantine subventionnée sur place

jobs.title: Jr. Logistics Officer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Junior Logistics Officer da soporte a las operaciones logísticas, incluyendo transporte, almacén y seguimiento de inventario, contribuyendo a garantizar un flujo eficiente de mercancías y materiales.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales junior que, bajo supervisión, aplican conocimientos teóricos básicos y desarrollan sus capacidades analíticas para la resolución de problemas, en colaboración con perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales

• Coordinar el transporte y la entrega de mercancías (nacional e internacional)

• Dar soporte a procesos de importación/exportación y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo

• Realizar el seguimiento de envíos y mantener actualizados los sistemas logísticos

• Preparar documentación de envío (facturas, packing lists, documentación aduanera, etc.)

• Apoyar en la gestión de pedidos internos y expediciones

• Comunicarse con proveedores, transportistas y equipos internos

• Monitorizar niveles de inventario y dar soporte a operaciones de almacén

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos logísticos y optimización de costes

Requisitos

• Formación Profesional o Grado en Logística, Supply Chain o similar

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia relevante (incluyendo prácticas)

• Conocimientos básicos de importación/exportación y procedimientos aduaneros

• Manejo de herramientas de gestión logística y Microsoft Office

Competencias

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y organización

• Atención al detalle y capacidad analítica

• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y cumplir plazos

• Actitud proactiva y orientación al trabajo en equipo

Idiomas

• Inglés: nivel B2 (intermedio-alto)

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinid o.

• Salario competitivo, así como participación en un sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y financieros.

• Ticket restaurante.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo: seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Un buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y consolidada.

• Incorporación a una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de las oficinas: RIVAS

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about engineering and looking for an exciting opportunity to grow your career? We have a vacancy at our Wexford Service Centre for a Service Engineer to join our dedicated team. This role involves servicing and installing industrial, municipal, and commercial wastewater and stormwater pumping equipment. Key Responsibilities:

• Planned Inspections & Maintenance : Conduct effective planned inspections, fault finding, and maintenance of pumping equipment at customer sites.

• Ownership & Initiative : Take an active role and ownership of your responsibilities.

• Technical Expertise : Demonstrate strong skills in the service and repair of wastewater equipment.

• Reporting : Complete repair, service, and technical reports accurately and timely.

• Work Environment : Support the company's drive to create a better working environment.

• Client Communication : Communicate effectively and liaise with our client base to ensure satisfaction and service excellence.

What We Are Looking For:

• Mechanical Ability : Strong mechanical skills and aptitude.

• Health & Safety : A dedicated approach to health and safety practices.

• Computer Skills : Proficiency in computer skills for reporting and communication.

• Interpersonal Skills : Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

• Team Player : Ability to work alone or as part of a team, under pressure and to deadlines.

• Attention to Detail : Excellent attention to detail in all aspects of the role

• Applicants must hold a full manual driving license. Automatic‑only licenses cannot be accepted for this role.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• An interesting and rewarding position with opportunities for career progression.

• Performance related bonus scheme related to personal and company performance paid end Q1 each year.

• Defined contribution pension scheme.

• Access to our Employee Assistance Programme.

• Additional ongoing training to enhance your skills.

• A real opportunity to grow your career with a global engineering company

• Working hours Mon-Fri hours 8:30-5:00 with flexi time depending on workloads.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SERVICE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Field Service Engineer es responsable de la instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos técnicos tanto en taller como en las instalaciones de cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales o intermedias de su carrera, que aplican conocimientos técnicos en entornos reales, analizan incidencias y proponen soluciones bajo la supervisión y coordinación de perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales

• Ejecutar trabajos de instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos en instalaciones de cliente y/o en taller

• Diagnosticar averías y resolver incidencias técnicas mecánicas y eléctricas

• Realizar tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo

• Apoyar en el montaje y desmontaje de equipos y sistemas

• Colaborar en la supervisión de instalaciones realizadas por proveedores externos

• Interpretar planos técnicos, manuales y despieces

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, seguridad y medioambiente

• Documentar las intervenciones realizadas y reportar incidencias

• Colaborar con equipos comerciales y técnicos en visitas a cliente cuando sea necesario

Requisitos

• Formación Profesional de Grado Medio o Superior en Electromecánica, Mecánica, Electricidad o similar

• Experiencia inicial o hasta 2-3 años en entornos industriales o de mantenimiento

• Conocimientos mecánicos y eléctricos (valorable hidráulica)

• Capacidad para interpretar planos y documentación técnica

• Manejo básico de herramientas informáticas (MS Office)

• Carnet de conducir y disponibilidad para desplazamientos

Competencias

• Atención al detalle y orientación a la calidad

• Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas técnicos

• Habilidad para trabajar de forma estructurada y metódica

• Autonomía, responsabilidad y orientación a resultados

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo

• Compromiso con la seguridad en el trabajo

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinido.

• Salario competitivo y participación en el sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y corporativos.

• Ticket restaurantes.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo, seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y con fuerte presencia global.

• Formar parte de una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de la oficina: SEVILLA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SERVICE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Field Service Engineer es responsable de la instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos técnicos tanto en taller como en las instalaciones de cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales o intermedias de su carrera, que aplican conocimientos técnicos en entornos reales, analizan incidencias y proponen soluciones bajo la supervisión y coordinación de perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales

• Ejecutar trabajos de instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos en instalaciones de cliente y/o en taller

• Diagnosticar averías y resolver incidencias técnicas mecánicas y eléctricas

• Realizar tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo

• Apoyar en el montaje y desmontaje de equipos y sistemas

• Colaborar en la supervisión de instalaciones realizadas por proveedores externos

• Interpretar planos técnicos, manuales y despieces

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, seguridad y medioambiente

• Documentar las intervenciones realizadas y reportar incidencias

• Colaborar con equipos comerciales y técnicos en visitas a cliente cuando sea necesario

Requisitos

• Formación Profesional de Grado Medio o Superior en Electromecánica, Mecánica, Electricidad o similar

• Experiencia inicial o hasta 2-3 años en entornos industriales o de mantenimiento

• Conocimientos mecánicos y eléctricos (valorable hidráulica)

• Capacidad para interpretar planos y documentación técnica

• Manejo básico de herramientas informáticas (MS Office)

• Carnet de conducir y disponibilidad para desplazamientos

Competencias

• Atención al detalle y orientación a la calidad

• Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas técnicos

• Habilidad para trabajar de forma estructurada y metódica

• Autonomía, responsabilidad y orientación a resultados

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo

• Compromiso con la seguridad en el trabajo

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinido.

• Salario competitivo y participación en el sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y corporativos.

• Ticket restaurantes.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo, seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y con fuerte presencia global.

• Formar parte de una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

El/La Sales Engineer (Industrial) da soporte al proceso comercial aportando conocimiento técnico, participando en la preparación de propuestas y colaborando en la definición de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales de su carrera, que combinan interés por la ingeniería y las ventas, analizan requisitos técnicos y contribuyen al desarrollo de oportunidades comerciales, trabajando en coordinación con equipos senior y otras áreas.

Ámbito de actuación: España y Portugal. Responsabilidades principales

• Apoyar en la preparación y presentación de propuestas técnico-comerciales

• Colaborar en el diseño de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente

• Dar soporte en reuniones y visitas comerciales con clientes

• Responder a consultas técnicas y comerciales, actuando como interlocutor de soporte

• Coordinarse con equipos de ingeniería y operaciones para asegurar la viabilidad de las propuestas

• Realizar seguimiento de ofertas y oportunidades comerciales

• Mantener actualizada la información de clientes y actividad comercial en el CRM

• Analizar el mercado y la competencia para identificar oportunidades de negocio

• Contribuir a la implementación de la estrategia comercial en el área asignada

Requisitos

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería (Industrial o similar) o formación equivalente

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia en entornos técnicos o comerciales

• Interés por el ámbito técnico-comercial en sector industrial

• Manejo de herramientas Microsoft Office y CRM (valorable Salesforce)

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de España y Portugal

Competencias

• Orientación al cliente y buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Capacidad analítica y de comprensión técnica

• Proactividad, iniciativa y actitud de aprendizaje

• Habilidades de organización y seguimiento

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Role Overview
In this role, you will actively shape and develop the Water and Wastewater market in Mexico by working closely with end customers, EPCs, and distributors to create tailored technical and commercial solutions. Leveraging our portfolio of pumps, mixers, and water treatment solutions, you will help customers improve process efficiency, reliability, and sustainability, in line with the strategic objectives of the Flow Division within the Water & Industry business unit.
Through regular customer engagement, strong technical understanding, and personal networking, you will build long term partnerships and position Sulzer as a trusted solution provider across the Mexican metals industry
Key Responsibilities
Market Development & Sales Strategy
• Implement and execute the sales strategy for the Water and Wastewater segment in Mexico.
• Actively develop the market by identifying new opportunities, key accounts, and strategic projects.
• Build a sustainable pipeline that supports long term growth and profitability.
Customer, EPC & Distributor Engagement
• Establish and maintain strong, trust based relationships with customers, EPCs, and selected distributors.
• Ensure early involvement in project development phases to influence technical solutions and specifications.
• Act as the main technical and commercial interface between Sulzer and assigned customers.
Solution Development
• Analyze customer processes and operational challenges.
• Leverage deep knowledge of the Sulzer portfolio to develop customized, competitive, and value adding solutions.
• Demonstrate clear customer value through improved performance, reliability, lifecycle cost reduction, and sustainability.
Proposals & Contract Management
• Prepare and manage formal technical and commercial proposals, ensuring clarity in scope, pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.
• Coordinate internally with engineering, product management, service, and operations teams to deliver accurate and competitive offers.
• Support negotiations and order intake in line with margin and risk guidelines.
Market & Trend Monitoring
• Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, and competitor activity.
• Translate market intelligence into targeted sales and marketing actions.
• Contribute to segment strategy, forecasting, and opportunity planning.
Success in This Role Looks Like
• Strong presence and credibility in the Mexican Water and Wastewater industry
• Early positioning in EPC driven projects
• Consistent opportunity creation and conversion
• Long term customer partnerships and repeat business
• Profitable growth aligned with Flow Division strategy * Benefits over law
* Training
* Aditional Christmas bonus
* Saving found

What we offer you

Prestaciones

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Manufacturing Quality Inspector is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs. This role ensures compliance with internal and regulatory standards and supports the timely delivery of quality products.
This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. SUMMARY: Performs receipt and in-process dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies. Create and record inspection results on appropriate inspection report using Microsoft Excel and Word. Reviews sub-contractor procedures and reports; and maintains department records and procedures for current code requirements. Position functions independently with occasional guidance from the Quality Assurance Manager.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

% OF TIME

jobs.title: Lean Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.

• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.

• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.

• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.

• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.

• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.

• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.

• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.

• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.

• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key Responsibilities include reviewing customer purchase orders & material BOM. Review drawings carefully to determine make or buy depending on costs and schedule. Handle multiple reports as needed to monitor multiple jobs and assist production with schedule. Assist in troubleshooting and basic maintenance. Collaborate with team members to meet production goals. Skills & Qualifications May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role. Basic mechanical and technical skills. Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Familiarity with safety and quality procedures. Willingness to learn and grow in a manufacturing environment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Collaborate with production teams to minimize downtime.
Train and support junior mechanics.
Follow safety and operational procedures.

Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Experience with industrial machinery and tools.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Position sind Sie die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Vertrieb und internen Fachbereichen. Sie begleiten den gesamten Sales‑Prozess von der Anforderungsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zur Umsetzung und stellen sicher, dass die Lösungen technisch fundiert und passgenau auf die Kundenbedürfnisse abgestimmt sind. Die Position richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die selbstständig arbeiten und ihre Expertise gezielt einbringen.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb von Nordic Water Lösungen:

• Filtrationssysteme (insb. 4. Reinigungsstufe / Spurenstoffe)

• MEVA-Rechen

• Zickert Schlammräumer

• Entwicklung und Ausbau eines regionalen Kundenportfolios (Bestandskunden + Neukunden)

• Identifikation und Bewertung von Projektchancen im kommunalen und industriellen Umfeld

• Technische Beratung und Ausarbeitung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen

• Verantwortung für den kompletten Angebotsprozess inkl. Kalkulation

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam für kommunale und industrielle Abwasserlösungen

• Präsentation von Lösungen bei Kunden, Planern und Entscheidern

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung und Klärung technischer Fragestellungen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) sowie mindestens 3–4 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

• Fundierter technischer Hintergrund im Bereich Engineering oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Erfahrung in strukturierten Vertriebs ‑ , Angebots ‑ oder Projektprozessen sowie ein gutes Prozessverständnis

• Sehr gute Kommunikations ‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und kundenorientiert darzustellen

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM ‑ Systemen sowie Sales ‑ Enablement ‑ Tools

• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und kundenorientiertes Denken

• Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 80%

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

jobs.title: FP&A Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Support the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget, providing accurate data and analysis

• Assist in refreshing predictive financial forecasts periodically, ensuring accuracy and relevance

• Help in conducting profitability and performance reporting, providing essential data for decision-making

• Contribute to plan analytics and risk management, assisting in the continuous improvement of financial planning and analysis processes

• Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support business recommendations, under the guidance of senior team members

• Support collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, aiding informed purchasing decisions

• Help oversee period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful financial reports and analytics

• Assist in period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Help oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting

• Support the adherence to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting and processes.

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus
Critical success factors

• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards

• Strong financial acumen

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders
Technical & language skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Sales Engineering Specialist provides advanced technical support to the sales team and clients, ensuring that complex customer requirements are met with tailored solutions. This role plays a key part in pre-sales and post-sales activities.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Lead technical discussions with clients and internal teams.
Design and present complex solutions.
Support RFP/RFI responses and technical documentation.
Collaborate with engineering and product development.
Provide training and mentorship to junior engineers.
Ensure customer satisfaction through technical excellence.
Stay informed on industry trends and innovations.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 5-7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Deep technical expertise in relevant products or systems.
Strong presentation and communication skills.
Experience in customer-facing technical roles.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects.
Proficiency in CRM and engineering tools.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Assistant is responsible for supporting project teams by maintaining schedules, tracking resources, and preparing progress reports. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy in routine tasks and provides coordination support across multiple projects.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

• Responsibilities
Maintain and update project schedules and resource plans.
Prepare and distribute project status and progress reports.
Coordinate meetings, documentation, and communication among project stakeholders.
Support project tracking and issue resolution processes.
Assist in maintaining project documentation and compliance records.

Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong organizational and time management skills.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Excel).
Effective communication and coordination abilities.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Familiarity with project documentation and reporting standards.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer - Utilities
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Summary**

Responsible for driving sales and providing technical expertise for Sulzer's pump solutions within the utilities sector across South Africa, ensuring customer satisfaction and achieving sales targets.

Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets for Sulzer pump products and services within the water, wastewater, power generation, and other utility industries.
* Identify and cultivate strong relationships with key decision-makers, engineering consultants, contractors, and end-users within the utilities market.
* Conduct technical presentations and product demonstrations to potential clients, effectively communicating the value proposition of Sulzer's solutions.
* Perform detailed technical analysis of customer requirements, recommending appropriate pump selections and system configurations.
* Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers in response to customer inquiries and tenders.
* Negotiate contracts and terms of sale, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements for Sulzer and its customers.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams, including engineering, project management, and after-sales service, to ensure seamless project execution and customer support.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and inform sales strategies.
* Provide post-sales technical support and troubleshoot issues to ensure customer satisfaction and repeat business.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and activity reports within the company's CRM system.
* Represent Sulzer at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety regulations.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of proven sales experience in the utilities sector, specifically with pumps, rotating equipment, or related fluid handling solutions.
* In-depth technical knowledge of pumps, pumping systems, and their applications within water/wastewater treatment, power generation, and other utility environments.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical requirements and propose effective solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen with a track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software.
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively throughout South Africa.

What we offer you

-

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Manage the team that performs hydraulic and functional tests for centrifugal pumps

• Ensure that area safety guidelines are met

jobs.title: NDT Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The NDT Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities

• Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.

• Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.

• Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.

• Document inspection results and report deviations.

• Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

• Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.

• Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.

• Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.

• Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.

• Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Jr. Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Production Worker / Technician is responsible for supporting the assembly and testing of products in a manufacturing environment. This role performs basic tasks under supervision and contributes to maintaining production quality and efficiency.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in assembling and testing products.
Follow safety and quality procedures.
Report defects and support troubleshooting.
Maintain tools and workstations.
Document production activities.
Learn and apply production techniques.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Basic technical and mechanical skills.
Willingness to learn and follow procedures.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Attention to detail and safety awareness.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Engineer serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
• Performs gage calibration for the measurement instruments for which there is in-house calibration capabilities;

• Selects and interacts with calibration vendors providing calibration services for manufacturing measurement instruments;

• Performs incoming inspection for designated parts. Fills out and files all the Vendor Corrective Action Requests for problems found in manufacturing;

• Participates in process improvement and scrap/rework reduction efforts throughout the manufacturing;

• Monitors the quality of vendor foundries as described in the quality system;

• Responsible for quality system documentation in his/her area. Facilitates compliance with procedures and work instructions

• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. Responsibilities

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

• Knowledge and understand of turbo machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 5 years or more of proven welding experience.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student, Apprentice, or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. SUMMARY:
The Engineering Intern works closely with the engineering department to assist with technical projects, design tasks, manufacturing processes, analysis, and documentation to gain practical, hands-on industry experience in nuclear rotating equipment design, manufacturing, and refurbishment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTION:

• Provide technical support for projects, including design, testing, and engineering calculations.

• Assist in creating and modifying drawings or models using CAD software.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Assist in creating technical reports, manuals, and documentation for projects.

• Interface with cross-functional teams (quality, manufacturing) to solve problems.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. JOB SUMMARY:
The Tendering & Purchasing Specialist is responsible for managing the end‑to‑end tendering, sourcing, and purchasing activities for materials, components, and services used in the manufacture of safety‑related and non‑safety‑related nuclear power plant parts. This role ensures compliance with stringent nuclear quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures while achieving cost, quality, and delivery objectives. The ideal candidate must have the ability to interpret Bills of Materials (BOMs) and technical drawings to accurately estimate costs and prepare proposals. This role requires close collaboration with sales, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to develop winning submissions and support business growth.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Prepare and manage RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders
· Evaluate supplier offers for commercial, technical, and quality compliance
· Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms
· Ensure adherence to nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
· Coordinate with engineering, quality, and production teams
· Track orders, expedite deliveries, and resolve supplier issues

SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Keep department manager apprised of future opportunities.

• Advise management of changes in current order and tender status.

• Actively involved with standardization and continuous improvement processes.

• Maintain quote and order files.

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and QESH Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in tendering, purchasing, cost estimation, or bid management in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

• Proficiency in reading and interpreting BOMs and technical drawings.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and cost structures.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP), SalesForce and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) preferred but not required.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.

• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

What we offer you

Country Benefits:

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
