jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc.. Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).

• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).

• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.

• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).

• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.

• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules.

Scope of Supply (Typical)

• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)

• MCC lineups and associated controls

• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)

• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)

• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)

• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)

• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded) Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution

Core Responsibilities
1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership)

Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:

• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)

• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)

• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation

Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:

• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)

• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects

• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details

• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable)

Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints.

Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release.

2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)

• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.

• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.

• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.

• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.

• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and interface registers.

• Manage change

jobs.title: Service Technician / Technicien Service
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Technicien Service passionné et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance, du diagnostic et de la réparation de nos équipements sur site et en atelier.

Responsabilités du poste

* Effectuer l'installation, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des pompes, agitateurs et équipements rotatifs de Sulzer chez les clients.
* Réaliser des diagnostics techniques précis et identifier les causes des pannes ou dysfonctionnements.
* Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés, incluant les actions réalisées, les pièces remplacées et les recommandations pour le client.
* Assurer un support technique aux clients, les conseiller sur l'utilisation et l'entretien de leurs équipements.
* Participer à la formation des clients sur l'utilisation et la maintenance de base des produits.
* Respecter scrupuleusement les procédures de sécurité et les normes de qualité en vigueur.
* Gérer les stocks de pièces détachées nécessaires aux interventions.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales et d'ingénierie pour améliorer la satisfaction client.
* Participer aux interventions fixées

Qualifications requises

* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Technicien Service ou dans un rôle similaire, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes, des équipements rotatifs ou de l'industrie lourde.
* Diplôme technique (BTS, DUT) en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique ou équivalent.
* Solides compétences en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel.
* Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques et électriques.
* Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure.
* Permis de conduire valide (déplacements fréquents à prévoir).
* Bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, sens du service client et autonomie.
* Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe.
* Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral). Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.
* Habilitations électriques à jour (B1V, BR, H0V) seraient un avantage.
* Connaissance des produits Sulzer serait appréciée.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

• Prepare and execute Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) with stakeholders.

• Provide technical quality support, including WPS/PQR review and material selection.

• Perform dimensional, geometric, and disassembly inspections.

• Manage NCRs, including RCA, CAPA, and lessons learned.

• Coordinate and oversee NDT and specialized testing with third parties.

• Ensure calibration, control, and traceability of inspection equipment.

• Support operations/projects, including progress updates and resolving technical issues.

• Train staff on quality standards and support LEAN and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with EHS, quality procedures, and 5S practices.

• Promote a safe, clean, and positive work environment.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar or related role

• Strong centrifugal pump background required; compressor/turbine experience is an advantage.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and technical specifications

• Experience in procedure development and NCR handling

• Proficient in precision measurement and workshop inspection

• Solid understanding of pump hydraulics, mechanical seals, and rotating equipment

• NDT certification (LPT/MPI/UT Level 2); LEAA lifting/rigging certification is a plus

• Knowledge of OEM standards and practices preferred

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Area Manager SEE
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Wir suchen einen Area Manager SEE (all genders) für unser Team in Österreich.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Aus- und Aufbau des Marktes in Südosteuropa für unsere technisch anspruchsvollen Produktgruppen

• Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungen unter Verwendung des gesamten Sulzer Produktportfolios

• Steigerung unserer Marktpräsenz in neuen Segmenten

• Betreuung unserer Key Accounts, sowie die Gewinnung neuer Kunden inklusive Budget- und Kostenverantwortung

• Angebotslegung, Auftragsverhandlung und -abschluss, Nachbereitung und technische Begleitung der Auftragsabwicklung

• Produktschulungen und Präsentationen bei unseren Händlern und Distributoren

Was Sie benötigen, um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein:

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Lehre, HTL, FH, Uni), vorzugsweise in der Verfahren- oder Prozesstechnik, und konnten idealerweise schon 2-3 Jahre Praxis in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit sammeln.

• Eine strukturierte, effiziente und terminorientierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit analytischem Denken und einer hohen Problemlösekompetenz zeichnen Sie aus.

• Sie punkten nicht nur mit ausgezeichneten Anwenderkenntnissen in MS-Office, sondern auch mit sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen und einem Führerschein der Klasse B.

• Ihre Teamfähigkeit, Verlässlichkeit und Belastbarkeit runden Ihr Profil ab.

What we offer you

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Freiheit, Vertrauen und Verantwortung für die Aufgaben, die Ihnen übertragen werden.

• Anhand unserer offenen und ehrlichen Kommunikation, die auf einer flachen Hierarchie und Du-Kultur basiert, schaffen wir ein angenehmes und humorvolles Arbeitsumfeld.

• Bedarfsorientierte fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sind uns wichtig.

• Eine faire Entlohnung (entsprechende Überzahlung zum Mindestgehalt lt. KV € 3.329,62 auf Basis Vollzeit), qualitativ hochwertige Arbeitsmaterialien, ein ansprechendes Sozialpaket sowie betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung zählen für uns zu den "Must-haves"

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

Qualifications:

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to use Sales

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols. Assembly Mechanic

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We've been awarded a top employer nationwide for the past 3 years. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step!

We are looking for Assembly Mechanics to join our Core team in La Porte.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols.

• Conduct thorough visual inspections of disassembled components, identifying wear, damage, or abnormalities that may affect equipment performance.

• Utilize precision measuring instruments, such as micrometers, dial indicators, and bore gauges, to take accurate measurements and assess dimensional integrity of parts.

• Operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts when required.

• Prepare detailed inspection reports documenting findings and measurements.

• Execute unit assembly of repaired or replaced components, following technical specifications and quality standards.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 3 years of hands-on, shop oriented experience turbomachinery repair preferred.

• High mechanical aptitude and experience in detailed mechanic industries (turbines, compressors, rotating equipment)

• Willingness to work overtime when necessary.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: QESH Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Pasadena, Texas, USA

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Stay updated with local, state, and federal QESH regulations.
· Prepare QESH permit applications and agreements as needed by regulatory agencies.
· Make sure branch stays compliant with ISO requirements.
· Maintain injury logs.
· Responsible for working with Divisional Safety to ensure all external, customer-related websites are current and that the company is in good standing (i.e.: ISNetworld, PIC, etc.).
· Maintain all Branch QESH related files.
· Enter all injuries into Intelex
· Send out notices and other correspondents as requested by Divisional Quality and SH and Environmental.
· Assist in writing Branch related Job Safety Analysis, Job Hazard Analysis and other safety related documents.
· Maintain and update all QESH related reference material.
· Conduct investigations of accidents, injuries and near misses to identify root causes and work with management to determine corrective and preventative actions so that such accidents might be prevented in the future.
· Conduct workplace inspections within the facility to endure compliance with company policies and procedures, safety and Quality standards and governmental regulations, including but not limited to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 AND ISO 45001.
· Assist with safety training and education programs.
· Responsibly for daily toolbox talks and weekly safety walks
· Assist with the company QESH manual updates and dissemination.
· Assist when needed in all corporate audits governing health, safety and Quality
· Maintain all calibration logs and make sure all equipment is calibrated in a timely manner
· Maintain QESH board
· Maintain Deviations and any other related quality paperwork needed for internal and external QESH audits.
· Generate environmental reports as requested by the Environmental Team.
· Work with the emergency response team to address environmental incidents such as chemical leaks and spills.
· Identify and solve any QESH violations.
· Conduct regular QESH inspections
· Oversee waste disposal and pollution control programs.

Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge in ISO 9001, ISO 14001 AND ISO 45001.

• Familiar with QESH policies in the manufacturing environment.

• Good computer skills.

Shift
Work hours are typically 7:30 until 4 pm

jobs.title: Helper
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This outline is intended for entry-level support staff PASADENA, TEXAS, USA

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures

• Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time

• Must be self-motivated and willing to learn

• Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis

• Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily

• Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project

• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen and hourly personnel

• General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities

• Provide assistance to Core departments as required

• Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times

• Maintain LEAN objections within the department

• Perform specialized task as required

• Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis

• Complete company-required training programs

• Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay

• Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments

• Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents

• Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or understood

• Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager

• Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• High school diploma or equivalent

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

What we offer you

Health insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Vision insurance
Dental insurance
401(k) 6% match
Paid time off
Paid parental leave
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Admin Coordinator is responsible for independently handling administrative tasks and coordinating support activities. This role works autonomously and may guide other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. PASADENA, TEXAS, USA

Summary:
The Estimating Coordinator provides essential support in the valuation and processing of incoming projects. Key responsibilities include maintaining data integrity within Microsoft Dynamics and facilitating clear communication between the company and its clients during the initial job intake phase.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
o Develop detailed repair estimates including labor, parts, and materials using internal systems and vendor quotes
o Collaborate with service technicians, ASM’s and engineers to determine scope of work and timelines
o Communicate clearly with clients regarding repair options, costs, and schedules
o Coordinate with procurement and vendors to source parts and materials
o Work with NPS group as needed to provide replacement options to our customers
o Maintain accurate records of estimates, work orders, and customer communications
o Ensure compliance with safety standards and industry regulations
o Support preventative maintenance planning and rebuild programs
o Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and process improvements

Qualifications:
· 2+ years of experience in estimating or service coordination within oil & gas or heavy industrial equipment preferred
· Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of oilfield machinery and systems preferred
· Proficiency in estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite
· Excellent communication and customer service skills
· High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects
· Familiarity with OSHA and industry safety standards
· Technical certifications or vocational training in mechanical or industrial repair is a plus

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

About the role

Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

Responsibilities

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge and understand of electro machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 3 years or more of proven welding experience.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. The following job description and duties are not meant to be all encompassing of the assigned duties. Due to business demands, job duties are variable by nature and subject to revisions, additions or deletions as may be determined and directed by Management or Supervision.
SUMMARY:
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required
· Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
· Designs setups and methods where none exist
· Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques
· Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs
QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of a machinist apprentice program or hands on training
.G code programming is a plus
· Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
· Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill
· Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision
· Working knowledge of tool geometry and application
· Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds
·At least 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment
· Willingness to work in a team environment
· Ability to work overtime as required
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
· While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
· Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: LAUNCH Program (Rotational)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:
• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service
• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service
• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service
• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program. Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path. Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities: Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX. All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements). Functions
• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.
• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.
• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects. Skills

jobs.title: Coordenador de Contratos PL
HR Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Sr. Officer is responsible for delivering HR services and supporting day-to-day HR operations. This role assists in recruitment, onboarding, and employee support, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The HR Representative provides hands-on operational and administrative support to the HRBP team, ensuring efficient execution of core HR processes. This role focuses on reducing transactional workload, improving data accuracy, and supporting payroll and HR systems processes so HRBPs can focus on strategic business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as day to day HR Support for assigned employee base

• Act as the primary support resource for HRBPs, assisting with day-to-day operational tasks

• Prepare and execute HR transactions in Workday and other systems (e.g., job changes, compensation updates, transfers)

• Draft communications and documentation to support business and HR initiatives

• Ensure timely follow-up on HR action items and requests

• Serve as a liaison between HRBPs and Payroll to support accurate and timely processing

• Validate data changes between HRIS (e.g., Workday) and payroll systems (e.g., ADP) to ensure alignment

• Reduce manual rework by leveraging reporting and system tools to capture employee changes

• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues proactively for resolution

• Support efforts to streamline payroll-related processes and minimize duplicate tracking

• Run and analyze standard reports (e.g., change reports, headcount, audit reports)

• Monitor data integrity across HR systems and address inconsistencies

• Support audits and compliance checks related to employee data and payroll

• Respond to employee and manager inquiries related to HR processes, pay, benefits, and data

• Provide guidance on system use (e.g., Workday self-service)

• Escalate complex or sensitive issues to HR Manager as needed
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of HR, payroll, or HR operations experience

• Hands-on experience with HRIS systems (Workday preferred) and payroll systems (ADP or similar)

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy skills
Key Competencies

• Operational excellence and process-oriented mindset

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage high-volume, detail-driven work

• Clear and professional communication skills

• Collaboration and customer service orientation
Preferred Experience

• Exposure to payroll processes, audits, and data reconciliation

• Experience driving process improvements or system adoption

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Indirect Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tax Jr. Analyst is responsible for assisting with basic tax-related tasks, including data entry, document preparation, and administrative support. This role works under close supervision and follows established procedures.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities
Indirect Tax Compliance

• Prepare, analyze, and file indirect tax returns (U.S. Sales & Use Tax, Canada GST/HST, and VAT in South America), ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.

• Use automation tools such as Vertex Returns and Avalara, reconciling information against accounting records (SAP/Dynamics), accounts receivable, and accounts payable.

• Set up and maintain new tax jurisdictions as needed, including system configuration/parameterization.

• Manage the electronic filing of returns and payments, as well as manual preparation when automation is unavailable.

• Prepare property tax renditions and coordinate payment requests.

• Manage annual tax license renewals, ensuring timely compliance.
Stakeholder Management

• Address internal and external inquiries related to indirect taxes (tax rate determination, taxability criteria, etc.).

• Support audit processes by compiling, validating, and providing required information.

• Maintain, analyze, and cleanse customer records, tax reports, and supporting documentation (exemption/resale certificates, export evidence, among others).

• Collaborate with finance, legal, and operations teams to ensure tax compliance and process improvements.

Profile Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in Mexican VAT (knowledge of U.S., Canada, and/or South America is a plus).

• Experience with tax automation tools (Vertex and Avalara highly preferred).

• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP and/or Dynamics.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, reconciliations, data analysis).

• Intermediate to advanced English level (B1/B2+) for professional communication.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.

• Good communication and teamwork abilities.

What we offer you

• Benefits Over law

• Saving found

• Training

• Christmas bonus over low

• Development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities Indirect Tax Compliance

• Use automation tools such as Vertex Returns and Avalara, reconciling information against accounting records (SAP/Dynamics), accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
• Set up and maintain new tax jurisdictions as needed, including system configuration/parameterization.
• Manage the electronic filing of returns and payments, as well as manual preparation when automation is unavailable.
• Prepare property tax renditions and coordinate payment requests.
• Manage annual tax license renewals, ensuring timely compliance. Stakeholder Management

• Support audit processes by compiling, validating, and providing required information.
• Maintain, analyze, and cleanse customer records, tax reports, and supporting documentation (exemption/resale certificates, export evidence, among others).
• Collaborate with finance, legal, and operations teams to ensure tax compliance and process improvements. Profile Requirements

jobs.title: Sales Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantworten Sie den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt. Sie betreuen bestehende Kunden, identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und begleiten Projekte von der ersten Kundenansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt

• Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie aktive Neukundengewinnung

• Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss

• Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren Sales-Pipeline inklusive Forecasting und CRM-Management

• Technische und kaufmännische Beratung von Kunden sowie Übersetzung von Anforderungen in passgenaue Lösungen

• Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Präsentationen und Produkt- bzw. Lösungsdemonstrationen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Service-, Projektmanagement- und Produktteams

• Unterstützung bei Angebotskalkulationen, technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungen

• Analyse von Markt‑, Wettbewerbs- und Technologietrends sowie Einbringen von Marktfeedback

• Mitwirkung an Vertriebsplanung, Zieldefinition und strategischen Vertriebsthemen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) oder kaufmännischer Hintergrund mit starker technischer Expertise

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in Energie, Schwerindustrie, Oil & Gas oder Power Generation

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Spezifikationen

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Verhandlungsstärke sowie hohe Kundenorientierung

• Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und starke Abschlussorientierung

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets sowie gelegentlich international

What we offer you

• Mitarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld mit enger Zusammenarbeit mit Technik und Engineering

• Attraktives Gesamtpaket mit fixem Gehalt und leistungsbezogenen Bonusanteilen

• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung und zum Ausbau der eigenen Vertriebsexpertise

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Quality Engineer / Welding Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld einbringen und weiter ausbauen? In dieser Position als Quality Engineer übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Sicherstellung unserer Qualitätsstandards entlang des gesamten Fertigungsprozesses. Ihre Expertise in der Schweißtechnik, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Qualifikation als Schweißfachingenieur, ermöglicht es Ihnen, komplexe Anforderungen zuverlässig umzusetzen und einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Produktqualität zu leisten.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung der auftragsbezogenen Qualitätssicherung im Bereich Schweißtechnik

• Erstellung und Umsetzung operativer Qualitätssicherungsstandards

• Schweißtechnische und prüftechnische Beratung interner Fachstellen sowie externer Kunden

• Erstellung und Prüfung von Verfahrensanweisungen und schweißtechnischer Dokumentationen

• Überwachung und Kontrolle aller Schweißprozesse unter Berücksichtigung von Produktionsabläufen und Kundenspezifikationen

• Qualitätsplanung auf Basis spezifischer Kundenanforderungen

• Erstellung und Pflege von Prüfunterlagen

• Umsetzung komplexer und anspruchsvoller Spezifikationen

• Betreuung von Kunden und Abnehmern im Rahmen von Qualitätsfragen

• Durchführung von Inspektionen und Abnahmen bei Lieferanten

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise im Maschinenbau oder in der Verfahrenstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Qualifikation als Schweißfachingenieur (SFI) sowie fundierte Kenntnisse der relevanten Normen (DIN EN ISO 14731, ISO 3834) erwünscht

• Praxiserfahrung als Schweißfachingenieur im Sondermaschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld

• Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Spezifikationen (z.   B. API, ISO, Druckgeräte-Richtlinie/AD 2000)

• Kenntnisse im Nuklearbereich sowie relevanter Normen (z.   B. RCC-M, ISO 19443) von Vorteil

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und eine prozessorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse (MS Office, idealerweise SAP)

What we offer you

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Ausstattung

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen (u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Familienservice ‑ Hotline)

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales engineer/Ingénieur technico-commercial
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Technico-Commercial passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de la promotion et de la vente de nos solutions techniques, ainsi que du développement et de l'entretien des relations clients sur un territoire défini.

Responsabilités du poste

* Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de vente pour atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires et de marge.
* Identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients potentiels dans les secteurs d'activité ciblés par Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU.
* Comprendre les besoins techniques des clients et proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits et services (pompes, agitateurs, etc.).
* Préparer et présenter des propositions techniques et commerciales détaillées.
* Négocier les contrats et les conditions de vente avec les clients.
* Assurer un suivi régulier des clients existants pour garantir leur satisfaction et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et de production pour s'assurer que les solutions proposées sont réalisables et conformes aux attentes du client.
* Participer à des salons professionnels et des événements de l'industrie.
* Réaliser des rapports d'activité commerciale et des prévisions de vente.
* Veiller à la conformité avec les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise.

Qualifications requises

* Diplôme d'ingénieur (BAC+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou domaine technique équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3-5 ans) dans un rôle d'ingénieur technico-commercial, idéalement dans le secteur des équipements industriels, des pompes ou des machines tournantes.
* Solides compétences techniques et compréhension des principes de fonctionnement des équipements industriels.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et présentation.
* Capacité à établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles solides.
* Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats.
* Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (écrit et oral).
* Permis de conduire valide et disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Tendering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung des Tendering-Teams in Deutschland und entwickeln Strukturen, Prozesse und Pricing-Strategien gezielt weiter. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen und internationalen Stakeholdern zusammen und stellen eine effiziente, transparente Angebots- und Kalkulationssteuerung sicher.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Leitung des Tendering-Teams Deutschland

• Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Angebots- und Kalkulationsprozessen

• Analyse und Optimierung von Pricing-Strategien sowie kommerziellen Rahmenbedingungen

• Sicherstellung von Margentransparenz und wirtschaftlicher Bewertung von Angeboten und Projekten

• Qualitätssicherung komplexer nationaler und internationaler Ausschreibungen

• Bewertung von kommerziellen und vertraglichen Risiken und Chancen

• Einführung und Implementierung von BIM in Angebots- und Projektprozessen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Engineering, Controlling sowie internationalen Stakeholdern

• Repräsentation der Tendering-Funktion in Management-Gremien

Ihr Profil

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Bereich Tendering, Bid Management oder Sales Engineering

• Erfahrung in Transformations- oder Interim-Mandaten

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Pricing, Kalkulation, Vertragsstrukturen und Discount-Modellen

• Hintergrund in einem technisch geprägten Industrieumfeld

• Erfahrung mit komplexen Angebots- und Projektstrukturen; BIM-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und souveränes Auftreten

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenz, auch auf Executive-Level

• Fließendes Englisch sowie verhandlungssicheres Deutsch

What we offer you

• Interim-Position mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum

• Direkte Einbindung in nationale und internationale Managementprozesse

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Kostenloser Obstkorb, Kaffee und Wasser und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü

• Ein starkes, hilfsbereites Team mit gutem Zusammenhalt

• Moderne Arbeitsmittel

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen, u. a.: Vergünstigungen/Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad ‑ Programm, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebliche Sonderleistungen wie Familienservice ‑ Hotline

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.de: Internal Controls Spezialist / ICS Manager (m/w/d) – Vollzeit/Teilzeit
titleByLocale.fr: Internal Controls Spécialiste / ICS Manager (m/w/d) – Vollzeit/Teilzeit

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für den Auf- und Ausbau eines wirksamen Internal Control Systems (ICS) in einem internationalen Umfeld. Sie arbeiten eng mit Finance-Teams und internen wie externen Prüfern zusammen und stellen sicher, dass Prozesse, Kontrollen und Compliance-Anforderungen konzernweit sauber umgesetzt werden. Diese Position kann entweder in Voll- oder Teilzeit (ab 25 Stunden/Woche) ausgeübt werden.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Weiterentwicklung des Internal Control Systems (ICS) für alle DACH-Gesellschaften gemäß Konzernvorgaben

• Sicherstellung der Segregation of Duties (SoD) inkl. Prüfung und Monitoring kritischer Berechtigungen in ERP-Systemen

• Durchführung interner Kontrollen und Audits (Reviews, Stichproben, Prozessanalysen, Dokumentationsprüfungen)

• Identifikation finanzieller Risiken sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Maßnahmen

• Schulung und Beratung der Finance-Teams zu ICS-Standards, Compliance-Anforderungen und Prozessqualität

• Erstellung von Reports, Audit-Follow-ups und Management-Updates

• Ansprechpartner:in für interne und externe Prüfer

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Finance, Accounting, BWL oder vergleichbar

• 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in Internal Controls, Audit, Finance oder Risikomanagement

• Erfahrung im Industrie- oder Produktionsumfeld sowie in der länderübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit (DACH) von Vorteil

• Fundierte Kenntnisse von Finanzprozessen, Rechnungslegung und ICS-Frameworks

• Analytische, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich zu vermitteln

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Durchsetzungsstärke und interkulturelle Kompetenz

• Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Microsoft Dynamics)

• Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (insb. Excel und PowerPoint)

• Kenntnisse in Tagetik und Qlik Sense von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Ausstattung

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen (u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Familienservice‑Hotline)

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production & Warehouse
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Lagerarbetare – Självständig roll med varierade arbetsuppgifter Är du en självgående person som trivs med ansvar och ett praktiskt arbete? Vi söker nu en engagerad lagerarbetare som vill arbeta i en varierad och viktig roll i vår organisation.

Nordic Water är ett ingenjörsföretag med passion för att utveckla innovativa, tekniska lösningar och produkter som revolutionerar vår bransch. Vattenrening är ett snabbt växande område där Nordic Water är en av de största aktörerna på en global marknad. Våra kunder finns över hela världen och försäljningen sker både direkt och via distributörer. Vår försäljning består i allt från enskilda produkter till större projekt samt eftermarknad

Om rollen

Som lagerarbetare hos oss arbetar du självständigt och har en central funktion i att serva olika delar av organisationen. Rollen är bred och innefattar både traditionellt lagerarbete och mer praktiska moment såsom att bygga emballage.

Arbetsuppgifter

• Hantering av material och gods i lager

• Serva interna avdelningar med material och leveranser

• Bygga och anpassa emballage för transport

• Truckkörning och lastning/lossning

• Administrativa uppgifter kopplade till lagerhantering

Kvalifikationer

• Erfarenhet av lagerarbete

• Truckkort

• God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta eget ansvar

• Praktisk läggning med viss hantverkskunskap (t.ex. att bygga emballage)

Meriterande

• Erfarenhet av arbete i ERP-system

• Särskilt meriterande är kunskap i Pyramid

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Perform routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, and mail handling.
Support scheduling and meeting coordination.
Maintain office supplies and assist with logistics.
Follow instructions and escalate non-routine issues.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic administrative and organizational skills.
Ability to follow instructions and procedures.
Familiarity with office tools and systems.
Willingness to learn and support team needs.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary
The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.

jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day production or service center activities, ensuring efficiency, quality, and safety in manufacturing or service processes. This role supervises teams, coordinates resources, and supports continuous improvement efforts.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium organization.

Key Responsibilities
Supervise teams and ensure adherence to schedules.
Monitor production or service metrics and implement improvements.
Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards.
Coordinate with maintenance and logistics to support operations.
Train and develop team members.
Support implementation of lean manufacturing practices.
Report performance and issues to senior management.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 6+ years of relevant work experience are minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in manufacturing or production management.
Strong leadership and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with lean tools and continuous improvement.
Proficiency in production software and reporting tools.
Effective communication and team-building abilities.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

jobs.title: Senior Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Work with the Sales Team, as instructed by the Head of Tendering, in the preparation of tenders and ensure adequate support to meet the company’s overall business plans and strategies.

Key Responsibilities

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms & conditions, and lead time.

• Ensure application of Sulzer tools, policies, procedures, codes of conduct, and best practice guidelines.

• Review inquiry documents and specifications, and prepare quality quotations on time using current tendering tools and procedures, independently or with guidance.

• Analyze customer requirements, particularly for complex applications and products within the relevant market.

• Develop suitable technical solutions in collaboration with specialist departments.

• Consult customers and the sales team on pump applications, including preparation of specifications and configuration of pumps and accessories.

• Obtain and evaluate subcontractor offers and ensure proper expediting.

• Cooperate with plants within the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network.

• Analyze and evaluate commercial and technical risks at the bidding stage, support negotiations with specialist departments, and develop approaches to minimize risks.

• Prepare and present technical/commercial offers, support clarification meetings with clients, ensure successful handover to project teams, and maintain sales systems and data.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• 5–7 years of relevant experience in a similar or related role

• Structured approach to work, with the ability to break down complex issues in collaboration with the bid team

• Experience in at least one of the following areas: pump design, international tendering/sales, project management, or equivalent

• Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and related accessories

• Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills are preferred

What we offer you

• A great working environment.

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: TSF Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Production Worker / Technician is responsible for coordinating daily production activities, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, and supporting the team in achieving operational goals. This role provides technical guidance and hands-on support to production staff while promoting continuous improvement.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Production Supervisor: TSF Job Description

Location: Margate, FL
Department: Services_AME
Position: Production Supervisor

Company Overview:
Sulzer Rotating Equipment Services (SRES) is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the turbomachinery industry. SRES specializes in the repair, overhaul and parts sales of Heavy Industrial Turbines, Aero Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, Compressors, Pumps, and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical and Power Generation industries.

Position Summary (TSF)
The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily shop floor operations to ensure work is performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved scopes, procedures, and quality standards. This role leads technicians and shop personnel, manages production schedules, and ensures all work is completed accurately and on time. The Production Supervisor works closely with Operations, Project Management, and Inventory teams to support execution, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

• Lead and supervise shop employees, ensuring work is performed in compliance with safety policies, SOPs, and quality requirements

• Manage daily shop scheduling, issue work scopes and packets, and ensure all released work is completed per approved scope

• Inspect all work performed and review signoffs, documentation, and assembly records for completeness and accuracy

• Assist in the development and execution of production timelines, supporting delivery commitments and operational priorities

• Coordinate and manage shop resources, including routers, cranes, hoists, equipment, and general housekeeping

• Inspect and manage issued parts, request required materials, and ensure parts are allocated to the correct projects

• Manage employee time, PTO, overtime planning, training needs, and reporting of safety incidents or near misses

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in operations, engineering, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

• 5+ years of progressive experience in operations management, manufacturing, or industrial production environments

• Strong leadership, planning, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across departments

• Proficiency with ERP systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office; experience with quality or safety systems preferred

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
